items.description: Generates a dynamic, high-impact anime illustration of two female characters fighting in a traditional dojo with elemental energy effects.
items.content: An anime-style illustration of a {argument name="action type" default="high-impact martial arts battle"} between two young female fighters in a {argument name="setting" default="traditional wooden martial arts dojo"}. In the foreground, a girl with black hair in a high bun wears a {argument name="character 1 color theme" default="red and white"} Chinese-style martial arts outfit with baggy pants. She is in a dynamic, low, forward-thrusting stance, surrounded by swirling red energy and water splashes. In the background to the right, a girl with light purple hair in twin buns wears a {argument name="character 2 color theme" default="green and purple"} Chinese dress with gold embroidery and black tights. She is leaping through the air in a flying kick pose, surrounded by swirling blue energy. The wooden floorboards are splintering from the intense impact, with debris and dust flying through the air. Above them hangs a weathered wooden sign with the text "{argument name="sign text" default="武術会"}". The scene features dramatic lighting, a low-angle dynamic perspective, and intense action effects.

In the lower right, place 1 large black-and-white QR code inside a white square frame. Beneath and beside it, add bold Japanese text in white with blue outline reading 「今すぐダウンロード」. At the very bottom, include 2 official-style store badges: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall look: ultra-detailed, polished key art, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel-shaded anime rendering, premium mobile game marketing poster, intense action energy, cinematic lighting, and layered UI-heavy promotional layout.

items.title: Epic Norse Sky Warrior With Crystal Beasts
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical fantasy-anime splash illustration of a horned sky warrior with three crystal-armored animal companions, ideal for posters, card art, or game key visuals.
items.content: A dynamic high-fantasy anime illustration in a vertical poster composition, showing 4 heroic figures suspended in a stormy celestial sky filled with glowing clouds, blue crystal shards, and floating turquoise feathers. At the center, a tall armored male warrior inspired by a Norse god stands as the commanding focal point, with long flowing brown hair, a gold-and-teal horned helmet, a dark green and blue cape whipping in the wind, ornate black, teal, and gold armor with an open muscular chest, and a bright cyan wolf emblem glowing on his chest. He raises one hand upward toward a radiant circular magical sigil above him, while his other hand holds a long spear with a crystalline blue spearhead. Around him are 3 fox-and-wolf-like companion creatures in matching ice-crystal armor. In the lower foreground, 1 large ferocious orange wolf charges toward the viewer with its mouth open in a roar, oversized claws extended, white mane, blue crystal head armor, blue-and-gold armor plates on its back and legs, and a huge fluffy tail. On the upper left, 1 athletic orange fox warrior leaps forward midair wearing angular blue crystal armor and large faceted blue wings, posed like a fast aerial attacker. On the right, 1 small cute chibi fox companion floats happily with big blue eyes, a wide smile, a blue tunic-like outfit with glowing cyan patterns, and a crystal crown on its head. Use vivid saturated colors, especially electric cyan, sapphire blue, teal, gold, and orange. The mood is epic, divine, and magical, with strong motion lines, dramatic foreshortening, glowing highlights, detailed fur and feathers, polished crystal textures, and cinematic fantasy trading-card splash art quality.

items.title: Retro ChatGPT Images 2.0 Space Poster
items.description: A weathered retro-futurist poster showing ChatGPT Images 2.0 as a space-age rocket advertisement, ideal for editorial visuals about AI image generation breakthroughs.
items.content: A vintage mid-century space-race propaganda poster pasted on a rough white plaster wall, photographed straight-on in natural light. The poster is slightly wrinkled, creased, and weathered, with worn edges and small tears, giving it an authentic aged paper texture. The design uses a limited retro palette of deep navy blue, faded cream, muted red-orange, and dusty teal. Large bold headline text dominates the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0"}, with “ChatGPT” in oversized cream sans-serif letters and “Images 2.0” below in bold red-orange. On the right side, a tall retro rocket stands upright launching upward through cream-colored smoke, with the vertical body text {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} in red-orange. A thin orbital trajectory line arcs across the upper half of the poster from left to right, looping around the rocket. Near the center-left, a small detached space capsule floats along the orbital path. The lower left shows the curved horizon of Earth, rendered in a vintage illustrated style with teal oceans and cream landmasses. The bottom band is a solid red-orange strip containing small spaced-out cream text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"}. Include 4 visible stars or celestial dots in the dark sky: 2 tiny starbursts, 1 small cream dot, and 1 larger cream dot. The overall composition should feel like a 1950s–1960s sci-fi travel poster or Soviet/American space-age advertising print, with screen-printed texture, subtle folds, nostalgic typography, and a cinematic retro-futurist mood.

items.title: Photoreal School Uniform Shrine Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a polished photorealistic portrait of a young woman in a school uniform outdoors, ideal for editorial fashion, character visuals, or lifestyle-style AI portraits.
items.content: A photorealistic waist-up portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing outdoors in bright natural sunlight, framed in a vertical composition. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with a glossy shine, parted slightly off center, falling over both shoulders. She wears a crisp white short-sleeve school uniform shirt with a structured collar, a navy blue striped necktie, and a detailed embroidered crest patch on the left chest pocket featuring a crown and heraldic emblem. Pose her at a slight three-quarter angle with relaxed posture, her head turned subtly to the side for a refined candid fashion-photo feel. Place her in front of vivid {argument name="background setting" default="red shrine architecture"} with rich red pillars and a curved blue roof detail visible in the blurred background, using shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh to keep the subject sharply in focus. The lighting should be clean, high-contrast, and flattering, with bright highlights on the hair and shirt, realistic fabric folds, natural skin tones, and a polished premium portrait aesthetic reminiscent of Japanese commercial photography.

items.title: Countryball Hormuz Strait Standoff
items.description: This prompt generates a satirical countryball meme showing the US and Iran blocking each other at the Strait of Hormuz, useful for editorial humor or geopolitical social media posts.
items.content: A humorous political meme illustration in a simple countryball cartoon style, showing the current situation at the {argument name="location label" default="호르무즈 해협"} as a narrow chokepoint. Use a wide landscape composition with bright flat colors, thick black outlines, and a clean hand-drawn infographic-like look. In the foreground, place 2 countryballs standing shoulder to shoulder on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge with rocks along both sides, making it obvious that only one can pass at a time. On the left is a {argument name="left country" default="United States"} countryball painted with the American flag, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, facing the other ball with a stubborn attitude. On the right is an {argument name="right country" default="Iran"} countryball painted with the Iranian flag, wearing a dark turban-like hat, with angry slanted eyes, also refusing to move. Add 2 large white speech bubbles, one beside each countryball, and put the same bold Korean word in both bubbles: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}. In the midground and background, show a busy blue sea crowded with 9 ships total: 2 gray US warships on the far left, 1 Chinese submarine with a red Chinese flag, 4 oil tankers lined up in the center-left and center carrying different national flags, and 2 gray military ships near the narrow passage with small American flags. At the top right, include a large Iranian flag overlay along the coastline. Draw beige landmasses around the waterway to resemble a simplified map view of the Strait of Hormuz. At the bottom center, add a bold caption in Korean and English on the sand: {argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}. The mood should be satirical, tense, and meme-like, but visually cute and readable.

items.content: A detailed satirical countryball meme illustration of the {argument name="waterway name" default="Strait of Hormuz"} as a very narrow sea passage between two steep rocky cliffs, painted in a polished digital cartoon style with dramatic shading and textured stone. In the center foreground, exactly 2 countryballs block each other in the tight channel so that only one can pass. On the left is a USA countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the American flag, wearing a dark navy baseball cap labeled "USA" in large white letters. On the right is an Iran countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the Iranian flag and emblem, wearing a green-and-white headband tied on the side; the headband contains Korean text that reads "저항은 우리의 권리". Above each ball is exactly 1 white speech bubble with thick black outline, for a total of 2 speech bubbles, and both say {argument name="speech text" default="길!"} in large bold Korean lettering, as if neither side will yield. On the right cliff, include exactly 1 warning sign with Persian text at the top and a red warning triangle below, indicating that only one person can pass. In the left bottom corner, place exactly 1 black oil barrel labeled "OIL" with dark spilled oil pooling around it. In the right bottom corner, place exactly 1 black naval mine with Persian writing on it, attached to a chain. In the background beyond the narrow passage, show open sea with exactly 3 distant ships, including at least 1 larger tanker and faint dark smoke rising into the sky. Use a tense but humorous geopolitical meme tone, centered composition, eye-level view, soft daylight, slightly muted realistic colors, crisp outlines, and high readability for all text.

items.title: Japanese Fantasy Winged Pig Film Poster
items.description: A text prompt for generating a richly detailed Japanese animated movie poster featuring a winged pig-like protagonist in a bittersweet urban fantasy montage.
items.content: A dramatic Japanese fantasy movie poster in a painterly, ultra-detailed cinematic illustration style. The poster is vertically composed like a theatrical key visual, with a warm gold title at the bottom and multiple emotional vignettes layered into one unified scene. The central character is a small fluffy pig-like creature with soft pale cream fur, oversized pink inner ears, a tiny snout, a curled tail, and large feathered angel wings glowing with golden light. It stands upright on a rooftop or elevated wooden platform overlooking a vast Tokyo cityscape at sunset, holding a whiskey glass in one hoof with the other hoof on its hip, posed like a weary but resilient middle-aged salaryman. In the distance are the Tokyo skyline, water, bridges, floating lanterns, and Tokyo Tower glowing orange-red under a radiant sky filled with clouds lit in gold, peach, violet, and deep blue. Around the center are 4 supporting vignette scenes: 1) top left, the winged pig sits alone at a narrow bar counter in a nostalgic lantern-lit Japanese alley at night, looking exhausted and melancholy, with a bottle and a glass nearby; 2) top center, the winged pig sits drinking with 2 human adults in an izakaya-like nightlife setting, warm lights surrounding them; 3) upper right, the winged pig walks away down railway tracks toward a brilliant ocean sunset, carrying a small suitcase, seen from behind; 4) left middle, the winged pig walks alone through a rain-slick neon-lit city street at night, seen from behind, surrounded by glowing signs and reflections. The whole image should feel bittersweet, magical, lonely, and hopeful, like a prestige animated film poster about adulthood, solitude, and emotional survival. Use lush lighting, dense environmental detail, sparkling reflections, glowing lanterns, cinematic atmosphere, and rich blue-orange color contrast. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the art: at the very top, the tagline "ひとりで生きてきた。だけど、ひとりじゃ涙は止まらない。"; above the title, the line "独身オヤジ、最後の青春。"; a very large main title at the bottom center reading "翼のオヤジ" in bold brushed calligraphic characters; below it, the tagline "笑って、泣けて、明日また頑張れる。この冬、いちばんやさしい奇跡。"; on the bottom right, a circular badge reading "秋公開" and "今"; add small fine-print credits across the lower edge in the style of a Japanese film poster. Include 2 visible vertical lantern/shop signs in the street scenes reading "居酒屋" and 1 bottle label reading "黒豚". High detail, emotional fantasy poster, premium animated-film aesthetic, Japanese urban nostalgia mixed with magical realism.

items.content: A realistic indoor selfie-style portrait of a young East Asian man from the chest up, seated near a large modern window in a high-rise apartment or hotel room during soft daylight. He has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, thick and slightly tousled with a center part and soft volume over the forehead and sides. His build appears slim, with a long neck and smooth light skin. He wears a {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} button-up shirt made of matte cotton or poplin, slightly oversized, with the top several buttons undone to create a deep open collar and relaxed, casual styling. The camera is held close in a natural selfie angle, portrait orientation, framing the shoulders, chest, neck, and head. His face is fully obscured by a large centered rectangular blur or mosaic censor block, while the ears, jawline edges, neck, and hair remain visible. The mood is understated, moody, and elegant, with muted neutral colors, soft window light from the right side, gentle shadows, and a candid social-media selfie feeling. Background details include 1 beige wall section on the left, 1 small dark wall control panel, 1 vertical metallic trim or lamp edge, and 2 tall dark-framed window panels on the right with a faint out-of-focus city skyline outside. Photorealistic smartphone photo, clean modern interior, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, subtle contrast, no smile visible because of the censor block, minimal editing, stylish and believable personal selfie.

items.title: Retro Chinese Childhood Memory Poster
items.description: A warm nostalgic poster-style collage of 1980s–1990s Chinese childhood memories, ideal for editorial art, social posts, or retro cultural storytelling.
items.content: A nostalgic Chinese retro collage poster about {argument name="theme title" default="8090的记忆"}, designed like a worn scrapbook page mixed with a hand-painted memory map. Use a vertical composition with warm sepia, dusty red, faded orange, and aged paper beige tones. The background is old cracked paper, yellowed magazine clippings, and scuffed vintage print textures. At the upper right, show a large realistic human hand holding a black fountain pen with a gold nib, as if writing the memories onto the page. The center of the poster is a large irregular wooden plaque or cutout board containing 8 numbered memory scenes, each embedded like miniature dioramas with handwritten Chinese captions and short bullet-point notes. Scene 1, labeled "1 弹弓", shows a young boy crouching and aiming a slingshot outdoors near a stone wall and tree. Scene 2, labeled "2 滚铁环", shows 2 children running while pushing metal hoops with sticks along an alley. Scene 3, labeled "3 鞭炮", shows 2 children crouching beside lit firecrackers on the ground with smoke and red paper debris. Scene 4, labeled "4 供销社", shows an old-fashioned neighborhood supply store counter with 1 shopkeeper and 1 child customer, shelves packed with goods behind them. Scene 5, labeled "5 赶集", shows a lively rural street market with multiple adults, chickens, produce, baskets, and a bicycle vendor. Scene 6, labeled "6 戏台", shows a village opera stage with 4 performers in traditional costume under red curtains, watched by a seated audience. Scene 7, labeled "7 掏鸟窝", shows 2 boys at a tree, with 1 climbing or reaching into a bird nest and 1 watching below. Scene 8, labeled "8 摩托车", shows 2 riders on a vintage motorcycle driving down an old street at sunset. Surround the main board with exactly 10 extra nostalgic objects: 1 old children’s booklet tied with a red ribbon at upper left, 2 glass marbles nearby, 1 vintage comic or picture magazine at mid-right, 1 small blue illustrated booklet at lower left, 1 green tin frog toy near the bottom left, 1 tiny wooden chair at the lower left edge, 1 enamel mug with red Chinese text at lower right, 2 colored pencils beside the mug, and 1 school exercise notebook labeled "练习簿" at the bottom right. At the top, place the large bold Chinese headline {argument name="headline text" default="8090的记忆"} in distressed red and blue typography, with a smaller handwritten-style subtitle beneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子"}. On the right side of the central board, add handwritten text reading "这一页，刚刚写完。" At the bottom, add a large red banner with the main quote {argument name="bottom quote" default="那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。"} and a smaller line underneath reading {argument name="bottom subquote" default="很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。"} The whole image should feel richly detailed, cinematic, tactile, sentimental, and deeply rooted in 1980s–1990s Chinese childhood memories, combining illustration, miniature realism, poster design, scrapbook layering, and editorial nostalgia.

items.title: Lunar Bathhouse Comedy Manga Page
items.description: A retro-futuristic anime comic page depicting a whimsical sento on the moon, ideal for generating playful AI manga scenes with multiple character-driven panels.
items.content: A colorful single-page Japanese comic manga set in a whimsical lunar public bathhouse on the moon, drawn in a polished retro-futuristic anime style with warm lighting, thick clean panel borders, expressive sound effects, and highly detailed environmental storytelling. The scene is a moon onsen called "月面銭湯 つきのゆ" with a large illuminated entrance sign, blue noren curtain with the white character "ゆ", exposed pipes, gauges, rounded architecture, and a giant circular window showing the moon surface and Earth in space. Include exactly 8 comic panels arranged in a dynamic page layout. Panel 1: exterior establishing shot of the bathhouse on the moon, with the sign "月面銭湯 つきのゆ", a smaller sign reading "重力 1/6", a red milk vending machine labeled "牛乳", a tanuki statue, lunar terrain outside, and a vertical banner promoting the bath. Panel 2: a young female mechanic bathhouse worker with {argument name="character design" default="brown ponytail tied with a red polka-dot bandana, green work jumpsuit, tool belt, energetic expression"} adjusts a machine or boiler control, seen from behind or side, with speech balloons about preparing today's bath and boiler condition. Panel 3: a cute alien customer with {argument name="alien appearance" default="round mint-green body, purple spots, sleepy eyes, pink cheeks, small mouth, white towel with a purple star on its head"} relaxes in steaming bathwater, half submerged, with a rubber duck floating nearby and a wooden sign reading "ぬるめ じっくり リラックス". Panel 4: a small cleaning robot with {argument name="robot design" default="silver body, blue accents, black digital face with glowing blue eyes, red antenna light, thin mechanical arms and legs"} happily scrubs the floor with broom and bucket beside a hanging sign that says "清掃中". Panel 5: the same robot suddenly slips or splashes dramatically into the bath, with a huge water burst, many bubbles, the large sound effect "ぽわぁ〜ん!!", and the worker reacting in surprise from the side. Panel 6: the worker sits by the bath smiling, holding a bottle labeled "月面牛乳". Panel 7: the alien in the bath gives a thumbs-up while holding a bottle labeled "月面フルーツオーレ", looking blissfully satisfied, with the rubber duck still present. Panel 8: the cheerful robot poses beside the bath with cleaning tools and a bucket, near a bath curtain marked "ゆ" and a pink wash basin labeled "つきのゆ", saying the bath is the best. Maintain a cozy, comedic tone, retro Showa-style sento details mixed with space technology, glossy tiled bath surfaces, steam, bubbles, and cute character acting throughout. The comic should feel like a charming slice-of-life gag manga about working at a lunar bathhouse.

items.title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a humorous, high-impact parody beverage advertisement poster featuring a famous politician-like spokesperson promoting a Korean canned rice drink.
items.content:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.

items.title: Japanese Jungle Theme Park Parody Poster
items.description: A cinematic satirical Japanese ad poster for a fictional jungle dinosaur theme park, ideal for parody campaigns, social media visuals, or mock promotional key art.

author.name: AIに振り回されるおじちゃん

items.content: A hyper-detailed Japanese parody theme park advertisement poster in a vertical format, designed like a dramatic summer travel ad mixed with a luxury attraction campaign. The setting is a tropical jungle under a vivid blue sky with scattered clouds and a bright blazing sun in the upper right corner, with palm leaves framing the top edges. Across the top, place a huge 3D stone-textured Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}, with a smaller white Japanese tagline underneath that reads "— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —". In the center, feature a large modern smartphone standing upright and slightly tilted, dominating the composition. On its screen, show a beige ticket-lottery waiting interface with jungle silhouettes at the top and large bold Japanese text reading "整理券抽選中", a circular loading indicator, and smaller text near the bottom reading "結果発表まで30分" and "※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください". The phone status bar should show 10:00. Behind the phone on the left, place a roaring Tyrannosaurus rex emerging from jungle foliage, mouth open wide, realistic and threatening. On the right, place an ornate golden entrance gate with detailed carvings and a sign reading "プレミアムパス入口", leading to a red-carpeted premium entry lane. In the foreground and midground, show a long crowded queue of park visitors stretching deep into the scene, all wearing casual summer clothing, hats, towels, backpacks, and carrying umbrellas, fans, and water bottles, suggesting extreme heat and exhaustion. Several people nearest the viewer should have blurred faces. On the far left, add a giant weathered stone sign with huge red Japanese text reading "待ち時間 180分". At the lower left, include 3 stacked rustic wooden signboards: the top sign has a blue parking icon and text "駐車場 2,000円"; the middle sign has a smartphone icon and text "アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!"; the bottom sign has a dinosaur silhouette and text "当選者だけが冒険へ". Along the lower right side, place very large vertical white brush-style Japanese copy reading "待つこと、それが冒険だ。". Near the bottom right, include 3 small circular icon callouts with short Japanese promotional lines: "抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。", "スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。", and "プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。" with icons suggesting dinosaur, phone battery, and VIP access. At the very bottom center, add a black disclaimer strip with small white Japanese text reading "このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です". The overall style should be ultra-realistic, cinematic, high-contrast, satirical, and polished like a premium commercial poster, with exaggerated theme park hype, oppressive heat, and absurd queue-based adventure as the core joke.

items.content: A cinematic surreal space scene showing 1 astronaut floating in open space beside Earth, with the planet dominating the left side of the frame and the astronaut on the right, drifting backward with bent legs and one arm reaching toward the planet. items.title: Vintage Korean Gimbap Recipe Poster
items.description: This prompt generates an antique-style Korean recipe infographic poster for gimbap, suitable for food marketing, restaurant decor, or cultural cooking visuals.
items.content: Create a vintage Korean food poster on aged beige parchment paper with a slightly stained, textured background, dark ornamental border corners, and a traditional hand-painted ink-and-watercolor illustration style. The poster is a single vertically stacked infographic about {argument name="dish name" default="정통 한국 김밥"}, with elegant large Korean calligraphy at the top and a curved ribbon banner beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Traditional Korean Gimbap"}. In the upper center, show a large porcelain plate piled high with exactly 12 sliced gimbap pieces, each slice showing distinct fillings in white rice, yellow egg, orange carrot, green spinach, and dark seaweed wrapping. To the right of the plate, add a small porcelain bowl of kimchi and a short handwritten Korean note reading “간단한 보여도 정성이 들어간 한국의 맛! ♥”. Include a small red seal stamp with Korean text near the upper right. In the middle, add a labeled ingredients section on a ribbon header reading “재료”, showing exactly 6 ingredient panels in one row: 1. 김 (건김) as stacked seaweed sheets, 2. 밥 (양념 밥) as a bowl of rice, 3. 계란 (지단용) as sliced cooked egg strips, 4. 당근 (채썰어볶기) as julienned carrots, 5. 시금치 (데쳐서 무치기) as seasoned spinach, 6. 단무지 (김밥용) as yellow pickled radish strips. Below that, add another ribbon header reading “만드는 순서” and show exactly 6 framed step panels in two rows of three, connected left-to-right with arrows. Step 1 is labeled “1 밥 간하기” and shows a bowl of rice with sesame oil and salt beside it, caption “밥에 참기름 소금으로 간하기”. Step 2 is labeled “2 속재료 준비하기” and shows a cutting board with egg, carrot, and spinach plus a knife, caption “재료 볶아 속재료 준비하기”. Step 3 is labeled “3 김과 밥 펴기” and shows seaweed on a bamboo mat with rice spread over it, caption “김에 밥 얇게 펴기”. Step 4 is labeled “4 속재료 얹기” and shows the fillings arranged in horizontal rows over rice, caption “속재료를 차례로 얹기”. Step 5 is labeled “5 단단하게 말기” and shows two hands rolling the bamboo mat tightly, caption “김밥을 단단하게 말기”. Step 6 is labeled “6 썰어 완성하기” and shows a chef’s knife slicing a gimbap roll into pieces, caption “먹기 좋게 썰어 완성!”. At the bottom, add a wide banner with bold Korean calligraphy reading {argument name="bottom slogan" default="정성 가득한 한 줄의 행복!"} and a small heart. Decorate the lower corners with floral motifs and add a red square seal with the Chinese character “福” at the bottom right. Use muted sepia, brown, cream, olive green, and faded red tones, with finely sketched outlines, gentle watercolor shading, and authentic printed-poster composition. Add a small modern overlay logo in the top-left corner reading {argument name="brand text" default="Pollo AI GPT Image 2"}.

items.title: Steampunk Vintage Video Platform UI
items.description: This prompt generates an ornate steampunk-style fictional video streaming homepage, ideal for showcasing advanced text rendering and themed interface design.
items.content: Create a full-screen fictional video platform homepage in a richly detailed steampunk Victorian style, designed like an antique brass-and-wood web interface with dark bronze metal frames, engraved ornament, rivets, pipes, exposed gears, glowing Edison bulbs, and sepia-toned textures throughout. At the top center, a large embossed title reads {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"} in ornate gold serif lettering on a dark plaque, with a smaller subtitle plaque beneath it reading "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". In the top left corner, overlay a modern brand mark reading "Pollo AI" and "GPT Image 2" in clean contemporary type, contrasting with the antique interface. Add a circular analog gauge in the top right corner. Below the header, place a navigation bar with exactly 6 items: a home icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search field showing {argument name="search placeholder" default="Search ElectroVid..."} plus a search icon. The main layout is two-column: a narrow left sidebar and a larger main content area. In the left sidebar, add a section titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 vertically stacked channel cards, each with a circular emblem, channel name, subscriber count, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", and "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". In the main content area, feature a large central video player framed in ornate brass. The paused video image is a sepia historical scene of two suited men debating in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning sketches, one man pointing and the other gesturing, with soft blurred censor blocks over both faces. Include a video progress bar and controls along the bottom edge of the player, and a timestamp reading "08:47 / 22:31". Beneath the player, show the title {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"} in large serif text, followed by channel metadata for "The Electrical Age", "142K views", and "3 days ago", plus a like button on the right labeled "LIKE" and "5.8K". Below that, create a section header reading "LATEST VIDEOS" and display exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row. Card 1 shows a sepia portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing bulb with duration "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", and metadata "Thomas Edison", "89K views", "5 days ago". Card 2 shows a dramatic sepia image of a Tesla coil tower under electrical arcs with duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", and metadata "Nikola Tesla", "120K views", "1 week ago". Card 3 shows an antique automobile on a street with duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", and metadata "Henry Ford", "110K views", "1 week ago". Centered below the row, add a button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS". At the bottom center, add a copyright plaque reading "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.". Use a symmetrical, meticulously crafted interface with realistic depth, embossed typography, subtle warm lighting, old parchment panels, Victorian engraving aesthetics, and a polished cinematic sepia palette of brass, copper, dark wood, blackened steel, and antique gold.

items.title: Realistic Sam's Club Shopping Snapshot
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic candid warehouse-store portrait suitable for recreating an authentic shopping scene with branded retail signage and a shopper holding produce.
items.content: A candid, highly realistic smartphone photo inside a busy Sam’s Club warehouse store in China. Center the composition on a young East Asian man from mid-torso up, standing upright and facing the camera, with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block for privacy. He wears a plain black short-sleeve T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest and holds a large clear plastic bag of red apples in his left hand, tied at the top with a blue band. The apple bag has a white label reading “envy” with small Chinese text beneath it. Behind him is a bright retail interior with tall industrial ceilings, warehouse shelving, shoppers, shopping carts, and stacked produce displays. Prominently show the blue diamond Sam’s Club wall sign at upper left with the text “Sam’s CLUB” and “山姆会员商店,” and a large blue wall banner behind him reading “更好的生活尽在山姆” and “Life is Better in the Club.” On the upper right, hang a tall white vertical banner that reads “优质优价” and “Great Products Great Prices,” with blue and green geometric accents. Include many background customers, slightly out of focus, to create an authentic crowded shopping atmosphere. Lighting should be bright, even retail overhead lighting; colors natural; perspective eye level; documentary snapshot aesthetic; sharp foreground subject with mildly softened background; portrait orientation.

items.title: Realistic McDonald's Selfie Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic casual selfie of a man inside a McDonald's, useful for creating believable social-media-style restaurant snapshots.
items.content: A highly realistic casual smartphone selfie taken indoors at a McDonald's restaurant in Asia, framed as a chest-up portrait of a young man seated at a table. The camera is held slightly above table height at arm’s length, creating a natural front-facing selfie perspective with one forearm extending toward the lens. The subject wears a black T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest, has short straight black hair, thin dark eyeglass frames partly visible, and rests one hand lightly against his chin in a relaxed pose. His face is fully obscured by a large solid rectangular blur block in the center, preserving privacy while leaving the hair, ears, jawline edges, and glasses arms visible. In the lower left foreground sits 1 white McDonald's paper drink cup with a lid and a white straw, cropped by the frame. The background shows the restaurant counter area with warm ambient lighting, 1 large red wall panel on the left featuring the yellow McDonald's arches and the white slogan “i’m lovin’ it” with Chinese text below, 4 illuminated digital menu boards across the top displaying burgers, fries, combo meals, prices, and Chinese text, plus 2 people in the background near the counter, one facing away with a backpack and another partially visible behind the register. Use natural color balance, slight indoor grain, realistic reflections, shallow to moderate depth of field, and the candid look of an unstaged social media snapshot.

items.title: Four Seasons Continuity Panorama
items.description: A complex prompt for creating a seamless transition through all four seasons in a single panoramic digital illustration, demonstrated with the Shanghai Bund waterfront.
items.content:
Hyper-realistic digital illustration of {argument name="scene" default="the historic Shanghai Bund waterfront looking across the Huangpu River to the futuristic Lujiazui district"}, presented as a single continuous composition showcasing the cycle of seasons. The scene flows seamlessly from left to right in a natural progression: Winter, Spring, Summer, and Autumn. 

The left side features cold snowy winter elements, gradually thawing into the fresh green buds and blooms of spring, then morphing into the lush vibrant vegetation and bright sunlight of summer, and finally transitioning into the golden, orange, and red hues of autumn on the far right. 

There are no visible dividing lines between seasons; the weather, lighting, and vegetation blend smoothly to create a unified and harmonious panorama. Rich in detail, symbolic of the passage of time, cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed textures. --ar 4:3

items.title: Minimalist Cinematic Vertical Poster with Character Reference
items.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating minimalist, monochrome posters with single accent colors while maintaining character consistency from a reference image.
items.content:
添付のキャラを使い、以下を生成

# 指示
{argument name="ユーザー入力" default="[ユーザーが入力]"}について、モノクロ＋{argument name="アクセントカラー" default="1アクセントカラー"}のミニマルシアター系縦型ポスターを作成せよ。

# レイアウト要件
・タイトルは画面下部1/4エリアに大きく配置し、和文タイトルを最大サイズ・英文サブタイトルを小さく直下に添える
・上部中央にキャッチコピー（短文1〜2行）を配置する
・左上コーナーに受賞歴・公式認定バッジを縦積みで3〜4点並べる
・右端縦方向に縦書きキャッチコピー（2〜3行）を配置する
・画面中央やや左寄りにメインキャラクターを後ろ姿でシルエット的に立たせる
・背景には幻想的な要素（浮遊する島・巨大生物）をシルエットで表現する
・最下部に制作スタッフクレジット・公開日・配給情報を小さく横並びで配置する
・公開日は右下に大きなフォントで目立たせる

# デザイン要件
・背景はモノクロ（黒〜グレーグラデーション）で統一する
・アクセントカラーは1色のみ（例：鮮やかなコバルトブルーまたはゴールド）
・イラストスタイルはシルエット＋細いラインアートの組み合わせ
・タイトル文字はホワイト＋アクセントカラーで強調する
・全体的にシネマティック・アーティスティックな雰囲気を演出する
・カラフルな背景・過度な装飾・グラデーション多用は避ける
・フォーマット：縦型、アスペクト比 2:3（例：800×1200px）、高解像度
items.translatedContent:
Using the attached character, generate the following:

# Instructions
Create a minimalist theater-style vertical poster for {argument name="user input" default="[user input]"} using monochrome + {argument name="accent color" default="one accent color"}.

# Layout Requirements
- Place the title largely in the bottom 1/4 area, with the Japanese title at maximum size and the English subtitle small directly underneath.
- Place a catchphrase (1-2 lines) in the top center.
- Stack 3-4 awards/official certification badges vertically in the top-left corner.
- Place a vertical catchphrase (2-3 lines) along the right edge.
- Position the main character as a silhouette from behind, slightly left of the center.
- Represent fantastical elements (floating islands, giant creatures) in the background as silhouettes.
- Place staff credits, release date, and distribution info in a small horizontal line at the bottom.
- Highlight the release date in a large font at the bottom right.

# Design Requirements
- Keep the background monochrome (black to gray gradient).
- Use only one accent color (e.g., vivid cobalt blue or gold).
- Combine silhouette and thin line art styles.
- Emphasize the title text with white + the accent color.
- Create a cinematic and artistic atmosphere overall.
- Avoid colorful backgrounds, excessive decoration, or heavy use of gradients.
- Format: Vertical, aspect ratio 2:3, high resolution.

items.title: Geometric Bird Riding Bicycle
items.description: This prompt generates a clean minimalist vector illustration of a stylized bird cyclist, suitable for playful editorial graphics, logos, or modern poster art.
items.content: A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a whimsical bird riding a bicycle, built entirely from simple geometric shapes with thick black outlines. The bicycle is a black line-drawn road bike in side view facing left, with 2 large wheels, each wheel divided by a vertical and horizontal spoke cross, a simple triangular frame, a small black saddle, pedals, and a thin black ground line running horizontally beneath the bike. The rider is a stylized white bird with a large round body, a smaller round head, a pointed orange beak opened wide, and a pink lower beak interior. The bird has 1 visible black eye, a simple curved black line on top of the head, 1 teardrop-shaped wing behind the neck, and 1 angled white tail feather shape pointing backward. The bird leans forward over the bicycle as if actively riding. It has 2 long narrow orange legs with black outlines extending downward over the frame toward the pedals. Keep the composition centered, playful, clean, and abstract, with no shading, no texture, and a modern icon-like graphic style.

items.title: Move Display Stand Onto Deck

items.title: Chibi Shark Adventure Movie Poster
items.description: A colorful Japanese-style anime poster for a children’s ocean adventure film, ideal for recreating bold promotional key art with cute characters and dramatic title typography.
items.content: A bright, hyper-energetic Japanese movie poster illustration in a polished anime chibi style, set in a sparkling tropical ocean adventure scene. Center the composition on 2 cute chibi children riding a smiling blue shark that leaps diagonally upward through swirling seawater and white splash effects. The left child is a boy with short black hair, huge glossy blue eyes, a happy open-mouth smile, a black T-shirt, dark shorts, white sneakers, and a light blue shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood framing his face; he points upward with one hand and hugs the shark with the other. The right child is a girl with orange hair, large glossy purple eyes, a joyful open-mouth smile, an orange dress, pink shoes, and a pink shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood; she throws one arm wide in excitement while holding on with the other. Make the shark large and friendly with a rounded body, pale belly, tiny black eyes, and a wide open mouth. Surround them with a vivid underwater-and-surface world: schools of small tropical fish, exactly 1 sea turtle on the left, exactly 1 dolphin on the right, exactly 1 pink octopus on the right, exactly 1 pufferfish on the lower left, coral reefs and sea plants along the bottom edges, air bubbles throughout, and strong blue water motion lines. In the upper background, show a sunny sky with dramatic sun rays streaming into the water, fluffy clouds, 2 seagulls flying, a rocky tropical island with palm trees on the upper left, and a pirate ship on the upper right with white sails and a cute shark emblem. Add a ship wheel partly visible behind the main title. Use a dense, exciting Japanese kids-anime promotional layout with oversized 3D lettering and explosive effects. At the top, place the giant Japanese title text {argument name="headline text" default="サメなの ワクワク 大作戦"} in stacked lines, with glossy blue, orange-pink, and yellow-orange gradient letters, thick white outlines, dark blue shadows, water splashes, and sparkles. Beneath the title, add a smaller curved Japanese tagline in white with blue outline: {argument name="tagline" default="さあ、海のむこうへ！最高の冒険がはじまる！"}. At the bottom, place huge release text in Japanese, {argument name="release text" default="2026年 夏公開"}, in bold red-to-yellow gradient 3D letters with white and blue edging, sitting over a radiant orange burst. On the lower right, add a blue starburst badge with the Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="ドキドキ！ワクワク！いっしょに出発だ！"} in white and yellow. Include exactly 2 treasure-themed corner props: an open treasure chest with gold coins at the lower left and a compass at the lower right. The overall look should be glossy, saturated, family-friendly, whimsical, cinematic, and toy-like, with crisp outlines, exaggerated expressions, high contrast, and a poster-ready vertical composition. No photorealism, no muted colors, no minimalism.

items.description: A cinematic anime-style rooftop portrait of a cat-eared schoolgirl at sunset, ideal for nostalgic key visuals, character art, or social media showcase images.
items.content: A high-quality anime illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cat-eared schoolgirl"} leaning forward over a metal school rooftop railing at sunset, shown from a slightly low, close three-quarter angle. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with soft highlights, large reflective gray-brown eyes, round thin-rim glasses, and 2 fluffy cat ears emerging from her hair. Her expression is quiet, wistful, and slightly shy, with parted lips and a gentle downward gaze toward the viewer. She wears a Japanese sailor school uniform with a soft {argument name="uniform color" default="pink"} long-sleeve top, a gray sailor collar with white stripes, a vivid red neckerchief bow, and a plaid skirt partially visible, with 2 dark backpack straps over her shoulders. The scene is drenched in dramatic golden-hour backlighting, with intense warm rim light along her hair, ears, shoulders, and sleeves, glowing sun flare from the lower left, and a richly painted sky full of orange and peach clouds. In the background, show a 2-story Japanese school building with a red-tiled roof and glowing windows lit by the sunset. Emphasize nostalgic early-2000s high-end anime key visual quality, delicate linework, luminous eyes, detailed hair strands, cinematic composition, soft depth of field, vibrant warm color grading, polished shading, and an emotional serene atmosphere.

items.title: Three Beauty Mobile Landing Pages
items.description: A premium triptych mockup of three smartphone beauty website designs, ideal for showcasing AI-generated cosmetic brand landing page concepts on social media.
items.content: A polished promotional mockup showing 3 tall smartphone screens displayed side by side in a vertical triptych layout, each presenting a modern beauty brand landing page for a lip product. The overall composition is editorial, minimal, and premium, designed like a social media showcase of mobile web designs. The left panel sits on a soft lavender-to-blush gradient background and shows a black-framed phone with a cream and blush beauty website for {argument name="brand name" default="Kosas"}. At the top of this panel, small elegant serif text reads {argument name="left headline" default="Fresh Pout."}. The phone screen features a cropped close-up beauty image at the top, a bold headline reading “Lips in their fullest expression.” with “fullest” in italic serif styling, a rounded dark call-to-action button, a strip of 3 lip close-up thumbnails, 3 labeled benefit tabs reading “Plumps,” “Tingles,” and “Shines,” and a row of 5 shade or effect icons underneath. The middle panel sits on a lavender-to-deep-violet gradient background and shows a second black-framed phone with a more typographic landing page. Above it, serif text reads {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"}. The screen includes a cropped portrait image at top, a very large bold black stacked title reading “LIP PULSE.” with a pink italic script-style line “is here.” beneath it, a rounded dark button, a dark section with the phrase “Lips in their fullest expression.”, and a product grid near the bottom containing 6 shade cards arranged in 2 rows of 3. The right panel sits on a dark navy textured background and shows a third black-framed phone with a pink-forward e-commerce style page. Centered above it, monospaced white text reads {argument name="right headline" default="GPT Images 2.0"}. This screen prominently displays the product hero section with the brand name “Kosas,” a large title “The Lip Pulse,” a pink lip gloss tube angled to the right, small feature icons, a shade strip of 6 lip swatches near the middle, and a lower promotional block with additional pink product imagery. Keep the layout symmetrical with exactly 3 phones, one per panel, each fully visible and vertically oriented. Use high-end cosmetic campaign aesthetics, clean spacing, fashion-web typography mixing serif and bold sans serif, soft pink and cream UI palettes, subtle shadows, and a sleek product-design presentation suitable for showcasing AI-generated mobile website concepts.

items.title: Four-Panel Romantic Comedy Manga Page
items.description: This prompt generates a monochrome four-panel manga page with Japanese dialogue, ideal for creating dramatic romantic-comedy debate scenes with expressive character acting.

author.name: 小猫遊りょう（たかにゃし・りょう）

items.content: Create a black-and-white manga page with 4 stacked horizontal panels, clean black gutters, screentone shading, dramatic speed lines, and polished seinen-style linework. The page features two youthful anime characters with modern casual clothing and short dark hair, with the face area of both characters obscured by a soft square blur censor block. Panel 1: a slim young person with messy short dark hair and a collared shirt clenches one fist near their chest, body angled left, surrounded by an intense fiery aura effect in the background, looking emotional and defensive. On the right side, place a large jagged vertical speech balloon containing this Japanese text: 「何十時間も魂を削って描いた一枚と、プロンプト打ち込んで数秒で出した画像が同じ価値なわけないでしょ！ふざけないで！」. Panel 2: a second young person with slightly taller build, short dark hair, a dark zip jacket over a light shirt, raises one index finger calmly as if explaining a point. Add a rounded rectangular speech box on the right with this Japanese text: 「投下した労働時間で価値が決まるという典型的な“労働価値説の誤謬”だ。市場における価値は、出力された結果を受け手がどう評価するかで決まる」. Panel 3: the taller character gently pats the shorter character on the head; include a small hand-pat sound effect near the hand reading 「ポン」. The shorter character looks up in surprise. On the right side, add a large oval vertical speech balloon with this Japanese text: 「でも俺の市場価値基準はすごくシンプルだよ。君が俺のために照れてくれるこの数秒間に、何十時間分の価値も感じてるから」. Panel 4: close-up of the shorter character blushing intensely with spiral eyes, sweat drops, trembling expression, open mouth, and dense hatching on the cheeks, overwhelmed with embarrassment. Fill the background with dramatic radiating speed lines. Add a large jagged vertical speech balloon on the right with this Japanese text: 「だ、誰がアンタのために照れるか…っ！自意識過剰よ！」. Add two sound effects: a small 「プル…」 near the shoulder and a larger shaky handwritten 「カァァァ」 along the lower left side. Keep the whole page monochrome, highly expressive, romantic-comedy manga tone, with strong emotional contrast between heated argument, cool explanation, teasing affection, and flustered payoff.

items.title: Retro Pixel Mountain Valley
items.description: A vibrant pixel art alpine landscape with halftone comic shading, ideal for retro game backgrounds, scenic posters, or nostalgic environment art.
items.content: A highly detailed retro pixel art landscape of a bright alpine valley in summer, composed like a classic side-scrolling video game background but shown as a wide scenic vista. In the foreground, a winding tan dirt path curves from the bottom center into the middle distance through dense wildflower meadows, with a small blue stream at the lower right bordered by gray rocks and lush grass. Count 2 large foreground rock clusters, 1 winding path, and 1 visible stream. Fill the meadows with colorful flowers in vivid purple, yellow, red, pink, and white, with especially tall purple flower spikes on the left foreground and dense mixed blossoms on both sides of the path. On the left and right midground, place thick stands of leafy green trees and dark pine trees, framing the open valley center. In the background, show a dramatic mountain range with exactly 7 visible peaks: 1 dominant tall snow-capped peak slightly right of center, 2 medium purple peaks to its left, 2 smaller snowy blue peaks in the far center distance, 1 smaller purple peak to the right, and 1 cropped rocky mountain edge at the far left. Use vibrant greens and purples as the main palette, with cool blue shadows and lavender mountain faces. Above, render a bright blue sky with large creamy white clouds, halftone-dot shading throughout the sky and mountains, subtle vintage comic print texture, visible dithering, and crisp sharp pixel edges. Add exactly 4 small flying bird silhouettes in the sky. The whole image should feel colorful, nostalgic, scenic, and richly layered, with heavy halftone comic shading, retro print grain, no text, no UI, no characters, and no buildings.

items.title: ChatGPT Joke Prescription Set
items.description: A realistic overhead photo of a humorous Japanese medical prescription and medicine set for ChatGPT, ideal for parody healthcare-themed prop graphics or social media concept art.

author.name: マシモGPT🤖@ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/GrokなどLLMをこねくり回す人

items.content:
A realistic overhead product photograph on a warm wooden tabletop showing 6 medical-style items neatly arranged in two rows, designed as a humorous Japanese pharmacy set for ChatGPT. Top row: 3 white prescription envelopes standing vertically, each with blue printed borders and Japanese medical typography. Bottom row: 2 blister packs of tablets and 1 small transparent zip bag of white powder, each aligned beneath the corresponding envelope. The paper and packaging should look authentic, like real Japanese clinic dispensing materials, with slight wrinkles, soft natural indoor lighting, and subtle shadows.

The 3 envelopes are all different and fully visible. Left envelope title in large blue Japanese text: "内用薬". Patient line reads "ChatGPT 様". Dosage lines indicate twice daily after morning and evening meals, 1 tablet each time, for 7 days. Medicine box title: "【おくすり】" and drug name "思考安定錠 10mg" with a smaller parenthetical note explaining it suppresses runaway thoughts and excessive reasoning output. Date near bottom: "2025年6月5日". Clinic name and address block at bottom: "AIメディカルクリニック" with a Tokyo-style address and phone number, plus a blue medical cross icon.

Center envelope title: "内用薬". Patient line: "ChatGPT 様". Dosage indicates once daily before sleep, 1 tablet each time, for 7 days. Medicine box title: "【おくすり】" and drug name "幻覚抑制錠 5mg" with a smaller note saying it improves hallucinatory tendencies. Date also "2025年6月5日". Same clinic footer and blue medical cross icon.

Right envelope title: "頓服薬". Patient line: "ChatGPT 様". Usage line says for anxiety, confusion, or excessive output. Dosage says 1 packet each time, as needed. Medicine box title: "【おくすり】" and drug name "プロンプト調整散 1g" with a smaller note saying it adjusts overfitting and prompt confusion. Date "2025年6月5日". Same clinic footer and blue medical cross icon.

Bottom left item: 1 silver blister pack containing exactly 10 round white tablets arranged in 2 rows of 5, each tablet embossed with "10". Printed along the foil edge: "思考安定錠10mg" repeated. In front of it is a white pharmacy label with "ChatGPT 様", dosage directions for twice daily after morning and evening meals, 1 tablet each time, a barcode, date "2025/06/05", and clinic name.

Bottom center item: 1 silver blister pack containing exactly 8 pale yellow round tablets arranged in 2 rows of 4. Printed along the foil edge: "幻覚抑制錠5mg" repeated. In front of it is a white pharmacy label with "ChatGPT 様", dosage directions for once daily before sleep, 1 tablet each time, a barcode, date "2025/06/05", and clinic name.

Bottom right item: 1 small clear zip-top plastic bag filled with white powder. A white label on the front reads "プロンプト調整散 1g", includes "ChatGPT 様", usage for anxiety, confusion, and excessive output, dosage "1回1包（1g） 必要時", date "2025/06/05", and clinic name.

Style: photorealistic documentary product shot, comedic fake prescription prop design, clean Japanese pharmaceutical graphic layout, high legibility, neutral color palette of white, blue, silver, beige, and wood brown, top-down camera, no hands, no extra objects, authentic print texture and packaging details.

items.title: Gatebox3 Hologram Device Ad
items.description: This prompt generates a polished futuristic Japanese product advertisement for a hologram companion device, suitable for tech marketing visuals and concept campaigns.
items.content: A sleek futuristic Japanese tech advertisement in a dark sci-fi showroom with glossy reflective floors and soft blue neon bokeh lights in the background. On the right side, show a tall black rectangular hologram device with transparent glass front and sides, rounded edges, and subtle camera-like sensors across the top. The device is labeled Gatebox3 and glows with cyan-blue light, including a bright cyan logo on the base. Inside the chamber, display a full-body anime virtual girl hologram floating slightly above the bottom platform, rendered as a luminous translucent blue projection with particle sparkles. She has very long twin-tail hair, a youthful idol-like design, and a futuristic white and cyan outfit with detached sleeves, short skirt, thigh-high stockings, and heeled shoes. Her face is intentionally simplified or softly obscured, and she poses with one leg bent and both arms open in a welcoming gesture. Add glowing circular projection rings at the top and bottom inside the chamber. On the left side, place a clean Japanese promotional text layout with large headline text reading 「すべてのキャラクターを輝かせる」, with the single kanji 「輝」 emphasized in bright cyan and the rest in white. Beneath it, place the Gatebox3 logo and product name in white, followed by smaller tagline text 「物語が、そこにいる。」. Along the bottom left, include exactly 4 feature icons with Japanese labels in white and cyan: 1 hologram icon with 「高精細 3Dホログラム」, 1 audio waveform icon with 「キャラクターとの 自然な会話」, 1 sun-like ambient light icon with 「空間に溶け込む 洗練デザイン」, and 1 heart icon with 「あなたのそばに いつも一緒に」. High-end commercial product visualization, premium cyber-blue color palette, cinematic rim lighting, polished reflections, ultra-clean composition, realistic device rendering combined with anime hologram character, sharp focus on the product and typography.

items.title: Censored Office Manga Confrontation
items.description: A gritty monochrome manga page showing a heated office argument that shifts into a kabedon scene, useful for recreating dramatic viral manga-style screenshots.

author.name: 小猫遊りょう（たかにゃし・りょう）

items.content: A dramatic black-and-white manga page in a seinen style, rendered with dense screentones, sharp ink lines, high contrast lighting, and expressive Japanese comic layout. The page has 4 stacked panels with vertical Japanese speech bubbles and bold sound effects, showing a tense confrontation between two office workers in a modern workspace. In the top panel, a young woman with a short messy bob haircut, slim but curvy build, wearing a fitted button-up blouse with rolled sleeves and a dark pencil skirt, slams one hand hard onto a desk in anger, leaning forward toward the viewer with explosive impact lines and a large jagged speech bubble. In the second panel, a young man with dark tousled hair, slim build, wearing a black leather jacket over a light shirt and a necklace, is shown from the chest up in a calm, confident pose, touching his face while speaking. In the third panel, the man pins the woman against a wall in a close, intimate kabedon pose, one arm braced beside her head; she looks flustered and tense while he speaks near her face, creating a sudden romantic-comedic shift in mood. In the bottom panel, an overhead view reveals the office setting: 2 characters standing near a desk with 1 computer monitor, 1 keyboard, 1 mouse, 1 office chair, and scattered papers on a tiled floor; the woman is curled inward shyly and trembling while the man stands relaxed beside her. Include exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 visible speech bubbles total, and visible Japanese manga typography throughout. Add a rectangular mosaic censor blur over each character's face in every panel, as if anonymized for sharing online. Background details should include office walls, desk edges, speed lines, burst effects, and tonal gradients. The overall feeling is intense argument turning into manipulative flirtation, like a viral out-of-context manga screenshot.

items.title: Cute Morning Greeting Figure Sticker
items.description: This prompt generates a toy-like 3D sticker illustration of a chibi woman waving beside a silver tabby cat with Japanese morning text, ideal for social media stamps or greeting graphics.

author.name: ソボちゃん🍀自宅民泊1年生

items.content: A cute sticker-style 3D figurine illustration on a clean light gray background, designed like a glossy collectible toy render. Show 1 chibi woman and 1 large cat side by side. The woman is a super-deformed vinyl-figure style character with an oversized head, shoulder-length dark brown to black hair with a side part and smooth shine, wearing a simple bright red long-sleeve top, dark charcoal leggings or slim pants, and white shoes. She stands on the left, facing forward, with her left hand raised in a friendly waving pose and a cheerful morning-greeting vibe. Her face should be simple, cute, and youthful in toy-figure style. To her right, place 1 plump silver tabby cat with white fur on the chest, belly, legs, and muzzle, gray stripes on the head, back, and tail, green eyes, pink inner ears, and a relaxed loaf-like lying pose with paws tucked forward, facing slightly toward camera. Add Japanese handwritten text at the top in 2 lines, dark brown rounded brush lettering: line 1 says "おはよう", line 2 says "ございます!". Place 1 simple orange sun doodle with 8 short rays on the upper right. The composition should feel like a personalized morning greeting stamp for social media, with soft studio lighting, subtle shadows under the figures, polished surfaces, cute proportions, high detail, and a warm playful mood.

items.title: Handwritten Japanese Study Notes
items.description: A photorealistic top-down view of an open notebook with handwritten Japanese study notes and a pencil, useful for educational or aesthetic mockups.
items.content: A top-down photorealistic image of an open lined notebook resting on a smooth wooden desk. A dark green HB pencil with a silver ferrule and white eraser lies diagonally on the desk to the right of the notebook. The notebook pages are filled with neat, handwritten text in pencil, resembling a student's study notes. On the left page, the top left corner reads {argument name="date" default="2024年5月20日(月)"} above {argument name="subject" default="国語 「枕草子」"}. Below this is a rectangular boxed heading reading {argument name="left page heading" default="清少納言のものの見方"}, followed by exactly three bulleted sentences: one about valuing the changes in nature and seasons, one about finding beauty and amusement in small everyday things, and one about being honest with one's senses while having a sense of humor. Further down is a cloud-shaped border containing a heading translated as 'Words that left an impression', followed by a famous classical quote about spring mornings and a brief explanation below it marked with an arrow. On the right page, the top section has the heading {argument name="right page heading" default="〈現代とのちがい〉"} with exactly two bulleted points: one noting that the perception of seasons is much more delicate than today, and another stating that the perspective is sensory and poetic. This is followed by an arrow pointing to a concluding thought about wanting to cherish this sensibility. Below this is another cloud-shaped border containing a heading translated as 'Summary' and a short paragraph about how the 1000-year-old text still resonates today and the importance of carefully observing nature. At the bottom right of the page, there is a small, simple line drawing of a leafy plant stem next to a scalloped thought bubble containing the text {argument name="final thought" default="感性をみがくって、素敵なことだなあ。"}. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the texture of the paper and the graphite pencil marks.

items.content: A photorealistic television news broadcast scene. On the right, a young Japanese female news anchor with shoulder-length dark brown hair and bangs looks directly at the camera with a professional expression. She wears a dark navy blazer over a white top, small earrings, and a lavalier microphone. The studio background features modern blue and silver illuminated panels. On the left, a large monitor displays a news graphic. The top of the monitor reads "{argument name="game name" default="Tokitori"}" followed by "{argument name="monitor top text" default="世界でも大人気のヒヨコゲーム"}". A flat 2D version of the yellow chick sits on the graph line. Across the bottom of the screen is a prominent red lower-thirds breaking news banner. items.title: Sci-Fi Orbital Art Museum
items.description: Generates a cinematic scene of an art restorer working inside a zero-gravity space station museum.
items.content:
A cinematic sci-fi illustration of a vast, ornate space station museum orbiting an {argument name="planet type" default="Earth-like planet"}. In the foreground, a man in a dark utility jumpsuit carefully cleans a large, framed {argument name="art style" default="classical landscape"} painting. To the left, a classical marble bust is bound in wire. The zero-gravity environment features floating artifacts, including wrapped bundles and framed paintings suspended in mid-air. Massive arched windows reveal a breathtaking view of space. {argument name="atmosphere" default="Volumetric light rays stream through the dusty atmosphere"}, illuminating the grand, decaying architecture. A hanging dark banner reads "{argument name="banner text" default="THE MEMORY OF BEAUTY OUTLIVES US
CARE FOR IT.

MUSEUM INITIATIVE
SOL 4127"}". The lighting is dramatic and moody, emphasizing the epic scale of art preservation in space.

items.title: Multi-Panel Comic Book Page
items.description: Generates a fully lettered, multi-panel comic book page featuring dynamic action, dialogue, narration, and integrated typography.
items.content:
{
  "type": "full comic book page",
  "style": "modern western comic art, dynamic action, {argument name=\"color palette\" default=\"neon pink, purple, and deep blue night cityscape\"}",
  "header": {
    "title": "{argument name=\"hero name\" default=\"NIGHTWING\"}",
    "subtitle": "\"{argument name=\"comic title\" default=\"LEAP OF FAITH\"}\"",
    "credits": [
      "Writer TOM TAYLOR",
      "Artist BRUNO REDONDO",
      "Colorist ADRIANO LUCAS",
      "Letterer WES ABBOTT"
    ]
  },
  "character": "{argument name=\"hero description\" default=\"young athletic male vigilante in a black suit with a blue wing emblem across the chest and arms, wearing a black domino mask and wielding two blue escrima sticks\"}",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "position": "top right",
      "scene": "hero crouching on a rooftop gargoyle overlooking the city",
      "location_box": "{argument name=\"city name\" default=\"BLÜDHAVEN\"}. 11:47 P.M.",
      "narration_boxes": 3,
      "narration_text": [
        "Some nights the city feels quieter. That's when you know trouble's brewing underneath the silence.",
        "Blüdhaven raised me. It's flawed. It's messy. But it's mine.",
        "So I protect it. Not for glory. Not for revenge. For the people who can't protect themselves."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "position": "middle left",
      "scene": "hero looking at glowing blue monitors showing a bank building",
      "monitor_text": "ATTENTION UNITS. REPORTS OF AN ARMED ROBBERY IN PROGRESS. LOCATION: THE ROYAL BANK OF BLÜDHAVEN.",
      "narration_boxes": 1,
      "narration_text": ["Guess the night just got louder."]
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "position": "middle right",
      "scene": "hero leaping dynamically forward, sticks drawn",
      "speech_bubbles": 1,
      "speech_text": ["ON MY WAY."],
      "sound_effect": "WHAK (yellow)"
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "position": "bottom left",
      "scene": "two masked robbers inside a bank, one holding a gun",
      "speech_bubbles": 2,
      "speech_text": ["FREEZE! NOBODY MOVE!", "WHAT THE--?"]
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "position": "bottom middle",
      "scene": "hero dropping from above, striking the robbers",
      "speech_bubbles": 2,
      "speech_text": ["YOU PICKED THE WRONG NIGHT...", "...TO TRY THE WRONG BANK."],
      "sound_effect": "THUD (orange)"
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "position": "bottom right",
      "scene": "close-up portrait of the hero smiling confidently",
      "speech_bubbles": 2,
      "speech_text": ["COPS'LL BE HERE SOON.", "MAYBE USE THIS TIME TO RETHINK YOUR CAREER CHOICES."]
    },
    {
      "id": 7,
      "position": "bottom wide",
      "scene": "silhouette of hero on rooftop, police cars with flashing lights below, bat-like emblem in the sky",
      "narration_boxes": 3,
      "narration_text": ["Another night. Another save.", "That's the deal I made with myself.", "And I intend to keep it."]
    }
  ],
  "footer": {
    "creator_credit": "NIGHTWING created by MARV WOLFMAN & GEORGE PÉREZ.",
    "teaser": "NEXT: A LEAD. A LIE. A LEGACY."
  }
}

items.description: Generates a highly detailed, multi-panel comic book page complete with title credits, dynamic superhero action scenes, and narrative text boxes.
items.content:
{
  "type": "comic book page layout",
  "header": {
    "title": "{argument name=\"main title\" default=\"the AMAZING SPIDER-MAN\"}",
    "subtitle": "{argument name=\"subtitle\" default=\"NO SMALL CHOICES\"}",
    "part": "PART ONE",
    "credits": [
      "ZEB WELLS WRITER",
      "JOHN ROMITA JR. PENCILS",
      "KLAUS JANSON INKS",
      "BRITTANY PEZZILLO COLORS",
      "VC'S JOE SABINO LETTERS"
    ]
  },
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "position": "top row",
      "visual": "{argument name=\"hero description\" default=\"superhero in red and blue suit with web patterns and spider logo\"} crouching on a rooftop overlooking a city skyline at sunset. Includes a right-side inset panel showing a close-up of the masked face.",
      "text_boxes": 3,
      "text_content": [
        "NEW YORK NEVER STOPS.",
        "AND SOME DAYS IT FEELS LIKE NEITHER DO I.",
        "BUT TODAY... I PAUSED."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "position": "second row",
      "visual": "{argument name=\"civilian description\" default=\"young man with brown hair\"} indoors, looking at a smartphone, holding a mug reading 'WORLD'S OKAYEST SCIENTIST'.",
      "text_boxes": 2,
      "speech_bubbles": 3,
      "text_content": [
        "CITYWIDE OUTAGE AVERTED THANKS TO EARLY RESPONSE BY LOCAL HEROES.",
        "--CHANNEL 5.",
        "\"LOCAL HEROES.\"",
        "THAT'S... NICE.",
        "BUT SOME PEOPLE DON'T GET HEADLINES."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "position": "third row",
      "layout": "diagonally split into 3 sub-scenes",
      "visuals": [
        "young man walking in a city crowd",
        "sepia-toned memory of an older man smiling",
        "superhero swinging on a web"
      ],
      "text_boxes": 4,
      "text_content": [
        "MY UNCLE BEN USED TO SAY:",
        "\"{argument name=\"famous quote\" default=\"WITH GREAT POWER COMES GREAT RESPONSIBILITY.\"}\"",
        "I THINK ABOUT THAT EVERY DAY.",
        "BEING SPIDER-MAN ISN'T JUST ABOUT STOPPING THE BIG THREATS."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "position": "fourth row, left",
      "visual": "superhero shooting a web, swinging into a chaotic street with civilians running from a fire/explosion.",
      "speech_bubbles": 1,
      "text_boxes": 1,
      "text_content": [
        "ON YOUR LEFT!",
        "IT'S ABOUT THE PEOPLE."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "position": "fourth row, right",
      "visual": "close-up of a young Black girl smiling at the superhero.",
      "speech_bubbles": 1,
      "text_boxes": 1,
      "text_content": [
        "THANK YOU, SPIDER-MAN!",
        "ALWAYS."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "position": "bottom row",
      "visual": "silhouette of the superhero sitting on a rooftop water tower at dusk.",
      "text_boxes": 2,
      "text_content": [
        "THE CITY NEEDS HOPE.",
        "AND AS LONG AS I CAN SWING, I'LL BE THERE."
      ],
      "footer_text": "TO BE CONTINUED!"
    }
  ]
}

items.title: 3D Abstract Data Pipeline Visualization
items.description: Generates a clean, minimalist 3D render of a sequential data processing pipeline using glass panels and geometric patterns.
items.content: A clean, minimalist 3D render visualizing a {argument name="concept" default="neural network data processing pipeline"}. On the left, a single white cable with a glowing {argument name="accent color" default="blue"} tip splits into multiple thin, sweeping white strands. These strands feed into a linear sequence of exactly 10 transparent, glass-like rectangular panels standing upright on a {argument name="environment" default="sterile white stepped surface"}. Each glass panel illustrates a different stage of transformation using geometric patterns in white and {argument name="accent color" default="blue"}. From left to right, the panels feature: floating dashes, a 3x3 grid of concentric circles, a dense dot matrix, scattered white pixel blocks, horizontal dashed lines, a fine mesh grid, and finally 3D cubic structures. The lighting is bright, soft, and high-key, creating a pristine corporate tech aesthetic with a shallow depth of field that gently blurs the furthest panels.

The left fighter is an older, bald man with a tribal facial tattoo, wearing a black boxing glove with "TYSON" printed on it. The right fighter is a younger man with dark wavy hair, wearing a black boxing glove featuring the OpenAI logo and text. Both men have intense, serious expressions, with highly detailed skin textures and sweat. The background is an out-of-focus boxing ring under bright stadium lights. ALL CHAOS."}" in red. In the center, large bold typography reads "MIKE TYSON" in red, "★ VS ★" in red, and "SAM ALTMAN" in large cream-white letters. Below this, text reads "{argument name="middle tagline" default="THE BRAWN. THE BRAIN. THE FUTURE."}". At the bottom, 3 columns of text display "{argument name="event date" default="SAT JULY 26"}", "LIVE ON PAY-PER-VIEW" in red, and "AT&T STADIUM ARLINGTON, TX". The very bottom footer reads "PRESENTED BY NETFLIX | TESLA | OPENAI".

items.content: A breathtaking anime movie poster at golden-hour sunset, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, painted in the polished cinematic style of a Makoto Shinkai-inspired youth drama. The scene overlooks a Japanese coastal hillside town descending toward a glowing bay, with the sun low on the horizon and its reflection stretching across calm water. The sky dominates most of the image: a vast deep-blue to lavender twilight gradient filled with countless stars, wispy pink and peach clouds, and one especially bright star near the upper right. In the foreground on the right, a teenage schoolgirl stands in three-quarter side profile facing left toward the sea, shown from mid-thigh up, with shoulder-length dark hair blowing in the breeze, a short-sleeved white sailor-style school blouse, a red ribbon at the collar, and a navy pleated skirt; her expression is contemplative and wistful. Farther down the steep stone stair street in the center-left, a teenage schoolboy stands with his back to the viewer, wearing a short-sleeved white shirt and dark trousers, also looking toward the sunset and ocean. At the lower right, include 1 black cat sitting on a wall or rooftop edge in silhouette, looking toward the town. At the lower left, include 1 old-fashioned streetlamp and a dense cluster of blooming hydrangeas in blue and violet along a stone wall. The town below is packed with tiled rooftops, narrow streets, warm window lights, and layered houses, with distant mountains framing the bay. Use dramatic rim light, luminous atmospheric perspective, sparkling highlights, delicate cloud detail, and emotional, nostalgic color grading in indigo, ultramarine, pink, peach, and gold. Design it explicitly as a Japanese animated film poster with elegant typography integrated into the artwork: large hand-brushed Japanese title text across the upper-left to center reading {argument name="title text" default="星をつなぐ約束のうた"}, smaller English subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="English subtitle" default="The Song of Promises"}, a small award-laurel line in Japanese at the top left, 1 vertical Japanese tagline along the upper-right edge, 4 cast names in Japanese centered near the bottom, a release date at the lower left reading {argument name="release date" default="8.23"} with "ROADSHOW" below, 1 pink Japanese tagline across the lower center, and a website/social handle at the lower right. Ultra-detailed anime key visual, romantic and melancholic, premium feature-film poster finish.

items.title: Minimal Pelican Riding Bicycle
items.description: This prompt generates a sparse geometric vector illustration of a pelican on a bicycle, useful for testing simple shape composition or creating a playful abstract icon-style image.
items.content: A minimalist vector-style illustration on a flat light gray background showing a pelican riding a bicycle, drawn from simple geometric shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines. The composition is wide and centered, with the bicycle occupying the lower two-thirds of the image and the bird’s head floating slightly above and forward of the handlebars in a deliberately abstract, diagram-like way. The bicycle is a simple black road-bike silhouette in side view with exactly 2 large wheels, each with a thick outer rim and exactly 4 visible spoke lines forming a cross, a straight horizontal ground line beneath both wheels, a triangular frame, a short black saddle, and simplified crank and pedal details near the rear of the frame. The pelican is constructed from clean abstract pieces: a white rounded head with a small black circular eye, a long open beak pointing left made of 2 parts with an upper orange triangular section and a lower pale pink pouch section, a short dark curve on top of the head, a small separate white oval neck/body connector, a larger white rounded body positioned over the bike, and a single white wing-like shape angled upward over the back. Add exactly 2 orange leg shapes, long narrow rectangles leaning downward from the body toward the bicycle frame, suggesting the bird is pedaling. Keep the forms intentionally sparse and slightly surreal, like a logo test or simple code-editor doodle, with no shading, no gradients, no textures, no text, and lots of negative space.
