items.title: Cute Four-Panel Cat Jealousy Comic
items.description: This prompt generates a warm, hand-drawn four-panel cat comic ideal for social posts, manga-style humor, or cozy pet illustrations.
items.content: A cute hand-drawn four-panel comic in a soft, warm, slice-of-life style on a light cream background with thick black panel borders and slightly textured paper grain. Use simple rounded cartoon cat anatomy, expressive faces, clean black outlines, muted natural colors, and a gentle manga-like presentation. In the top-left panel, show 2 cats: a brown tabby cat with dark stripes and white muzzle sitting with eyes closed, looking pleased, while a mostly white cat with dark brown patches on the head stands beside it and affectionately licks the tabby's cheek; add 2 small black musical notes above them to suggest happy grooming. In the top-right panel, show the white-and-brown patched cat in the foreground looking toward a small calico kitten standing to the right; include a speech bubble containing the Japanese text "めい" above the kitten. In the bottom-left panel, show 3 cats together: the brown tabby on the left with a surprised or blank expression, the white patched cat on the right looking cheerful, and the small calico kitten centered in front between them, looking up. In the bottom-right panel, show a close-up of the brown tabby cat alone, facing forward with narrowed yellow-green eyes and an angry, jealous expression; add 2 short emphasis lines near the face and 1 small puff-shaped anger symbol to the right. Keep the tone cozy and comedic, with the visual joke that the tabby was happy being groomed until the new kitten appears. Use flat colors, minimal shading, and a charming Japanese webcomic feel.

items.title: 108 Chibi Fantasy Mandala
items.description: A highly detailed wide fantasy poster showing exactly 108 unique chibi mythical creatures arranged in concentric mandala rings, ideal for decorative key art or showcase illustrations.
items.content:
A gigantic ultra-detailed fantasy mandala poster featuring exactly 108 distinct chibi characters arranged in concentric circular rings around a radiant central emblem. The composition is perfectly symmetrical overall and fills a wide horizontal canvas like an ornate collectible mural. In the center, place a glowing golden core with 9 chibi animal-fantasy mascots clustered in a circular medallion, each with oversized heads, tiny bodies, expressive eyes, and luxurious costume details. Surround this center with multiple evenly spaced concentric rings containing the remaining 99 characters, each character occupying its own wedge-like segment and designed as a unique elemental or mythical variation. items.title: Multiplication Domino Classroom Activity
items.description: A realistic classroom photo showing children using a colorful multiplication domino board game, ideal for educational materials, school promotions, or math activity visuals.
items.content: A realistic documentary-style photo of an elementary school classroom during a math activity, with about 10 children seated around grouped wooden desks, wearing green and blue school uniforms, actively playing a colorful multiplication domino game. The camera is at child eye level, slightly angled downward toward the main table in the foreground. Center the scene on one square educational board game labeled in Portuguese, with the title "DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇÃO" on the lower edge and "TREINANDO AS TABUADAS" in the center, surrounded by a border of brightly colored domino-style multiplication tiles. Show 4 children clearly engaged around this main board: one child placing a yellow tile onto the board, one child holding a stack of multicolored tiles, one child watching from the left, and one child in a blue sleeve at the bottom edge arranging pieces. Include 2 shallow wooden boxes labeled "JOGO DE DOMINÓ," one near the center-left and one at the bottom-right, each containing colorful rectangular domino pieces. Scatter school materials naturally on the desks: 3 pencils, 2 worksheets, 1 water bottle, pencil cases, notebooks, and extra game tiles. In the background, show the rest of the classroom softly out of focus with additional students at desks, a bookshelf, a corkboard filled with children’s drawings, and a large multiplication chart poster on the left wall reading "TABUADA DE MULTIPLICAÇÃO." Bright natural daylight enters from tall windows on the right, giving the room a warm, lively, authentic school atmosphere. The educational board and tiles should use vivid classroom colors like yellow, blue, pink, green, and orange. Faces should be unobtrusive or de-emphasized, with the focus on hands-on learning, collaboration, and the multiplication domino activity. Vertical composition, highly realistic photography, candid classroom moment, sharp foreground details, soft depth of field in the background.

items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic illustrated tourism poster of Malta with bold headline text, a coastal road, classic car, harbor boats, and sunlit historic architecture for travel branding or wall art.
items.content: A vintage travel poster illustration for {argument name="destination" default="Malta"}, designed like a mid-century Mediterranean tourism advertisement with elegant painterly realism and slightly textured printed-poster grain. At the top center, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"} in oversized cream serif capitals, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} directly below in smaller dark navy sans-serif capitals. Show a sunlit coastal road curving along a stone waterfront in Valletta, viewed from slightly above and behind a classic white 1960s sedan driving away from the viewer in the lower left foreground; the rear license plate reads {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"}. Across the harbor, depict warm honey-colored limestone buildings climbing the hillside, including 1 large domed church, 1 tall narrow church spire, rows of historic townhouses with several colorful enclosed wooden balconies, and distant city walls stretching across the opposite shoreline. In the bay, include exactly 3 traditional Maltese fishing boats in vivid blue, yellow, red, and green, plus 2 tiny white sailboats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls flying across a brilliant turquoise-blue sky with soft white clouds. Frame the whole composition with dark leafy trees and abundant bright magenta bougainvillea blossoms arching in from the top and right edges, with more flowers in the lower right corner, creating a lush border around the scene. Include a palm tree among the waterfront buildings and a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. Use warm golden sunlight, saturated coastal colors, romantic vacation-poster composition, clean readable typography, and a nostalgic, idealized Mediterranean atmosphere.

items.title: Cat to Human Portrait Transformation
items.description: This prompt converts a cat reference photo into a photorealistic human version while preserving the original pose, composition, and setting for playful pet-to-person portraits.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, turn the cat into a realistic human portrait while keeping the same lounging pose, camera angle, framing, and the same plush turquoise chair background. Preserve the cat’s orange-and-white color pattern as inspiration for the human look: make the person a fair-skinned young woman with warm ginger hair and a soft, calm expression. Dress her in cozy off-white loungewear: 1 loose knit V-neck sweater and 1 pair of cream drawstring pants, seated naturally in the chair with relaxed body language. Make it photorealistic, soft natural indoor lighting, editorial lifestyle photo quality.

items.title: Dark Space Emperor Movie Poster
items.description: A cinematic sci-fi poster showing an armored alien ruler on a starship bridge, ideal for blockbuster space-opera key art and film promotion.
items.content: A dark epic sci-fi movie poster for {argument name="film title" default="EMPIRE OF THE VOID"}, in a highly cinematic photorealistic space-opera style. Centered composition with a tall alien emperor standing behind a massive circular command table, viewed from slightly below to make the figure feel imposing and godlike. The emperor wears ornate black and gunmetal biomechanical armor with sharp layered pauldrons, engraved metallic filigree, a long dark cloak, and a regal elongated helmet-crown. The face is mostly obscured in shadow, giving a mysterious, intimidating presence. One large clawed hand rests prominently on the glowing table in the foreground. The command table displays a luminous spiral galaxy hologram in blue-violet tones, with concentric interface rings and subtle cosmic light. The setting is the bridge of a colossal starship or throne room, with two curved panoramic windows framing outer space. Outside the windows are 8 visible spacecraft total: 4 on the left side and 4 on the right side, including several large battleships and smaller escort vessels. A huge planet fills much of the left background, while the right background shows a purple-blue nebula and starfield. Two secondary alien officers are seated in the mid-background, 1 on the left and 1 on the right, each at glowing futuristic control consoles. The color palette is deep black, steel gray, indigo, violet, and cold blue, with dramatic rim lighting, glossy metallic reflections, and dense atmospheric shadows. The layout should feel like a premium blockbuster poster: a centered top tagline in small uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline" default="INTELLIGENCE. DOMINION. DESTINY. THE GALAXY BOWS TO NONE."}, the giant title near the bottom in elegant spaced serif capitals with the words {argument name="main title" default="EMPIRE"} on the first line and {argument name="subtitle" default="OF THE VOID"} below it, with the letter O stylized as a glowing black-hole eclipse. Beneath that, add a glowing imperial trident-like emblem centered above the release line {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}. At the very bottom, include a dense strip of tiny production credits in authentic movie-poster typography. Ultra-detailed, symmetrical, ominous, imperial, galactic conquest mood, vertical one-sheet poster, premium VFX key art, sharp focus, high contrast, dramatic sci-fi lighting.

items.title: Surreal Archer With Birds and Animals
items.description: This prompt generates a dreamlike cinematic fashion-style portrait of a masked archer surrounded by birds and animals, useful for surreal editorial or fine-art image creation.
items.content: A surreal cinematic outdoor portrait of a masked archer standing in a dry field under a deep clear blue sky, framed from about the knees up in a wide horizontal composition. The central figure is a woman-like person in a vintage prairie-style dress and matching headscarf, aiming a simple wooden longbow toward the left side of the frame with an arrow drawn back to the cheek. Her face is fully obscured by a soft rectangular blur or blocky censorship patch, creating an uncanny anonymous effect. The dress is sage green with long puffed sleeves, a gathered waist tied with a sash, and a tiny repeating red-and-white floral dot pattern. A red cloth or scarf is wrapped around the lower face and neck beneath the green head covering. Surrounding her are 12 animals total: 8 white birds flying across the sky at different distances, 2 larger white birds standing on the ground at the right side, 1 deer head entering from the lower left foreground, and 1 sheep or goat head entering from the lower right foreground. Add 1 red-headed crane-like bird at the far right edge, visible in profile. The image should feel dreamlike, strange, and symbolic rather than realistic, with crisp midday sunlight, rich saturated colors, soft film grain, and a slightly vintage editorial-photography look. Use low-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal lines from the bow and arrow, and layered animal placement to create tension and motion. Dry grasses appear at the bottom edge, but the background is mostly open sky. Highly detailed fabric folds, natural bird wing positions, and a balanced surreal composition.

items.title: Historical Invention Timeline Grid
items.description: This prompt generates a parchment-styled educational poster showing a grid of labeled invention dioramas across history, ideal for timeline infographics and world-changing technology comparisons.
items.content:
Create a square infographic-style illustration showing a {argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} invention timeline grid rendered as a collection of miniature isometric dioramas on aged parchment tiles. The image should look like a curated historical poster that spans from {argument name="starting year" default="1000 BC"} to {argument name="ending year" default="2026"}, with one invention per tile and no repeats. Show the visible portion as a 5 by 5 section of the larger grid, for a total of 25 labeled tiles, arranged in neat rows and columns with thin dark borders. Every tile contains a unique world-changing invention depicted as a small handcrafted diorama with era-appropriate materials, colors, and background details. Use a warm antiquarian palette for ancient and medieval inventions, sepia technical-document tones for early modern inventions, and cooler neon-blue futuristic lighting for modern digital and biotech inventions. Surround the grid with an old-map border and subtle historical cartography textures, blending into faint modern network graphics near the bottom right.

Label each visible tile with a small beige caption tag in bold black text. Include exactly these 25 visible inventions in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1) {argument name="first tile label" default="1000 BC"} tile showing an iron plow and simple hand tools in a farm field, captioned "Iron Plow & Tools"; 2) "Concept of Zero" shown as a parchment-like tile with a carved zero symbol and a blue hourglass; 3) "Water Clock" shown as a wooden water-timing device; 4) "Catapult" shown as a wooden siege engine; 5) "Antikythera Mechanism" shown as an intricate bronze gear device in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete" shown as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheelbarrow" shown as a simple wooden one-wheel cart; 8) "Windmill" shown as a traditional mill on grassy ground; 9) "Gunpowder" shown as a barrel and a mound of black powder with smoke; 10) "Printing Press" shown as a wooden press framed by classical columns; 11) "Mechanical Clock" shown as an ornate standing clock; 12) "Telescope" shown as an early brass telescope on a tripod with sketch-like scientific notes; 13) "Steam Engine" shown on a blue blueprint-style tile with an early locomotive engine; 14) "Electric Battery" shown on a blueprint-like tile with two cylindrical battery cells and wiring; 15) "Telegraph" shown as a Morse telegraph key on technical paper; 16) "Light Bulb" shown glowing warmly on a neutral pedestal; 17) "Automobile" shown as an early red motorcar on a workshop-plan background; 18) "Airplane" shown as a commercial jet aircraft in miniature; 19) "Transistor" shown as a black microchip on a luminous circuit-board tile; 20) "Personal Computer" shown as a beige desktop computer with CRT monitor and keyboard; 21) "World Wide Web" shown as a glowing blue globe over digital circuitry; 22) "Smartphone" shown as a sleek modern phone on a neon-tech background; 23) "CRISPR-Cas9" shown as a DNA double helix in a biotech-blue display tile; 24) "Reusable Rocket" shown as several upright rockets launching with exhaust clouds; 25) "AI (LLMs)" shown as glowing large letters AI in a holographic tech cube; 26) "Brain-Computer Interface" shown as a glowing brain hologram on a blue platform; 27) "Advanced Neural Interface (Implant)" shown as a transparent human head profile with a glowing brain implant, with a small top label reading "2026".

Keep the composition highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense, with each tile readable at a glance. Use slight isometric perspective, crisp linework, painterly shading, and polished editorial illustration quality. The overall feeling should combine museum poster, educational timeline, and imaginative historical-tech diorama art.

items.title: Vintage Confidential Case File
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic top-down noir-style confidential dossier page, ideal for storytelling, detective worldbuilding, and cinematic prop imagery.
items.content: A top-down cinematic still life of a vintage classified investigation dossier on a dark wooden desk, centered and filling most of the frame. Show a stack of 3 worn manila folders with aged beige paper, frayed corners, subtle stains, and realistic paper texture. The top folder is the main focus and is clipped at the upper left with 1 oversized silver paper clip. Across the top center, typewritten in bold black monospaced letters, the headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="CONFIDENTIAL – CASE FILES"}, with a thin horizontal rule beneath it. Add 2 red rubber-stamp marks: one near the top right that says "CONFIDENTIAL" at a slight angle, and one boxed stamp at the bottom right that says "HANDLING INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT COPY – DO NOT DISTRIBUTE". On the right edge of the folder stack, show 1 tabbed side label reading "CASE FILE NO." with a thick black redaction bar below it. The page is formatted like an old typewritten government document with crisp black ink, slightly uneven typewriter alignment, and many thick black redaction bars obscuring key details. Include 5 numbered sections exactly: "1. SUBJECT INFORMATION", "2. CASE SUMMARY", "3. DETAILS", "4. ASSOCIATES / CONTACTS", and "5. REMARKS". In the header area, include the fields "CASE FILE NO.:" with a black redaction bar, "DATE OPENED:" with {argument name="date opened" default="March 14, 20___"}, "PREPARED BY:" with a black redaction bar, "DEPARTMENT:" with {argument name="department" default="Internal Investigations Unit"}, and "CLASSIFICATION:" with {argument name="classification" default="CONFIDENTIAL"}. In section 1, include 6 fields: "NAME:", "ALIASES:", "DATE OF BIRTH:", "PLACE OF BIRTH:", "LAST KNOWN ADDRESS:", and "OCCUPATION:", each followed by black redaction bars of varying lengths. In section 2, add a short paragraph of typewritten case-summary text with 5 separate black redaction bars embedded in the sentence flow. In section 3, add a second paragraph of details text with 4 separate black redaction bars embedded in the paragraph. items.title: Tiny Planet Aerial of Canakkale
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic 360-degree tiny-planet drone view of Canakkale's waterfront landmarks, ideal for travel imagery and city-poster visuals.
items.content: A dramatic ultra-wide aerial tiny-planet photograph of {argument name="city name" default="Canakkale"}, Turkey, rendered as a full 360-degree stereographic projection so the city and waterfront form a compact spherical world surrounded by a swirling ring of blue sky and white clouds. The viewpoint is high above the shoreline in bright daytime with crisp summer light, realistic colors, and strong photographic detail. Place the large hillside sign reading {argument name="landmark sign text" default="Canakkale"} prominently across the center of the miniature planet. On the left-upper side of the sphere, show a tall pale stone clock tower with a small red Turkish flag at the top, surrounded by dense urban blocks with red-tiled roofs and mid-rise buildings. On the right side, include a vivid blue harbor with 2 white passenger ferries docked along the waterfront and a long curving coastline extending into the distance. In the lower-right quadrant, feature the monumental dark wooden Trojan horse statue on a circular plaza. In the lower-left quadrant, include the large rectangular concrete memorial structure set within green parkland. Cover the planet with winding pedestrian paths, lawns, trees, and landscaped gardens, with city streets and waterfront promenades visible around the edges. Use a highly realistic drone-photo look, deep depth of field, sharp textures, slightly exaggerated fisheye distortion from the tiny-planet projection, and a majestic travel-poster composition emphasizing the contrast between the green park, historic landmarks, and sparkling sea.

items.title: Uncanny Full-Body Alien Portrait
items.description: A dark photorealistic studio image of a gaunt humanoid alien, suited for creature concept art, sci-fi key art, or unsettling model capability demos.
items.content: A hyper-realistic full-body studio portrait of a disturbing humanoid alien standing alone against a dark, smoky blue-black backdrop. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, a narrow waist, long thin fingers, and oversized bare feet planted on a dim studio floor. Its skin is smooth but leathery and subtly wrinkled, colored deep charcoal blue with cold gray highlights, showing sharply defined ribs, sternum, collarbones, tendons, and stringy musculature across the chest, abdomen, shoulders, and neck. The torso is hairless and gaunt, with an eerie anatomical realism that feels biologically plausible but unsettling. The head is bald, enlarged, and slightly bulbous with a classic extraterrestrial silhouette, attached to an unnaturally long neck; keep the face obscure, unreadable, and deeply uncanny rather than expressive. Pose the alien front-facing with a slight three-quarter angle, arms hanging loosely at its sides, posture upright but subtly predatory, centered in frame from head to feet. Use low-key cinematic lighting with a faint cool rim light and soft overhead illumination that sculpts every crease and contour while keeping the overall scene dark, moody, and oppressive. Desaturated palette, ultra-detailed skin texture, photoreal creature design, sharp focus, high contrast, ominous atmosphere, no clothing, no props, no environment details beyond the shadowy studio background.

items.title: Photoreal Alien in Dark Ravine
items.description: This prompt generates a disturbing full-body sci-fi horror portrait of a realistic humanoid alien in a bleak rocky canyon, ideal for cinematic concept art and creature design.
items.content: A full-body cinematic portrait of a deeply unsettling humanoid alien standing alone in a dark rocky ravine, centered in the frame and facing forward in a neutral upright pose with both arms hanging low at its sides. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, narrow shoulders, a sunken torso, visible rib-like structures, taut sinewy anatomy, long forearms, oversized hands with long thin fingers, and long digitigrade-looking feet planted on wet black ground. Its skin is hairless, slick, pale gray-beige with brownish fleshy undertones, semi-organic and biomechanical in appearance, with glossy damp highlights, leathery textures, stretched membranes, tendons, grooves, and subtle vein-like striations. The neck and upper chest are fused into a disturbing organic structure, with tendril-like folds and open channels running from the clavicle area upward into the head. The head is broad and mushroom- or hammer-shaped with a ridged crown and flared side lobes, giving a nonhuman silhouette; the face should feel unreadable and alien rather than cute or familiar. Place the figure in a narrow canyon of dark eroded stone, with 2 large foreground rock masses framing the subject on the left and right, and a misty cliff wall receding behind it. Use cold desaturated lighting, soft fog, damp surfaces, shallow atmospheric haze, and a grim monochrome palette of charcoal, slate, ash gray, and muted flesh tones. The mood should be uncanny, realistic, oppressive, and biologically plausible, like a high-end sci-fi horror still. Ultra-detailed photorealism, sharp texture on the creature, subtle depth of field, dramatic natural backlight from above, no clothing, no tools, no background creatures, no gore, no text.

items.title: Celestial Anime Fantasy Movie Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a fully typeset Japanese fantasy anime film poster featuring a silver-haired moon-themed heroine, ideal for cinematic key art and promotional poster concepts.
items.content:
A dramatic Japanese fantasy anime movie poster, vertical one-sheet composition, centered on a beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing silver-white hair, glowing golden eyes, and a calm inviting smile, reaching one hand toward the viewer. She wears a black-and-white celestial dress with a fitted corset bodice, white chest panel, black ribbon lacing at the front, detached black sleeves with soft white ruffles, a black belt at the waist, layered skirt panels decorated with exactly 3 gold crescent moon ornaments, and a black choker with a gold crescent moon pendant. She also has exactly 1 gold crescent moon hair clip near her bangs. Behind her is a luminous night sky filled with stars, nebula-like clouds, and a huge eclipsed moon halo directly above her head, plus exactly 3 floating crescent-ring light effects around the left side of her hair. The background shows an ornate fantasy city with towering gothic palace architecture, spires, observatory-like structures, and glowing windows, all bathed in cool moonlight. Use a rich palette of deep indigo, violet, midnight blue, silver, and gold, with sparkles, magical particles, rim lighting, glossy highlights, and a slightly dense, painterly modern-anime poster finish.

Design it as a fully typeset Japanese film poster with elegant serif display typography in gold and white. At the very top, place a centered headline in Japanese: {argument name="headline text" default="夜が欠けるたび、忘れていた真実が目を覚ます。"}. On the right side, set a large vertical Japanese tagline in gold: {argument name="right-side tagline" default="最後の月光が消える前に、世界の記憶をつなぎ直せ。"}. On the left side, arrange 4 stacked blocks of smaller Japanese body copy separated by decorative divider lines and crescent motifs. Add a circular gold burst badge on the lower right with Japanese promotional text inside. Across the lower middle, place the large glowing Japanese title in ornate gold-white lettering: {argument name="movie title" default="月蝕のリグレット"}. Beneath the title, add a smaller centered Japanese subtitle line. Below that, place a horizontal feature line with exactly 3 gold-separated phrases in Japanese: "記憶", "月光", "観測魔法". At the very bottom, add 3 short Japanese teaser lines spread left, center, and right, and a large glowing release line centered under them: {argument name="release text" default="近日公開"}. The overall feeling is epic, melancholic, magical, celestial, romantic, and nostalgic, like a high-budget fantasy anime film poster.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Cliffside Outpost
items.description: This prompt generates a moody dark-fantasy landscape painting of a ruined encampment on a cliff, ideal for worldbuilding art, RPG settings, or ominous book-cover style scenes.
items.content: A dark fantasy matte painting of a bleak hilltop encampment overlooking a vast cursed wasteland at dusk. In the left foreground, a ragged hanging banner reads "The Pale Lodge Outpost" in large black hand-painted letters, attached to wooden poles and weathered by wind. Beside it stands a tall carved totem post topped with a black raven and draped with bones, skulls, and tattered ornaments. The camp itself contains 4 visible canvas tents: 2 large central tents, 1 medium tent on the left, and 1 smaller tent on the right, all in dirty beige fabric with black occult sigils painted on them, held by ropes, spikes, and crooked poles. Around the tents are 5 hooded human figures in dark robes, standing still like sentries or cultists. Near the center-left is a small campfire casting a faint orange glow. In the right foreground sit 2 brass-and-iron astronomical or ritual instruments on stone pedestals, resembling armillary spheres or astrolabes. The ground is uneven black rock at the edge of a cliff, with scattered stakes, lanterns, banners, and ritual posts. Beyond the outpost stretches a desolate valley of ash-colored plains, winding pale waterways, jagged rock spires, and distant mountain silhouettes. On the horizon, slightly right of center, a sinister dark castle rises from a lone hill. The sky is filled with enormous turbulent storm clouds, with 3 flying creatures or birds silhouetted in the distance and a break in the clouds casting cold, sickly light across the landscape. Use a grim, painterly, highly detailed style with muted sepia, charcoal, umber, and gray tones, dramatic atmospheric perspective, cinematic composition, and the mood of a foreboding fantasy frontier outpost at the edge of a dead world.

items.title: Epic Senna vs Prost Gladiator Poster
items.description: A dramatic vintage-style motorsport poster depicting Senna and Prost as mythic gladiator rivals, ideal for recreating cinematic tribute art or high-impact F1 legend posters.
items.content: An epic cinematic poster in a dark golden bronze palette, styled like a mythic gladiator movie poster merged with vintage Formula 1 iconography. Two legendary rival drivers face away from each other in mirrored side-profile bust portraits at the top half of the image, one on the left inspired by Ayrton Senna and one on the right inspired by Alain Prost, both depicted as heroic Roman gladiators with weathered bronze armor, dramatic shoulder plates, and racing colors draped as cloaks. The left figure wears green, yellow, and blue accents, and the right figure wears blue, white, and red accents. Their faces are mostly in shadow, lit by intense backlight through storm clouds, creating a solemn, monumental mood. Behind each driver hangs 1 vertical banner, for a total of 2 banners: the left banner is dark green with a large gold S, the text "SENNA", "#12", and a cursive signature; the right banner is dark blue with a large gold P, the text "PROST", "#1", and a cursive signature. Centered near the top, in elegant serif French text, place the line "DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE." with a small gold Formula 1 emblem and laurel motif below it. In the central sky, add 2 stacked lines of French text reading "RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE." and "LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS." The main title dominates the middle in huge metallic serif lettering: "{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"}", with a sword-like vertical separator for "vs". Beneath it, a subtitle in French reads "LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1". The lower half shows a colossal Roman colosseum packed with spectators, flags, arches, dust, smoke, and dramatic perspective lines converging on the center. At the exact center of the arena stands 1 large victory banner with the words "VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR" in gold. In the foreground, place 2 front-facing late-1980s Formula 1 cars charging toward the viewer on a dirt-covered arena floor, throwing dust. The left car is associated with Senna and features red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 12 on the nose, with the driver wearing a yellow helmet. The right car is associated with Prost and features matching red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 1 on the nose, with the driver wearing a white helmet. At the very bottom, add the line "1988. 1989. 1990." and below it "L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H." Include a small ornamental laurel decoration under the final line. Use hyper-detailed textures, dramatic storm clouds, god rays, flying dust, intense contrast, symmetrical composition, ultra-polished poster design, heroic scale, and a timeless legendary atmosphere.

items.title: Storm Wizard Casting Lightning
items.description: A cinematic photorealistic fantasy prompt for generating a dramatic wizard portrait with storm lighting and crackling magical energy.
items.content: A dramatic dark-fantasy portrait of an elderly wizard standing in a stormy wasteland under a black, cloud-choked sky. He wears a tall, weathered pointed hat with a brown leather band and a tiny metal clasp, and a heavy dark blue-gray robe with wide sleeves. His face is mostly hidden in shadow beneath the hat brim, with long strands of glowing {argument name="accent hair color" default="electric blue"} hair peeking out at the sides and a very long flowing silver-white beard reaching down his chest. The wizard thrusts his left hand toward the camera in a powerful forced-perspective pose, fingers spread, conjuring a bright orb of blue-white magical energy in his palm with crackling lightning arcs wrapping around the hand and sleeve. In his right arm he clutches a large ancient leather spellbook with worn corners, metal fittings, embossed arcane markings on the cover, and a few pages visible. The background shows a barren dark landscape and exactly 1 prominent lightning bolt striking on the right side of the frame. Cinematic high-contrast lighting, hyper-detailed skin and fabric texture, moody photorealism, sharp focus on the hand and beard, intense fantasy atmosphere, centered composition, square crop.

items.title: Minimal Magnus Effect Infographic
items.description: A polished academic poster explaining the Magnus Effect with four numbered sections, fluid-flow diagrams, pressure equations, and clean textbook-style visuals for educational or presentation use.
items.content:
{"type":"educational physics infographic poster","topic":"The Magnus Effect","style":"minimal academic poster, premium textbook-meets-modern design, clean symmetry, balanced spacing, soft neutral cream background, thin teal border, elegant serif typography for headings, minimalist sans-serif for explanatory text, limited palette of teal, muted gold, dark gray, and light beige","layout":{"orientation":"square poster","sections":[{"title":"THE MAGNUS EFFECT","position":"top center","count":1,"labels":["main title"]},{"title":"1. THE PHENOMENON DEFINED","position":"upper section","count":2,"labels":["definition text block","small top-right icon showing a spinning ball with a curved arrow and a gold force label F_M"]},{"title":"2. FLUID FLOW & SPIN INTERACTION","position":"middle section","count":2,"labels":["No Spin (Symmetric Flow)","With Spin (Asymmetric Flow)"]},{"title":"3. PRESSURE DIFFERENTIAL (BERNOULLI’S PRINCIPLE)","position":"bottom left","count":4,"labels":["Lower Pressure (P1) / P1 < P2","spinning ball with gold rotational arrows","Higher Pressure (P2) / P2 > P1","Bernoulli's Principle formula box"]},{"title":"4. NET FORCE & CURVED PATH","position":"bottom right","count":4,"labels":["ball with pressure labels P1 < P2 on top and P1 < P2 on lower region","upward gold arrow labeled F_M (Magnus Force)","gray dashed Original Path arrow","teal dashed curved trajectory arrow"]}],"dividers":"4 thin teal horizontal and vertical divider lines separating the poster into distinct bands and lower two-column panels"},"content_details":{"section_1":{"heading":"1. THE PHENOMENON DEFINED","body":"The generation of a sideways force on a spinning object moving through a fluid (gas or liquid), causing it to curve from its principal flight path.","diagram":"simple gray circular ball icon with a curved spin arrow above it, an outward curved motion arrow, and a small rounded gold box containing F_M"},"section_2":{"heading":"2. FLUID FLOW & SPIN INTERACTION","panels":[{"title":"No Spin (Symmetric Flow)","diagram":"gray sphere centered on a faint square grid, with 6 teal horizontal streamlines flowing left to right and bending symmetrically around the sphere; small teal arrows indicate equal flow speed above and below"},{"title":"With Spin (Asymmetric Flow)","diagram":"gray sphere with 2 gold rotational arrows around it, centered on a faint square grid, with 6 teal streamlines compressed and faster above the sphere and more spaced below; right side labels read 'Faster Fluid, v↑' near the upper lines and 'Slower Fluid, v↓' near the lower lines; subtle gold highlight wedge behind the upper-right flow region"}]},"section_3":{"heading":"3. PRESSURE DIFFERENTIAL (BERNOULLI’S PRINCIPLE)","elements":["top rounded rectangle with lower pressure label","center spinning sphere with gold curved arrows","large vertical gold downward arrow labeled Pressure Gradient (ΔP)","bottom rounded rectangle with higher pressure label","wide formula box with Bernoulli equation"],"text_boxes":{"top":"Lower Pressure (P1)
P1 < P2","bottom":"Higher Pressure (P2)
P2 > P1","formula":"Bernoulli's Principle:
P + 1/2 ρv^2 = Constant ⇒ ΔP ∝ (v1^2 − v2^2)","caption":"Faster fluid speed (v↑) results in lower pressure (P↓)."}},"section_4":{"heading":"4. NET FORCE & CURVED PATH","diagram":"large central sphere filled with a teal-to-gold split shading, gold curved spin arrow wrapping around the left side, thick upward gold arrow emerging from the top labeled F_M (Magnus Force), thin gray dashed horizontal arrow labeled Original Path extending to the right, and a teal dashed curved path arcing upward to the top-right with an arrowhead","caption_box":"The net Magnus Force (F_M) acts perpendicular to the spin axis and the direction of motion, creating lift or a curved trajectory."}},"rendering":"crisp vector-style infographic, subtle paper texture, high legibility, light shadows only inside rounded label boxes, precise alignment, understated scientific elegance"}

items.title: Agritech magazine cover from app screenshot
items.description: This prompt turns a mobile app screenshot into a realistic Spanish-language agricultural magazine cover, useful for product marketing, launch visuals, and editorial-style mockups.
items.content: Using the provided reference image of the mobile app screen, transform it into a premium editorial magazine cover mockup about agricultural innovation. Keep the app UI recognizable on the phone display, but place it in a realistic lifestyle context: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone that shows the app, with vineyard rows, mountains, and a few workers in the background under natural daylight. Design the full page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with a refined agricultural-business aesthetic in green, cream, and earthy tones. Add a large masthead at the top reading “REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”, a thin top strapline with 3 items separated by vertical bars: “Especial Viñas de Chile”, “Innovación agrícola”, and “Abril 2026”, plus a subtitle line beneath the masthead: “Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”. On the left, add a green section tag reading “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA” and a bold stacked main cover headline: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”, followed by a short deck about Kimün replacing the traditional notebook and giving real-time control to vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular callout badge mentioning a special feature about Kimün as an intelligent field notebook with AI. Include 2 bottom teaser photos: one close-up of the worker holding the phone in the vineyard with page label “p.18” and a caption about field diagnosis and cellphone alerts, and one small group scene with 3 people reviewing the app together with page label “p.24” and a caption about connected field teams, voice, records, and instant costs. On the right column, add 3 article teasers with icons and page numbers: one about the end of paper and the new era of the intelligent field notebook (p.30), one about more efficient vineyards through better data-driven decisions (p.36), and one about water management 4.0 and smarter, more profitable irrigation (p.42). Add a footer strip with 5 category labels: “AGRICULTURA”, “FRUTALES”, “VIÑAS”, “GANADERÍA”, “SUSTENTABILIDAD”, plus a barcode and a small price. Make it look like a polished real magazine cover photo shoot and editorial layout, not a flat app screenshot.

items.title: Vintage Kyoto Travel Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a retro-style Kyoto tourism poster, ideal for travel art prints, editorial covers, or destination-themed wall decor.
items.content: A vintage travel poster for {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}, Japan, designed in a nostalgic mid-century tourism style with a faded paper texture, softly worn edges, and warm sun-aged colors. Use a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream border. At the top, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"} in oversized elegant red serif letters, with “JAPAN” centered below in dark blue serif type and thin decorative divider lines. Add an italic tagline beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}. The main image should show a dramatic low-angle view of a traditional five-story Japanese pagoda in vivid vermilion red with dark wooden eaves and black railings, standing on a stone base with a wooden walkway in the foreground. Surround the pagoda with green wooded hills, a bright blue sky, and soft cream-colored clouds. On the left side, include a vertical red label with white Japanese characters reading “京都、日本”. Also add a blooming cherry blossom branch entering from the left, with clusters of pale pink flowers. In the upper right corner, include a postage stamp featuring a pagoda silhouette in muted red tones, partially overlapped by a circular postal cancellation mark reading “KYOTO JAPAN” with the kanji “京都” in the center and a few wavy postmark lines extending rightward. At the bottom, add a centered vintage footer slogan in serif capitals reading {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}. The overall look should feel romantic, collectible, slightly distressed, and like a classic Japanese tourism print from the 1950s or 1960s.

She has shoulder-length wavy {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair, small gold hoop earrings, and wears a soft beige knit sweater with relaxed blue jeans. She sits with one leg crossed, holding a patterned ceramic coffee cup in one hand while an open paperback book rests on the table in front of her, with her other hand lightly touching the pages. The background shows warm stone buildings with wooden shutters, potted green plants outside the storefronts, and a hanging sign that reads {argument name="cafe sign" default="CAFÉ LUNA"}. A few distant pedestrians appear softly blurred in the far background. items.title: Cinematic Wednesday Anime Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic Japanese film-poster illustration of a schoolgirl in a sunlit classroom, ideal for cinematic anime key art or social media poster visuals.
items.content: A Japanese movie-poster style anime illustration, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, showing a teenage schoolgirl seated alone in a classroom at golden hour. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, long and slightly wavy, gathered into a loose side braid draped over her right shoulder, with soft bangs and warm rim light along the top of her head and hair edges. She wears a cream or light beige sailor-style school uniform with navy trim and a dark blue ribbon bow at the chest. Her pose is quiet and introspective: sitting at a school desk, leaning her cheek into one hand, shoulders slightly curved, looking off to the side with a tired but calm midweek expression. The scene is lit by strong late-afternoon sunlight pouring in from a tall classroom window on the right, creating glowing highlights, dust motes in the air, soft haze, and a nostalgic cinematic mood. In the dimmer left background, include a green classroom chalkboard and 2 small chalkboard erasers or chalk accessories resting on the tray. Use painterly anime realism with rich filmic contrast, delicate facial rendering, textured brushwork, subtle grain, and dramatic poster lighting. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the artwork: on the left side, large vertical white brush lettering reading "真ん中" with smaller handwritten-style vertical text above reading "やっと、"; across the lower middle, large pink calligraphic title text reading "水曜日" diagonally; on the upper right, a vertical tagline reading "週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる。" Near the lower right, include 3 stacked gold laurel award emblems with small Japanese text inside each. Along the bottom center, add 2 lines of small Japanese tagline text, then a credits block in small Japanese film-poster typography. In the bottom right corner, place a large release date reading {argument name="release date" default="5.29"} with "ROADSHOW" beneath it. Overall feeling: soft, melancholic, reassuring, like an understated coming-of-age film poster about an ordinary Wednesday becoming quietly special.

items.title: Spanish Sports Newspaper Front Page
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic dramatic Spanish sports newspaper cover, useful for editorial mockups, media design concepts, or football news visualizations.
items.content: A realistic Spanish sports newspaper front page in the style of a major daily broadsheet, clean white background with strong red and black typography, editorial print layout, high-resolution scanned-paper look. At the very top, an oversized red masthead reading {argument name="newspaper name" default="MARCA"} spans nearly the full width, with a small black price in the upper-right corner reading {argument name="price" default="2,50€"}. Beneath the masthead, a thin line of small black publication details includes a Tuesday date, website, year, and issue number. The dominant main headline on the left takes up most of the page in gigantic bold condensed black uppercase letters over two lines: {argument name="main headline" default="ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO"}. Below it, a red subheadline in bold sentence case says that Real Madrid dismisses the coach after 100 days on the bench and seeks a replacement until the end of the season. A smaller black explanatory line underneath mentions the decision following Champions League elimination and loss of the LaLiga lead. The main photo occupies the lower-left majority of the cover: a suited football coach standing in a stadium with blue seats, one hand touching his forehead in a stressed or disappointed gesture, wearing a dark navy suit, white shirt, and dark tie, with the Bernabéu environment visible and a pitch-side barrier reading Real Madrid C. F. Along the bottom of the main image, a small caption line notes that the coach leaves the Bernabéu after learning the decision. At the very bottom left and center are 2 narrow columns of small black article text in Spanish newspaper style. To the right side, a vertical sidebar contains 2 stacked secondary stories separated by red divider lines. The top sidebar story has a red section label reading NBA PLAYOFFS, a bold black headline saying the Lakers force game seven, a rectangular action photo of 2 basketball players with a Lakers player in a purple number 77 jersey going up with the ball against a Nuggets defender, and a short caption below mentioning Doncic scoring 42 points in Denver. The lower sidebar story has a red section label reading TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN, a bold black headline about Alcaraz dominating at the Caja Mágica, and a rectangular tennis photo of a player in light purple kit hitting a forehand against a bright blue backdrop. Near the bottom center-right, include a pull-quote box marked by large red quotation marks and bold black text reading {argument name="pull quote" default="Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida"}. Overall composition should feel like an authentic dramatic sports front page: sharp print typography, rigid newspaper grid, realistic photojournalism, heavy black headline blocks, red accents, and a contemporary Spanish press design.

items.title: Futuristic Mumbai Sunset Skyline
items.description: A cinematic sci-fi cityscape prompt for generating a futuristic Mumbai skyline at sunset with coastal bridge traffic, dense skyscrapers, and bold title text.
items.content: A cinematic ultra-detailed wide-angle cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} reimagined as a futuristic megacity at sunset, viewed from an elevated overlook above the coastline. The skyline is packed with dozens of towering futuristic skyscrapers of varied silhouettes, including 6 especially prominent supertall towers with sleek glass facades, sharp angular forms, and neon accents, mixed with dense mid-rise urban buildings below. On the right side, a long sea bridge resembling the Bandra-Worli Sea Link curves dramatically from the foreground into the distance over calm coastal water, with flowing streams of headlights and taillights. The sun sits low near the horizon over the Arabian Sea, casting glowing golden reflections across the water and bathing the scene in intense orange, amber, pink, and magenta light under richly layered clouds. In the lower left foreground, include a grand historic domed building inspired by South Mumbai heritage architecture, warmly illuminated, juxtaposed against the futuristic skyline; above it, add a hovering circular UFO-like platform with blue light. Also place 2 visible illuminated billboards in the lower-left and center-right urban area: one large sign reading "MUMBAI", "मुंबई", and "THE CITY OF DREAMS", and one smaller sign reading "NAVI MUMBAI". Add 1 small flying vehicle or drone near the central towers. Place large clean white uppercase text near the top center reading {argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"}. The overall mood is epic, aspirational, glossy, highly detailed, vibrant, cinematic sci-fi urban fantasy, with atmospheric haze, glowing windows, reflective glass, dramatic contrast, and a polished concept-art finish.

items.title: Censored Point-Cloud Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a stark black-and-white lidar-style portrait of a suited man built from dense white particles, ideal for editorial tech visuals, privacy themes, or futuristic identity imagery.
items.content: A minimalist monochrome portrait made entirely from millions of tiny white point-cloud dots on a pitch-black background, showing 1 adult man from the chest up in a formal dark blazer and light collared dress shirt. The subject is centered slightly to the right, facing forward with a subtle three-quarter turn, with neatly combed short hair and one visible ear sharply defined by dense lidar-like particles. Render the figure as raw 3D scan data mixed with topological contour logic: ultra-dense stippling, precise geometric dot placement, faint isoline structure, and clean depth shaping across the hair, jacket lapels, collar, neck, and shoulders. Keep the face intentionally obscured by 1 large vertical rectangular censor block in dark gray to black, perfectly centered over the facial area from forehead to below the nose, creating a stark privacy-mask effect. Use matte texture, crisp edges, sharp focus, high contrast, no glow, no bloom, no neon, no fog, no motion blur, no chromatic aberration, no painterly strokes. Add 1 small four-point sparkle icon in light gray in the bottom-right corner. The overall image should feel mathematical, forensic, and futuristic, like a high-resolution lidar scan portrait in 8k.

items.description: This prompt generates a luxurious fantasy anime portrait of a seated kimono-clad princess in a glowing Japanese palace, ideal for character art and premium wallpaper-style illustrations.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style portrait of a seated shrine maiden princess in an opulent traditional Japanese palace interior, centered in a vertical composition. She is a young woman with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="mint green"} hair fading into yellow-green at the tips, soft pink accent strands, straight bangs, and ornate hair ornaments including 2 tall faceted crystal fox ears, 1 pink flower cluster, and 2 small ribbon clips. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft square blur. She wears an elaborate layered kimono and dress ensemble in deep indigo, violet, magenta, white, and gold, with rich brocade, floral embroidery, lace sleeves, tassels, cords, and jeweled obi ornaments. The outer robe is dark navy with intricate multicolor floral patterns and metallic trim; the inner dress is glossy white with ruffles and delicate translucent fabric. She is posed kneeling formally on a reflective lacquered floor, one hand resting on her lap and the other on the floor beside her, with long sleeves and trailing fabric spread elegantly around her. The setting is a grand ceremonial hall with 4 visible red lacquer columns, 3 hanging lanterns, tall shoji windows on the left casting warm golden sunset light, purple hanging banners with floral crests, a richly patterned coffered ceiling in blue, gold, and red, and folding screens in the background painted with trees and birds. items.content: A dark, cinematic graphic-novel style book cover illustration set in a snowy mountain forest at night, with a cold blue palette and dramatic vertical composition. In the foreground, 4 human figures stand behind a red-and-white striped barrier gate blocking a forest road. The first is an adult man in a heavy dark winter jacket, carrying 1 sleeping young girl in his arms; the girl wears a padded pink snowsuit and pale winter boots, her head resting on his shoulder. items.title: Washington Crossing Style Winter Boat Scene
items.description: This prompt generates a dark, cinematic historical winter river-crossing image in the style of an 18th-century military tableau, ideal for editorial art or dramatic history-themed visuals.
items.content: A cinematic historical scene at dusk on a freezing river crossing in winter, showing a crowded wooden rowboat packed with exactly 11 colonial-era soldiers and boatmen pushing through dark icy water filled with floating chunks of ice. In the center stands 1 commanding figure, upright and resolute, wearing a dark navy or black heavy cloak draped over a light tan military uniform and a black tricorne hat, evoking an 18th-century general. Around him are 10 other men seated or crouched low in the boat, dressed in weathered Revolutionary War-era clothing: dark coats, wool caps, cloaks, scarves, leather straps, and tricorne hats, with several gripping long wooden oars and one visible musket angled upward behind the central figure. The mood is grim, cold, and heroic, with wet clothing, snow dusting, pale breathy atmosphere, and a stormy blue-gray sky. The river is wide and partially frozen, with a dark tree-lined shoreline in the distance and a few tiny warm lights glowing on the far bank. Composition is frontal and tightly framed from just above the bow of the boat, making the viewer feel inside the freezing crossing. Use low-key lighting, muted desaturated colors, deep shadows, damp textures, realism, dramatic historical painting energy blended with cinematic photorealism, ultra-detailed fabric, wood grain, ice, and mist.

She wears a flowing ivory halter dress with a very deep plunging neckline, side cutouts, a gathered waist with a circular ring detail, and soft pleated fabric draped across her lap. Her hair is long, wavy, and {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"}, styled loose over her shoulders. Lighting is bright Mediterranean midday sun with crisp highlights, soft skin glow, and gentle depth of field that keeps the woman sharp while the background architecture and sea are slightly softened. Composition is vertical, elegant and aspirational, with the woman centered slightly right, torso visible down to the flowing skirt, scenic coastline stretching across the left half of the frame. items.title: Surreal Skull and Tree of Consciousness
items.description: A richly detailed surreal fantasy artwork of a skull topped by a glass sphere containing a glowing golden tree and contemplative figure, ideal for concept art about consciousness, mortality, and dreamlike symbolism.
items.content: A surreal, ultra-detailed fantasy illustration of a large weathered human skull rising from dark water, centered in the frame, with the top of the skull opened like a pedestal supporting a giant transparent glass sphere. Inside the sphere stands an intricate luminous tree made of twisting golden branches and roots, with exactly 1 main trunk, dozens of tiny warm glowing orbs embedded among the branches, and many metallic bronze leaves. The roots spread across the base inside the globe and wrap around a small ladder built into the trunk. At the lower left inside the globe, depict exactly 1 translucent seated human figure in a contemplative pose, knees drawn up, head resting on one hand, holding a small glowing flower or crystalline bloom in the other hand. On the lower right inside the globe, include exactly 1 miniature architectural tower-like structure made of delicate gold framework. Surrounding the sphere and background are ornate branch networks with hanging crystal ornaments, faceted gemstones, suspended droplets, circular glass forms, and metallic leaves, all arranged symmetrically but organically. The skull is highly realistic with deep eye sockets, detailed teeth, cracked bone texture, and fine copper-like tubes and circuitry extending from both sides near the temples. In the skull’s right eye socket, show exactly 1 glowing mechanical orrery-like light structure. Place the whole composition in a dreamlike seascape at dusk with calm reflective water, distant rock spires, soft clouds, and a blue-to-gold sky. Use cinematic lighting, high contrast, sharp focus, mystical atmosphere, luxurious gold and bronze filigree, crystal transparency, and a color palette of deep teal, midnight blue, ivory bone, warm amber, and metallic gold. Make it feel like symbolic metacognition, consciousness contained within mortality, blending dark surrealism, baroque ornament, and ethereal sci-fi fantasy.

items.title: Neon Lip Balm Launch Ad
items.description: A vibrant futuristic beauty advertisement poster for a glowing lip balm, ideal for social media campaigns, product launches, and editable Canva-style promo designs.
items.content: Create a glossy, hyper-saturated social media ad poster for a futuristic beauty product launch, designed like a Canva marketing graphic. The composition is a single widescreen promotional banner centered on a cyan-to-purple gradient background, with rounded corners and a vivid neon pink color palette. Inside the banner, show a young woman from the chest up in a glowing sci-fi tunnel made of concentric pink and white light rings. Her face is obscured by a soft square blur block, but her hair is styled in two small buns, and she wears hoop earrings, layered chain necklaces, a metallic silver top, and an iridescent pink holographic jacket. She extends one hand toward the camera holding a clear lip balm tube close to the lens, creating strong foreground perspective. The tube label reads “GLOW MODE Lip Balm.” At the top center, large neon headline text reads “GLOW MODE” with a script subtitle “Lip Balm,” and below it a smaller line reads “JUICY SHINE. HYDRATING CARE. ZERO STICKINESS.” In the upper left corner, add a handwritten neon note reading “NEW!” In the upper right corner, place an orange rounded sticker with white text reading “gpt-image-2,” plus a small orange pointer tab beneath it. On the right side of the banner, include 2 circular callout badges: a pink starburst badge that says “ONLY $14.99” and a black glowing circular badge that says “VIRAL ON TikTok 2M+ views.” At the lower right, show 2 product display elements: one upright open lip balm tube with wand applicator beside it, and one whole sliced peach plus one cut mango half with green leaves, all sitting on a glossy reflective surface with pink light swirls. Along the lower center, add 3 feature icons with labels: a droplet icon labeled “HYALURONIC HYDRATION,” a fruit icon labeled “PEACH MANGO SCENT,” and a bunny icon labeled “100% VEGAN & CRUELTY-FREE.” In the lower left inside the banner, add a vertical stack of 3 social buttons with platform icons and handles: TikTok with “#GlowMode,” Instagram with “@LunaBeatty,” and Snapchat with “@LunaGlow.” Beneath them place 1 glowing QR code card, and next to it handwritten script text reading “Shop Now!” with an arrow pointing toward the QR code. Outside the banner at the bottom left, place a tilted teal rounded label reading “Canva AI,” with a small teal paper-plane style accent nearby. Add glossy reflections, lens flares, bloom, neon rim lighting, sparkles, and polished ad-design styling throughout, with crisp commercial product photography mixed with futuristic graphic design.

items.content: A photorealistic humorous academic presentation in a conference room: an anthropomorphic otter scientist stands at the left side of the frame wearing a crisp white lab coat and holding a thin pointing stick toward a large presentation board on an easel. The otter is upright like a human, with realistic brown fur, dark paws, and a professional posture. The lab coat has a stitched name tag reading "Dr. Otter" and a smaller line reading "Aquatic Systems Lab," plus two pens in the chest pocket. The otter’s face is partially censored by a square blur block. Behind the otter is a whiteboard with faint handwritten notes and doodles, including "WiFi > Fish," "H2O," "Hydration," a fish sketch, and a wifi symbol. The main focus is a large clean presentation slide with sharp readable text and polished corporate-academic layout. At the top, a bold title reads "{argument name="headline text" default="Ethan Mollick’s Otter Test"}" and beneath it a subtitle reads "Prompt: \"{argument name="prompt text" default="An otter sitting on an airplane seat using in-flight wifi on a laptop"}\"". Below that is a boxed section titled "Sample AI-Generated Images" containing exactly 4 side-by-side sample images of a realistic otter seated in an airplane seat using a laptop or tablet, each framed like model outputs, with one showing a large wifi symbol above the seat. Beneath the images is a section labeled "Performance Results (Pass = otter, airplane seat, in-flight wifi, laptop/tablet)" with exactly 5 score boxes: "DALL·E 3" with no visible numeric score, "GPT-4o" with "4/4" and "100%", "Midjourney v6" with "3/4" and "75%", "Stable Diffusion XL" with "2/4" and "50%", and "SD 1.5" with "0/4" and "0%". On the right side is a large highlighted box reading "Average Score" and "{argument name="average score" default="70%"}" in large blue type. At the bottom of the slide is a "Key Findings" box with exactly 3 bullet points: "Modern models understand complex, specific prompts surprisingly well.", "Otters + airplanes + wifi = a reliable benchmark.", and "Further research is otter-ly necessary." A small simple cartoon otter doodle appears in the lower-right corner of the slide. The room is warmly lit with wood-paneled walls, shallow depth of field, and a few blurred audience members in the foreground, including a laptop at the bottom edge showing an otter image on its screen and a glass pitcher on a table. Style: ultra-realistic editorial photography, deadpan scientific satire, believable conference presentation, high detail, natural indoor lighting, professional lens compression, readable slide typography, polished yet absurd.

items.title: Historical WWII Photo Colorization
items.description: This prompt restores a black-and-white wartime reference photo into a realistic, historically accurate colorized image for archival, editorial, or educational use.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, colorize the original black-and-white WWII paratrooper photo into a realistic, historically accurate color restoration. Preserve the exact composition, pose, gear, weapon, cropped face block, background, and photographic framing. Add natural period-appropriate colors: khaki/tan uniform and jump gear, olive drab pack, brown leather boots and straps, wood-toned rifle stock, dark metal gun body, muted earth tones for the dirt road and building, green trees, and a soft pale blue sky. Make the 82nd Airborne shoulder patch historically correct with 1 visible patch in red, white, and blue. Keep the result looking like a faithful documentary-era restoration rather than a modern stylized repaint.

items.title: Chaotic Road Trip Comedy Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished theatrical poster for a fast-paced ensemble vacation comedy, ideal for parody film key art or summer movie poster concepts.
items.content: A bright, chaotic theatrical comedy movie poster in a polished Hollywood one-sheet style, vertical composition, with a retro yellow Mini Cooper speeding straight toward the viewer down a sunny palm-lined city street. The car is packed with exactly 5 vacationing friends: 2 visible in the front seats, 2 partially visible squeezed in the back, and 1 man sprawled on the roof luggage, pointing dramatically forward with a wild grin. Everyone wears colorful casual vacation clothes, including tropical prints, relaxed shirts, and sun hats. The scene feels loud, reckless, and fun. On the roof are stacked suitcases and travel bags. A police car with flashing lights chases from the rear right background. On the left side, a crooked wooden signpost has exactly 3 signs reading "BEACH", "MOUNTAINS", and "WHAT COULD GO WRONG?". A squawking seagull perches on top of the signpost. On the right side, a giant roadside donut shop sign reads "DONUT" and a folded paper map flies through the air. The street is full of motion blur, dust, debris, and tire energy, with a saturated blue sky and fluffy clouds above. At the very top, place exactly 4 actor names in black condensed caps: "DAVE JOHNSON", "LILY WANG", "KEVIN HARTLEY", and "AMY CHEN". Beneath that, add a stacked tagline in bold caps: "THEY CAME. THEY SAW." in dark navy, and "THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP." in red. The main title dominates the upper middle in huge playful 3D typography: "{argument name="movie title" default="VACATION MODE"}", with "VACATION" in bright yellow and "MODE" in white, heavy blue shadowing, and the O replaced by a simple smiling face wearing sunglasses. Add small doodle-like yellow accent marks around the title. Across the lower right of the title, place a tilted hot-pink banner reading "A COMEDY ABOUT BAD IDEAS & GOOD TIMES" with a hand-drawn curved arrow pointing down. The car license plate reads "NO PLAN ALL FUN". Near the bottom, add a glowing pull-quote in yellow: "LAUGH-OUT-LOUD FUNNY!" and below it "- MOVIE BUZZ". At the bottom center, add the release line "ONLY IN THEATERS" and then "{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}" in large bold yellow caps. Add tiny legal credits along the very bottom edge and small production logos in the corners, including "GOOD TIME FILMS" on the lower left and "NO PLAN ALL FUN" on the lower right. Use high-contrast lighting, exaggerated perspective, glossy commercial poster finish, vibrant summer colors, and a goofy road-trip comedy tone.

items.title: WWII D-Day Cinematic Poster
items.description: A dark, photoreal war movie poster showing four WWII soldiers above a beach landing scene, ideal for generating dramatic historical film key art.
items.content: A gritty cinematic World War II movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, designed like a modern prestige war film advertisement. At the top, two centered tagline lines in condensed uppercase text read {argument name="top tagline" default="COURAGE. BROTHERHOOD. SACRIFICE."} and {argument name="second tagline" default="VICTORY COMES AT A PRICE."}. The main composition features 4 American WWII soldiers in the foreground wearing dark olive uniforms and large netted M1 helmets: 1 dominant central soldier shown from the chest up, facing forward, flanked by 3 slightly smaller soldiers receding behind him, one on the left and 2 on the right. Their faces are shadowed, dirty, battle-worn, and dramatic, with intense low-key lighting and smoky backlight. Behind them, a stormy war-torn sky filled with heavy smoke columns, sparks, embers, and 2 aircraft groups: 1 group of 3 planes on the upper left and 1 group of 5 planes on the upper right. In the middle, a small centered line of text says {argument name="based on text" default="INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS"}. Below it, an enormous distressed title in bold block letters reads {argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"}, with a star used as the separator between the two D letters. Under the title, a red condensed date line reads {argument name="date text" default="JUNE 6, 1944"}. The lower half shows the D-Day beach landing from the viewpoint inside an open landing craft, with 2 dark metal ramp walls framing the left and right edges. In the surf, exactly 8 soldiers are wading toward shore with rifles and packs, surrounded by Czech hedgehog beach obstacles, rough water, smoke, distant fires, and an embattled coastline under bombardment. At the very bottom is a dense strip of tiny production credits, and beneath that a bold red release line reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}, followed by a smaller white line, "HONOR THEIR SACRIFICE.". Color palette is charcoal gray, steel blue, muddy brown, and fire orange with red accent typography. items.title: Revenge Action Movie Poster
items.description: A dramatic Hollywood-style revenge thriller poster with a gun-wielding protagonist, burning city chaos, bold title typography, and theatrical billing text for promotional key art.
items.content: A gritty, high-contrast cinematic action movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout for a revenge thriller titled {argument name="movie title" default="DEADLINE VENGEANCE"}. The composition is dominated by a large foreground figure of a tough middle-aged man with short dark hair, rugged stubble, and a black leather or tactical jacket, aiming a semi-automatic handgun directly at the viewer from the left side of the frame with strong foreshortening so the gun appears oversized and close to camera. His face is partially obscured in shadow for a mysterious, menacing look. Behind him is a dark modern city skyline at night under stormy clouds, with 1 helicopter in the upper right sky and 1 massive fireball explosion on the right side near the buildings, sending smoke, sparks, and debris into the air. Across the very top, small red uppercase text reads {argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"}. On the left-center area, add a stacked white uppercase tagline in 4 lines: {argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."}, styled as 2 short blocks separated by thin red accent lines. Place the main title huge across the lower middle, with 2 words: the first word in enormous distressed metallic-white block letters, and the second word in slightly smaller bold red uppercase letters. In the bottom third, show 1 lone male figure from behind standing in the middle of a wet reflective street, holding a pistol, facing the burning city. Surround him with 4 police vehicles total, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, with flashing lights, plus 2 additional helicopters in the distant sky near the horizon, making 3 helicopters total in the full poster. Include flames along both lower corners, wreckage, smoke, embers, and silhouettes of several armed figures in the distance. At the bottom center, add red uppercase release text {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"} with smaller white text underneath reading {argument name="format line" default="EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX"}. Add a dense strip of tiny fake production credits and a film rating box at the very bottom. Color palette: black, charcoal, steel gray, orange fire, and deep crimson. Style: polished Hollywood blockbuster key art, dramatic rim lighting, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, intense contrast, anamorphic action lighting, smoky atmosphere, explosive urban chaos, premium theatrical poster design.

items.title: Japanese Classroom Gear 5 Chalk Art
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic empty classroom scene featuring a large anime-inspired chalkboard mural, ideal for fan art, cinematic school interiors, or social media comparison posts.
items.content: A photorealistic Japanese classroom interior shot in soft daytime light, viewed from the front-left corner at a slight angle, with an old green chalkboard dominating the wall. On the chalkboard is a large hand-drawn chalk illustration of an anime pirate boy in a wild, joyous pose inspired by Gear 5, with fluffy white cloud-like hair and swirling white smoke around his body, open laughing mouth, white loose jacket and shorts with fluffy trim, a purple sash, one foot thrust toward the viewer and the other leg bent forward, drawn in colored chalk with visible sketch texture. On the right side of the chalkboard, include 2 lines of large chalk text: vertical Japanese characters reading "太陽の神" and below them the English text "GEAR 5". The room should include 1 wooden teacher's desk in the foreground with 1 chalkboard eraser on top, 1 open box of colored chalk, and 3 loose chalk sticks scattered nearby. Add realistic classroom details: a chalk tray running across the board, a left-side window letting in natural light, beige worn walls, a ceiling-mounted fluorescent light, and 1 wall speaker above the board. Make it look like a real photograph of impressive chalkboard fan art in an empty school classroom, clean composition, natural perspective, subtle wear and dust, highly realistic.

items.title: Gear 5 Chalkboard Classroom Mural
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic classroom photo featuring a dramatic chalkboard mural of Gear 5 Luffy, ideal for anime-themed poster art or social media comparisons of image models.
items.content: A photorealistic classroom interior centered on a large green chalkboard filled with an elaborate chalk mural of Monkey D. Luffy in Gear 5 from One Piece. The drawing dominates the board: a dynamic low-angle foreshortened pose with one oversized foot thrust toward the viewer, both fists raised, wild curly white hair, huge manic grin, intense round eyes, open white jacket, bare muscular chest with visible scars, loose white pants, and a flowing purple sash. Surround him with swirling white smoke-like aura drawn in expressive chalk strokes. On the right side of the chalkboard, include 2 text elements written in chalk: 1 vertical Japanese phrase reading "太陽の神" and 1 large English label reading "GEAR 5" near the lower right. Render the chalk art with layered white, gray, tan, and purple pastel-chalk texture, visible smudging, dust, and hand-drawn shading. Show the full blackboard frame, tray, and a realistic classroom setting with beige walls and a small speaker box above the board. In the foreground, place a worn wooden teacher's desk covered in chalk dust, with exactly 5 visible desk items: 1 open yellow box of multicolored chalk sticks, 3 loose chalk sticks on the desk, and 1 black rectangular chalkboard eraser. Add 2 small erasers resting on the left side of the chalk tray. Soft natural indoor lighting, straight-on composition, highly detailed, realistic photograph of a classroom with spectacular anime chalkboard art.

items.title: Sengoku vs Sangoku Crossover Poster
items.description: A cinematic anime poster prompt for generating an epic crossover battle visual between Japanese Sengoku warlords and Chinese Three Kingdoms heroes.
items.content:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {argument name="left faction title" default="日本戦国"}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="center slogan" default="時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。"}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {argument name="bottom tagline" default="時空を超え、英雄たちの戦いが始まる。"}. Poster layout, polished commercial promotional art, extremely detailed, high-impact, collectible poster aesthetic.
