items.title: Calligraphic Design with Vibrant Illustration Style
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating calligraphic art using freehand script with a vertical composition, set against a risograph illustration background with vibrant orange and purple tones.
items.content: مخطوطة بالخط الحر بتكوين طولي كل كلمة في سطر باتزان متكافئ وخلفها هايلايت مذهل، الكلمات تكون حولها ستروك مع حليات بشكل هندسي جميل، في الخلفية بنمط مينيمال جميل ثنائي الابعاد بطابع الليستريشن رايزوقراف مع فايبرانت كلرز بدرجات {argument name="الألوان" default="البنفسجي والبرتقال و الابيض"} مع تاثير فيلم قرين ورايزوغراف، الجملة "{argument name="الجملة" default="كن طموحا لاتقيده الحدود"}" والجو العام بتاثير جماليات {argument name="النمط" default="حكايات الاطفال"} مع حدة في المخرجات ووضوع عاليا وابراز للتفاصيل بشكل مبهر
items.translatedContent: Freehand calligraphy in a vertical composition with each word on a balanced line, featuring a stunning highlight behind it. The words are outlined with beautiful geometric ornaments. items.title: Apple macOS Redesign Promo Mockup
items.description: A sleek Apple-style macOS desktop hero image for keynote slides, product marketing, or UI concept presentations.
items.content: A polished Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup shown as a full-screen screenshot, with a soft pastel dawn wallpaper of layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. Centered near the top is a large minimalist headline reading "macOS" with the subheadline "Redesigned." and a smaller line below that says "More clarity. More focus. More you." The top system menu bar is visible across the full width: Apple logo, Finder, File, Edit, View, Go, Window, Help on the left; Wi‑Fi, battery, search, colorful user icon, and the date/time "Mon Jun 10  9:41 AM" on the right. On the left side, stack 4 translucent rounded widgets vertically: a weather widget for "Sonoma, CA" showing "65°", "Sunny", high/low "H:72°  L:55°", and 6 hourly temperatures from 10 AM to 3 PM; an "Up Next" widget with 2 calendar items, "Design Review" and "Lunch with Sophie" with times; a "Focus" widget showing "Do Not Disturb" and "On Until 10:00 AM"; and a "Notes" widget with the note "Website redesign" and time "3:30 PM". In the middle-left foreground, place a Finder window with rounded corners and a light frosted interface, titled "iCloud Drive". Include a left sidebar with 10 items total: Favorites with 6 items "AirDrop", "Recents", "Applications", "Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"; iCloud with 2 items "iCloud Drive" and "Shared"; and Locations with 1 item "Macintosh HD". In the main Finder area show 8 file items arranged in a grid: 4 folders on the top row labeled "Work", "Personal", "Projects", "Presentations", and 4 documents on the bottom row labeled "Brand Guidelines.pdf", "Project Brief.docx", "Research.png", "Moodboard.key". Add standard macOS traffic-light window buttons and small view/search controls in the title bar. On the right side, overlap a Mail app window with a three-column layout. The left mail list column is titled "Inbox" and shows "1237 messages" plus 5 visible senders/messages: "Antonio Manriquez" with subject "Design updates", "Jenny Court" with "Re: Team lunch", "Heather Lee" with "Q3 Planning", "Nisha Kumar" with "Re: Feedback", and "Simon Pickford" with "Offsite ideas". The reading pane shows the selected message from Antonio Manriquez to You with subject "Design updates" and body text about attached mockups for a new feature, plus a file attachment card labeled "Mockups.zip" and "12.4 MB". Use clean SF Pro-style typography, subtle shadows, translucent glassmorphism panels, soft ambient lighting, and a premium Apple keynote aesthetic. At the bottom center, include a glossy translucent macOS Dock with 15 icons: Finder, Launchpad, Safari, Messages, Mail, Calendar showing "JUN 10", Photos, Notes, Reminders, TV, Music, News, App Store, Settings, and Trash. Composition should feel balanced, airy, realistic, and highly refined, like an official Apple macOS redesign announcement image.

items.title: Premium Blueberry Product Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished Chinese-style e-commerce advertisement for packaged blueberries, suitable for supermarket branding, product listings, and promotional posters.
items.content: A premium e-commerce poster for fresh blueberries in a clean Chinese product-advertising style. Show a clear plastic clamshell box of blueberries as the main subject, placed diagonally from lower center to right side on folded blue fabric, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The package must remain realistic and consistent: a transparent square container with rounded corners, filled with dark blue blueberries, with a large irregular rounded label on top in white, pale blue, and deep blue, featuring one oversized blueberry illustration in the center and elegant Chinese branding. Make the fruit inside look larger, plumper, fresher, and covered with subtle moisture droplets, while keeping the overall blueberry arrangement believable. The background is an airy icy-blue tabletop with soft cloudy texture, cool daylight, and scattered loose blueberries around the package. Add a few blurred green leaves entering from the top right and bottom right edges for a fresh natural feeling. In the upper-right corner, include 1 small inset image showing the original product package from above on a warm brown surface, like a reference thumbnail. On the left side, create Chinese promotional typography with a large dark blue calligraphy headline {argument name="headline text" default="决茗新"}, followed by 2 smaller lines of copy: {argument name="subheadline text" default="新鲜蓝莓 自然之选"} and {argument name="tagline text" default="每一颗都是自然的礼物"}. Below that, place 3 vertically stacked feature icons with short Chinese captions: a leaf icon for natural ripeness, a fruit icon for juicy fullness, and a heart icon for rich nutrition. Near the bottom left, add large white brush-style Chinese text {argument name="product name" default="蓝莓"}, a secondary line {argument name="benefit text" default="膳食纤维+花青素"}, and a small net weight line reading 125克. Use cool blue color grading, crisp commercial lighting, sparkling highlights on the plastic lid, premium supermarket packaging aesthetics, high detail, realistic product photography blended with polished graphic design.

items.title: Found-Footage Office Horror Snapshot
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic flash-photo horror scene of two women in a dark security office with a sinister rabbit animatronic lurking in the doorway, ideal for analog-style thriller or mascot-horror imagery.
items.content: A gritty found-footage horror photo taken inside a dim, cramped security office at night, shot with a direct on-camera flash and slight film grain. In the foreground are exactly 2 young women, both partially cropped by the frame and both with their faces heavily blurred into rectangular smudges for privacy. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a black top, turned slightly away from camera. The woman on the right has long platinum blonde hair, a low-cut black top, and is holding a black flashlight angled upward in her right hand. Between them in the lower center foreground is 1 small black metal desk fan with visible circular grill. The background reveals a narrow open doorway centered in the image, leading into almost complete darkness. Standing deep inside that doorway is a terrifying rabbit animatronic silhouette with glowing eyes, long upright ears, a huge toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, barely illuminated so it emerges from the shadows. The office walls are off-white and worn, with a black-and-white checker stripe and a thin red stripe running horizontally across the room. On the left wall is 1 colorful “CELEBRATE!” poster featuring animatronic characters, plus 1 smaller character drawing sheet pinned nearby, and 1 black walkie-talkie standing upright on a surface. Near the doorway is 1 silver desk lamp. On the right side are 2 sheets of paper clipped to the wall and a gray filing cabinet in shadow. The door is ajar with the handle visible. Composition should feel like a candid party snapshot turning into a horror scene, with harsh flash-lit foreground subjects, deep black shadows, analog noise, muted colors, unsettling realism, and the hidden monster in the center background as the main scare.

items.title: Giant Robot Meets Woman on Balcony
items.description: This prompt generates a cinematic photoreal sci-fi image of a towering worn robot gently reaching toward a lone woman on a rusted balcony, ideal for dystopian concept art or dramatic AI showcase visuals.
items.content: A cinematic dystopian sci-fi scene in a wide, photorealistic frame: a colossal weathered humanoid robot fills the entire right half of the image, leaning in toward a lone woman standing on a tiny rusted apartment balcony on the far left. The robot is many stories tall, with a rounded helmet-like head, one visible glowing blue eye, dense exposed mechanical joints, layered armor plates, cables, pistons, and heavily scratched white-gray metal covered in rust, grime, and battle wear. Its enormous right arm is extended toward the woman, palm open and facing upward in a gentle offering gesture, with articulated metallic fingers and a massive forearm dominating the lower center of the frame. The woman is small by comparison, shown in profile, standing upright and looking up at the robot with a calm, contemplative expression; she wears a dark green hooded jacket, dark pants, and has dark hair tied back in a low ponytail. Place her on a narrow corroded balcony with a rusted railing attached to a decaying concrete high-rise, with 2 visible balcony levels and broken, abandoned architectural details on the left edge. In the background, show a dense, gray, rain-soaked megacity of tightly packed low-rise buildings fading into distant modern skyscrapers and hazy mountains. Use dramatic overcast lighting with thick storm clouds, muted steel and charcoal tones, soft atmospheric perspective, subtle mist, and a sense of immense scale, loneliness, and unexpected tenderness between human and machine. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic metal wear, cinematic depth, moody color grading, high contrast clouds, and a serious futuristic tone.

items.title: 3D Papercut Pirate Scene
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a high-saturation 3D multi-layered papercut scene featuring a stylized pirate crew in a chaotic sea adventure, complete with octane rendering and realistic paper textures.
items.content:
平视视角，正面直视一个高饱和度3D多层纸雕场景。
整体为灰蓝、奶油白、深森林绿，点缀琥珀色暖光。所有元素必须是实体纸张分层结构，边缘为硬切割效果，并清晰可见厚纸横截面。
极致丰富构图，一个高能量的{argument name="场景主题" default="海盗群像场景"}，发生在混乱的海上冒险中。多个风格化海盗角色以夸张动作呈现，中层核心是一位{argument name="核心角色" default="戴草帽的年轻船长"}向前冲刺，周围是姿态鲜明的船员。
分层的船只、翻涌海浪和旋转洋流贯穿前中后景，多艘船 in 不同空间层中碰撞倾斜，船帆破损、旗帜飞扬。
背景层中出现体型巨大的对立角色剪影，增强压迫感和空间层级。
前景堆满叙事元素：宝箱、金币、地图、木桶、绳索、灯笼，以及一张带笑脸海盗的通缉令。角落放置一个吉祥物式小角色作为视觉锚点。
所有氛围元素以纸雕形式呈现：海浪、水花、烟雾、碎片、动势线，强化混乱与动感。
主体位于中层，元素跨层互动，通过重叠和空间关系表达运动感。

The overall colors are grayish-blue, creamy white, and deep forest green, accented with amber warm light. All elements must be physical paper layered structures, with hard-cut edges and clearly visible thick paper cross-sections. Extremely rich composition, a high-energy {argument name="scene theme" default="pirate group scene"} set in a chaotic sea adventure. Multiple stylized pirate characters are presented in exaggerated actions, with a {argument name="core character" default="young captain wearing a straw hat"} in the middle layer charging forward, surrounded by crew members with distinct poses. Layered ships, surging waves, and swirling currents run through the foreground, middle, and background, with multiple ships colliding and tilting in different spatial layers, sails torn, and flags flying. Silhouettes of giant opposing characters appear in the background layer to enhance the sense of oppression and spatial hierarchy. The foreground is filled with narrative elements: treasure chests, gold coins, maps, barrels, ropes, lanterns, and a wanted poster with a smiling pirate. A mascot-like small character is placed in the corner as a visual anchor. All atmospheric elements are presented in paper carving form: waves, splashes, smoke, debris, and movement lines, strengthening the chaos and sense of motion. The main subject is in the middle layer, with elements interacting across layers to express movement through overlap and spatial relationships. Soft light from a single direction creates clear inter-layer shadows. Overall matte paper texture, no glowing, no soft edges, no volumetric light. items.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Anatomy Poster
items.description: A realistic smartphone chat-app screenshot showing a Japanese prompt and the resulting dense medical-style anatomical infographic, ideal for recreating viral AI image demo posts.

author.name: マシモGPT🤖@ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/GrokなどLLMをこねくり回す人

items.content: A smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in portrait orientation, showing a clean white iOS-style screen with a top bar containing a hamburger menu on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a small chevron, and two icons on the right for compose and more options. Near the top is a rounded light-gray user message bubble in Japanese reading “Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。” Below it, faint gray system text reads “Thought for 5s” and “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image as a detailed medical textbook-style anatomical poster. The poster shows a realistic three-quarter back view of an adult woman from head to upper thighs, with her head turned slightly left and her dark brown hair tied into a messy bun. Her skin and outer tissues are removed across most of the body to reveal musculature, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, rendered in extremely detailed vintage medical illustration style on a warm cream paper background. A rectangular cutout obscures the center of the face from forehead to jaw, creating a censored blank block over the facial area. Fine glowing network lines and nodes are overlaid through the exposed brain and body to visualize the attention mechanism as if it were an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are 6 numbered explanatory panels and 2 additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main poster title at upper left is “アテンション機構の解剖学的構造” with the English subtitle “The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”. At the top right is a flowchart labeled “Overall Flow of Attention” containing 5 connected boxes describing the process from input to output. Down the left side are 3 stacked explanatory sections with equations and mapping tables. Down the right side are 3 more numbered sections, each with technical notes and a small chart or matrix; the visible mini-diagrams include 1 purple heatmap matrix, 1 blue bar chart, and 1 multicolored cube graphic. Along the bottom edge are 5 small brain inset illustrations with captions showing stages of information flow. The overall aesthetic should feel like a highly polished AI-generated screenshot documenting a surreal scientific illustration request, with crisp UI, lots of tiny readable labels, and a convincing fusion of transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical plate design.

items.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Cosmic Artwork
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic mobile app screenshot showing an AI image-generation result, useful for mockups, social posts, or interface demos featuring dramatic visionary art.

author.name: マシモGPT🤖@ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/GrokなどLLMをこねくり回す人

items.content: A vertical smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in light mode, showing the moment an image has just been generated. At the very top is a simple mobile app header with a hamburger menu icon on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a right chevron beside it, and on the right a compose icon and a three-dot menu. Below that is the bottom portion of a rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text, visible across 4 lines: 「水彩や線画、油彩、カラー版画、 金箔アクセントなどを取り入れ てテクスチャも入れて立体的に、 芸術爆発させて」. Under the bubble, on a white background, place the gray system status line “Thought for a couple of seconds”, then a darker gray Japanese line “画像が作成されました”. Below that, centered and taking most of the lower half of the screen, display a large rounded-corner generated artwork preview. The artwork itself is an ultra-detailed cosmic visionary collage in a square format: a tiny glowing human figure stands at the vanishing point in the center bottom-middle, radiating light; two large semi-transparent human profiles or heads face inward from left and right midground; swirling galaxies, stars, nebulae, planets, floating geometric frames, transparent spheres, gold-leaf fragments, line art, splattered paint, and layered textures fill the scene. Use a dramatic palette of deep indigo, ultramarine, violet, magenta, white, and luminous gold, with explosive painterly energy combining watercolor, oil painting, printmaking, ink lines, and metallic foil accents. Include branching tree-like forms, abstract architectural steps on the right, a lotus-like flower on the left, multiple framed mini-scenes embedded in space, and dense luminous particle trails converging toward the central figure. The overall screenshot should feel like a real iPhone app capture, clean and minimal outside the artwork, with the generated image being the visual focal point.

items.content: A dark monochrome manga-style horror illustration on a pure black background, in a tall vertical poster composition. Centered at the bottom is a small lonely teenage boy with messy short dark hair, sitting on the ground with his knees pulled to his chest and his arms wrapped around them, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.

items.title: Cinematic Backlit Woman Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a moody, backlit fashion-style portrait of a woman with windblown hair, ideal for cinematic beauty editorials and atmospheric poster imagery.
items.content: A cinematic vertical portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up in a close half-body composition, positioned slightly right of center, with her body turned to the right and her head turned back toward the camera in a restrained over-the-shoulder pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"}, loose and slightly messy, being blown strongly through the frame so many strands lift outward and sweep across the air around her face and shoulders. Her visible styling is elegant and minimal: a dark thin-strap slip dress or camisole exposing the shoulder line, collarbone, and upper back, with a sheer black off-shoulder wrap or translucent outer layer slipping down the arms to create a soft dark framing shape around the lower body. The mood is cold, quiet, mysterious, and wistful, with a high-fashion cinematic realism rather than glamour polish. Use dramatic backlighting from the upper left, creating a bright halo along the hair, shoulder, and edge of the body, while the front of the figure stays mostly in shadow with only extremely soft fill light. The face is largely obscured in darkness and soft haze, emphasizing silhouette, neck, ear, shoulder, and luminous hair edges more than facial detail. The background is a dark gray to near-black empty space with 2 clear environmental elements: floating dust-like particles and soft circular bokeh light spots scattered mostly on the left side and around the hair. Overall color grading is low saturation with cool blue-gray shadows and slightly warm skin tones for subtle warm-cool contrast. Add diffused bloom, misty atmosphere, faint film grain, soft vignette, and shallow depth of field. Keep the eyes and lips de-emphasized or hidden in shadow, avoid hard frontal light, avoid bright busy background details, avoid cartoon styling, avoid oversharpening, and avoid plastic skin texture.

items.title: Fantasy Manga Spell Explosion Page
items.description: This prompt generates a high-impact monochrome fantasy manga page with a young mage unleashing a huge spell and a smaller reaction panel, suitable for comic storytelling or manga-style concept art.
items.content: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.

items.title: Japanese Izakaya Highball Poster
items.description: This generates a photorealistic Japanese izakaya promotional poster featuring a woman holding a highball, bold pricing text, and four featured dishes for restaurant advertising or nightlife-themed visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic Japanese izakaya advertisement poster in a warm, cinematic night-time mood, designed like a street-front restaurant flyer. The composition is vertical and densely layered. On the right side, a young Japanese woman with long straight dark brown to black hair, wearing a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, stands from the waist up and holds a large frosty glass mug of golden highball with visible ice cubes in her right hand near chest level. Her pose is relaxed and inviting, looking toward the camera, with a soft nightlife ambiance. The background is a narrow traditional izakaya exterior or interior alley scene filled with warm orange lantern light, shallow depth of field, hanging wooden menu plaques with handwritten Japanese calligraphy, and a nostalgic bustling-after-work atmosphere. In the upper left, a large weathered dark wooden signboard dominates the design, with bold white brushstroke kanji reading 蓮華食堂, small hiragana above it reading れんげしょくどう, and a red brush-painted banner beneath reading 大衆居酒屋. Below that on the left-center, place a large cream-colored paper or painted panel featuring the drink special in oversized calligraphic typography: ハイボール above a huge red 198円, with small black（税込） beside the price, the numerals painted in energetic brush style. Along the far right edge, add vertical white Japanese text reading 今日も一日、おかれさまです。 Near the lower right over the woman’s torso, place a red circular stamp-like badge with white handwritten text arranged diagonally and vertically: 旨い！安い！居心地◎. Across the bottom foreground, show exactly 4 plated menu items lined up side by side on rustic ceramic dishes: 1) two glazed grilled chicken skewers with char marks, labeled 焼き鳥 盛り合わせ and priced 580円; 2) a sashimi assortment with slices of tuna, salmon, white fish, shiso leaves and wasabi, labeled お刺身 盛り合わせ and priced 780円; 3) a plate of fried chicken karaage pieces with a lemon wedge, labeled 若鶏の唐揚げ and priced 480円; 4) sliced rolled dashi omelet topped with chopped green onion and served with grated daikon, labeled 出汁巻き玉子 and priced 380円. At the bottom left, include a glowing red paper lantern graphic with black vertical text 居酒屋. Across the bottom center on a dark band, add large bold white brush lettering reading でかい！うまい！安い！ and below it smaller white text reading みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！ Add a decorative red lotus-like emblem near the top sign and another matching emblem in the bottom right corner. Use rich amber highlights, strong contrast, glossy food styling, realistic skin and drink textures, commercial poster polish, and a nostalgic Showa-inspired izakaya promotion aesthetic.

items.title: Chinese Co-Branded Summer Drink Poster
items.description: A high-impact vertical Chinese advertising poster for a limited-time ice cream and coffee collaboration, suitable for brand campaigns, social ads, and product launch visuals.
items.content: Create a glossy Chinese co-branded beverage poster advertisement in a bold commercial style, vertical 4:5 composition, with a dramatic split-color background: bright saturated red on the left and vivid royal blue on the right, blended at the center with radiant streaks, motion lines, glow effects, and high-energy product-launch lighting. At the top, place 2 brand logo areas separated by a white multiplication sign: on the upper left, a snowman mascot logo with Chinese text {argument name="left brand name" default="蜜雪冰城"} and smaller subtitle text "始于1997冰淇淋与茶"; on the upper right, the deer logo and wordmark {argument name="right brand name" default="luckin coffee"} with smaller Chinese subtitle "专业咖啡新鲜式". Centered beneath the logos, add a huge Chinese headline in thick 3D extruded display typography with white faces, colored edging, heavy shadows, and a glossy embossed look, reading {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城 × 瑞幸咖啡"}, with the left half accented red and the right half accented blue. Below it, add a second slogan line in bold Chinese text, split by brand color, reading "冰爽甜蜜，咖啡加倍", flanked by short horizontal white dashes. Under that, place a rounded capsule banner in red-to-blue gradient containing the Chinese text "双品牌联名主打・人气招牌同框". In the center foreground, show 2 hero products: on the left, 1 vanilla soft-serve ice cream in a waffle cone, tall swirl, creamy white, slightly glossy, wrapped in a bright red cone sleeve printed with the snowman mascot and Chinese branding; on the right, 1 large clear plastic cup of iced latte or coffee with visible ice cubes, caramel-brown liquid marbling into milk, condensation droplets on the cup, a transparent lid, the blue deer logo, the wordmark "luckin coffee", and small Chinese subtitle text. Surround the cup with dynamic coffee splash arcs and exactly 3 flying coffee beans. Around the lower foreground, add scattered translucent ice cubes and white milk splashes to emphasize cold freshness. Include exactly 2 comic-style promotional burst badges: a red circular badge on the left reading "联名新品" and a blue circular badge on the right reading "限时热卖". In the bottom left corner, add 1 cute 3D snowman mascot character wearing a red cape and holding a tiny ice cream cone, smiling and winking. At the bottom center, place a large red-and-blue beveled ribbon banner with bold white Chinese text reading "今夏限定 立即尝鲜", ending with a yellow lightning bolt icon on the right. Along the very bottom edge, place 3 small selling-point items separated by vertical dividers: a snowflake icon with "冰爽甜蜜", a coffee bean icon with "咖啡加倍", and a heart icon with "双倍满足". Use premium e-commerce poster rendering, ultra-clean product retouching, glossy highlights, rich contrast, crisp Chinese typography, depth, reflections, splash effects, and an energetic summer limited-edition campaign aesthetic.

items.title: Fitness SaaS Landing Page UI
items.description: A massive, detailed prompt for generating a complete web and mobile UI/UX design for a premium fitness brand, including dashboards and various interface sections.

author.name: Stephen Day | Google AI, Agents & Vibe Coding

items.content:
Design a modern, high-end {argument name="app type" default="fitness app"} landing page and product UI for a brand called {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}.

Create a clean web design mockup that looks like a real SaaS fitness platform and mobile companion app. The design should feel premium, motivating, and easy to use, with a polished UI/UX style similar to top-tier health and wellness apps.

Include:
- A hero section with bold headline, short subheadline, strong call-to-action button, and app preview
- Dashboard UI showing daily activity, calories burned, workout streak, heart rate, step count, and progress rings
- Workout program cards for strength, cardio, mobility, and recovery
- Nutrition tracking section with macro breakdown and water intake
- Progress charts and analytics widgets
- Trainer/community section with profile cards and testimonials
- Pricing section and download/app store callout
- Mobile app screens shown alongside the web design for a cohesive product ecosystem

Style direction:
- Sleek, minimal, modern interface
- Premium fitness brand aesthetic
- Smooth spacing, strong hierarchy, rounded cards, soft shadows
- Dark mode UI with energetic accent colors like electric blue, neon green, or vibrant orange
- Crisp typography, realistic charts, polished buttons, beautiful onboarding feel
- Highly detailed, dribbble-worthy, startup-quality product design
- Realistic UX case study presentation, not a cartoon or illustration

Composition:
- Full website homepage mockup
- Multiple UI sections visible in one polished presentation
- Slight perspective or straight-on product showcase
- Clean background with subtle gradients and professional lighting
- Ultra-detailed, sharp text rendering, visually balanced layout

Output:
A stunning, realistic UI/UX design concept for a fitness app website and dashboard that looks ready for development.

Make it look like a real Figma product design presentation for a premium startup.

items.title: Pastel Anime Promo Poster
items.description: A colorful Japanese anime announcement poster featuring a white-haired mascot girl with multiple comedic inset scenes, ideal for recreating TV-series key visuals or parody promotional art.
items.content: Create a bright pastel anime promotional poster for a fictional slice-of-life comedy series. The composition is a single-page Japanese key visual with one central heroine surrounded by 5 inset moments and blocks of Japanese promotional text, like an anime announcement poster. The main character is {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}, a cute anime girl with short white hair fading slightly to silver, large vivid blue eyes, soft blush, and twin low ponytails tied near the shoulders. She wears an oversized black hood shaped like floppy dog ears, round silver goggles resting on top of her head, a black choker with a metallic round ornament, a futuristic white-and-black cropped sleeveless top with dark trim and a small emblem on the chest, detached black arm sleeves, very short white shorts with black edging, a thigh strap on one leg, and a small side pouch on her hip. Her body proportions are youthful anime stylization with a slim, petite build and slightly exaggerated chest, rendered in polished modern moe character design. In the center she stands full body, smiling gently and holding a pen in one hand as if she is about to make a mistake while writing, facing the viewer in a confident but sweet pose. Around her place 5 supporting vignette images of the same character: 1) upper left, a chibi-style scene of her outside with both hands thrown forward, crying dramatically with a huge open mouth; 2) lower left, a comic scene of her collapsed face-down on a desk or floor with scattered papers, exhausted and flustered; 3) upper right, a bust shot where she holds up a paper sign with Japanese writing, looking apologetic; 4) lower right, a cheerful half-body portrait with closed smiling eyes and one fist raised in encouragement; 5) a small background portrait in the top-right area behind text, used like a character callout. Include exactly 2 small white mascot creatures near the bottom center, both round and mochi-like with tiny dot eyes and tiny mouths, one larger and one smaller, floating or standing beside the heroine. Use a soft spring palette with pink, sky blue, mint green, peach, cream, and white, with scattered cherry blossom petals and rounded graphic shapes in the background. The background should feel airy and celebratory, with subtle outdoor scenery blur and decorative swooshes, stars, and bubbles. Fill the poster with Japanese typography in a playful commercial-anime style: a large multicolored title at top left, small header text above it, a red seasonal broadcast announcement, a pink "あらすじ" synopsis box on the left with several lines of body text, a blue explanatory box at bottom left, vertical and angled exclamatory phrases around the character, and a pink production-credit block at bottom right. Add a prominent character name banner in the upper right. Keep all text looking like authentic printed Japanese promotional copy, using rounded colorful fonts for the title and clean magazine-style fonts for the smaller text. Overall mood: adorable, comedic, slightly chaotic, professionally designed anime key art for a new TV series announcement in 16:9 landscape format.

items.title: Polaroid of Japanese Class Graduation Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a nostalgic realistic instant-film photograph of a Japanese high school class group portrait, ideal for school memory, graduation, or retro snapshot visuals.

author.name: やきいも｜週1クリエイトで飯を食う

items.content: A realistic instant film Polaroid photo lying flat on a light wooden tabletop, photographed from directly above. The instant print has a thick white border with a wider bottom margin and slight natural wear, with the photo area showing an indoor Japanese high school classroom group portrait. Inside the photo, about 35 graduating students in dark school uniforms are gathered in 4 loose rows in front of a green chalkboard, posing casually and tightly packed together. Most are teenage boys in black gakuran-style jackets or dark blazers with white shirts and ties, and several teenage girls wear dark blazers with blue plaid skirts. One girl near the front left stands out in a white cardigan and blue plaid skirt. Many students hold up peace signs, some crouch in front, and a few sit or recline on the wooden floor in the front row. Faces are intentionally obscured with soft square mosaic blurs, but the overall feeling is candid, nostalgic, and celebratory. On the chalkboard, hand-drawn Japanese graduation messages in chalk include large central text reading "3年B組" and celebratory doodles and writing around it such as graduation-themed congratulations. The classroom has white walls, a round wall clock above the chalkboard, a fluorescent ceiling light fixture, and subdued indoor lighting. The image should feel like a slightly dim early-2000s or 2010s snapshot with mild grain, soft focus, authentic flash photography, and natural color fading, emphasizing a sentimental end-of-school memory preserved as a physical instant print.

items.content: Create a polished Japanese promotional website hero banner for an AI creator community, in a clean modern tech-advertising style with a soft pastel blue, lavender, pink, and white palette. Wide 16:9 composition. On the left, place a gradient triangular abstract logo and the Japanese brand name {argument name="brand name" default="AIクリエイターズ・スタジオ"} at the top, followed by a thin horizontal divider line with a small sparkle in the middle. Below that, a very large bold Japanese headline in 2 lines: first line in dark navy, 「AIで、もっと自由に」, second line in large gradient letters from cyan to purple to pink, 「創る・学ぶ・つながる」. Under the headline, add a short Japanese subheadline with sparkle marks, 「AIを使ったクリエイティブの可能性を広げるメンバーシップコミュニティ」. On the right half, create a collage of 6 rounded-rectangle visual cards showing AI-generated creative examples: 1 large dreamy portrait of a woman in profile surrounded by flowers and butterflies in ethereal purple light, 1 small cyberpunk city nightscape with a lone figure, 1 small close-up portrait of a fluffy cat, 1 small luxury cosmetic bottle labeled “AI STUDIO”, 1 small bright seascape or flower-field landscape with a woman in white, and 1 large tablet drawing device on a desk with a stylus, plus a coffee mug and plant nearby. Add a circular gradient badge overlapping the right side with bold white Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="一緒に創造の未来をつくろう！"}. Across the lower middle, place a translucent white rounded feature panel containing exactly 5 equal columns with thin separators and pastel line icons. Each column has an icon, a bold Japanese title, and a smaller 2-line description. The 5 titles are: 「限定コンテンツ」, 「実践プロンプト＆テンプレート」, 「メンバー限定コミュニティ」, 「最新情報をいち早くお届け」, 「メンバー限定特典」. Use fitting icons for book, monitor, chat bubble, light bulb, and gift. Add concise Japanese descriptions beneath each title. At the very bottom, add a dark navy footer strip with a large Japanese call-to-action sentence in white and pink-purple gradient accent text, {argument name="footer text" default="AIを味方に、あなたの『創りたい』をカタチに。さあ、一緒に創ろう！"}. Overall look: premium startup landing page, glossy soft lighting, subtle sparkles, glassmorphism panels, clean typography, Japanese text rendered accurately, highly legible, visually balanced, professional social media thumbnail quality.

items.title: Boxing Impact Chat Screenshot
items.description: A photorealistic dark-mode chat screenshot featuring a dramatic boxing impact image, suitable for recreating viral social-media-style AI image demos.
items.content: A realistic smartphone screenshot of a dark-mode chat interface in Chinese, minimalist and modern, with a charcoal black background and lots of empty space. Near the upper right is a single rounded dark-gray message bubble containing the white Chinese text {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}. Below and to the left is one large embedded photo with rounded corners, occupying most of the lower-left half of the screen. The embedded photo shows the exact instant in a professional boxing match when one boxer lands a hard straight punch flush on the other boxer’s face. Two shirtless male boxers with muscular, sweaty bodies are inside a ring under arena lights. The boxer on the right is seen mostly from the back and side, extending his right arm fully across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are sharply defined, and he has short dark hair and tattooed arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim, and the glove is smashing into the left boxer’s face. The boxer on the left is recoiling from the impact, his head snapping sideways, with a spray of sweat and water droplets exploding outward around his head. He has a heavily tattooed left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and black trunks with large gold letters reading VICTOR across the waistband area. The ring ropes are red and white, with visible branding including PBC, and the dark blurred arena background includes bright signage reading RODRIGUEZ VS. The action photo should feel like a frozen high-speed sports photograph, dramatic, crisp, and photorealistic. Over both fighters’ faces are 2 rectangular mosaic-blur censor blocks, one on each face. Add small mobile UI overlay details on the image: the Chinese word 编辑 in white at the bottom-left corner of the photo and a circular share/upload icon at the bottom-right corner. Overall composition should look exactly like a casually shared AI-generated image shown inside a messaging app screenshot, clean, believable, and highly realistic.

items.title: Foreign Clerk in County Phone Shop
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic candid photo of a foreign shop clerk selling phones in a cluttered Chinese mobile phone store, useful for documentary-style social media imagery.
items.content: A realistic documentary-style smartphone photo inside a small county-town mobile phone shop in China, showing a candid sales interaction at the counter. A tall foreign man, about {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="Russian"}, stands behind a glass display case wearing a black jacket and a blue employee lanyard with badge, holding a smartphone in both hands as if introducing it to a customer. His face is deliberately blurred into a soft rectangular mosaic for privacy. In the foreground, a middle-aged Chinese male customer in a black jacket is seen from behind and slightly to the side, facing the clerk. The store is cramped, brightly lit, and visually cluttered with authentic retail details. Behind them are large smartphone brand posters and lightbox ads, including 2 major phone brand ads: vivo and oppo. There are 4 prominent Chinese promotional signs visible: a red overhead banner about buying phones and carrier service, a blue vertical installment-payment sign mentioning 0 down payment and 0 interest, a blue trade-in subsidy sign mentioning 1000 yuan, and a small counter sign promoting a Xiaomi model with a 6999 price. The glass counter contains multiple display phones, with 4 clearly visible upright demo phones on stands, plus scattered brochures and accessories beneath the glass. Add dense shelves of boxed accessories and hanging decorations in the background, with slightly messy composition, harsh indoor shop lighting, mild lens distortion, and the rough, unpolished realism of a casually taken phone snapshot. The mood should feel mundane, local, and faintly surreal because the foreign clerk appears completely integrated into an ordinary Chinese mobile phone store.

items.title: Xiaomi SU7 Exploded View Chat Screenshot
items.description: This generates a dark Chinese app-style screenshot featuring a premium keynote-quality exploded-view infographic of a Xiaomi SU7 electric car, useful for AI demo visuals and tech product presentation mockups.
items.content: A sleek Chinese social-media style screenshot on a dark charcoal black interface, minimalist and premium, with a large rounded rectangular image card placed in the lower left-center and a small rounded chat bubble in the upper right. The overall canvas is mostly empty dark space, giving a clean tech presentation feel. At the top left of the main area, show one line of bold white Chinese text reading: “换成小米汽车，我做一张更像发布会级别的整车爆炸分解图。” In the upper right, include a single gray rounded speech bubble with white Chinese text: “小米汽车的产品拆解图”. Below, display one featured poster-like infographic card with rounded corners and a glossy black background. Inside that card, create a highly polished exploded-view automotive product presentation for a turquoise {argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} electric sedan, shown in dramatic three-quarter front view, with the car body separated into many components suspended around the chassis. The hood is open, trunk lid lifted, four side doors detached and floating outward, front bumper and fascia separated, headlights isolated, interior exposed, and major mechanical and structural modules arranged neatly in layers beneath and around the body. The visual style should resemble a premium launch-event keynote slide: cinematic studio lighting, realistic reflections, sharp detail, dark background, subtle blue highlights, and precise technical composition. In the upper left of the infographic card, place large white Chinese title text in three lines: “小米汽车 SU7”, “产品拆解图”, “科技跨越，人车合一”. Add an orange square Xiaomi-style logo in the upper right corner of the card. Surround the car with 14 Chinese callout labels connected by thin white leader lines, identifying visible parts and systems. On the left side, include 6 labels for features such as integrated closed front fascia, LED headlights, front trunk design, high-voltage battery, front motor assembly, front double-wishbone suspension, and Brembo four-piston brake caliper. On the right side, include 8 labels for features such as electric tailgate, through-type taillight, frameless doors, hidden door handles, rear motor assembly, rear motor specs, all-aluminum alloy chassis, five-link rear suspension, and Michelin performance tires. Beneath the exploded car body, clearly show the battery pack, front and rear drive units, suspension subframes, wheel assemblies, braking components, front and rear seats, center console parts, underbody panels, and structural floor elements, all separated and floating in a carefully organized exploded arrangement. At the bottom of the infographic card, add a horizontal information strip divided into 5 columns of small Chinese specification text with headings for vehicle dimensions, power performance, range, intelligent driving, and safety structure. In the lower left of the card, place a bold white Chinese label “编辑”. In the lower center, include a circular down-arrow icon, and in the lower right, a share/export icon. The composition should look like a real screenshot from a Chinese AI chat app showcasing an automatically generated high-end car teardown infographic, with modern UI spacing, crisp typography, and a luxurious black-and-cyan color palette.

items.title: Fantasy Campfire Before a Crimson Mountain
items.description: A cinematic dark-fantasy image of 8 adventurers sheltering in a cave around a campfire while a glowing volcanic mountain looms outside, ideal for epic concept art or story illustration.
items.content: A cinematic fantasy scene inside a rocky cave during a blizzard, viewed from slightly above campfire level, with 8 characters seated in a circle around a small fire. Outside the cave mouth, a colossal dark mountain rises in the snowstorm, shaped like a sinister pyramid or volcanic fortress, split with glowing crimson-magenta fissures and crowned by a branching, ember-like red energy bloom at the summit; a ring of lava or fire glows at its base across the frozen landscape. The cave interior is warm, amber, and intimate, lit by the fire and a single ornate oil lamp on the right, contrasting with the cold blue-gray storm outside. The group should feel like a high-fantasy adventuring party resting together: 1 regal bird-like humanoid on the left with white feathers, a hooked beak, braided plumage, and layered tribal jewelry; 1 red-haired woman in the left foreground with long braided hair and ornate fantasy garments; 1 young elf-like traveler in blue sitting left of center; 1 small blond elf-like girl at center with pointed ears and clasped hands; 1 elderly king-like man on the right with long white hair, full beard, crown, and dark green robe with gold ornamentation; 1 elegant blond noblewoman beside him in embroidered formal dress; 1 white-haired figure in the foreground right seen mostly from behind in feathered or fur-trimmed clothing; and 1 blue-skinned aquatic-looking woman on the far right with a fin-like headdress, elaborate jewelry, and a cup in hand. Include cups, bowls, plates, bedrolls, sacks, and travel gear scattered around the cave edges. The composition should frame the terrifying glowing mountain through the cave opening behind the party, emphasizing the contrast between sheltered companionship and looming apocalyptic danger. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric and skin, dramatic volumetric firelight, snow streaks driven by wind, moody dark fantasy color grading, painterly realism, epic film still atmosphere, high contrast, rich shadows, masterpiece quality.

items.title: Fiery Butadon Japanese Ad Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic Japanese restaurant-style flyer for a thick-cut charcoal-grilled pork bowl, ideal for food promotions, social posts, or menu advertising.

author.name: メムロイロ🌽AI町おこし挑戦中

items.content: A dramatic Japanese food advertisement poster for a premium pork rice bowl, vertical composition, black and fiery orange background with glowing embers, smoke, and a high-contrast gourmet marketing look. The main focus is an oversized bowl of butadon in the lower center, filled with white rice and topped with many thick slices of glossy grilled pork belly, richly lacquered with dark sweet soy glaze, visible char marks, caramelized edges, and a stream of sauce pouring down from above onto the meat. Make the food look hyper-appetizing, juicy, rich, and slightly exaggerated like a restaurant flyer. Large bold brushed gold Japanese headline text dominates the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="帯広の肉厚豚丼"}. Across the middle, a gold paint-stroke banner contains black Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="極上の炭火焼き。極上のタレ。"}. On the right side, add a cute anime girl mascot standing behind the bowl, about half-body visible, wearing a black-and-white cow-themed hoodie with small horns, long blonde hair, frilly sleeves, and a shy delighted pose with one hand near her mouth; keep her face intentionally obscured by a plain beige rectangle censor block. Add vertical white Japanese copy along the right edge in 2 separate text groups: 1 at the upper right, 1 larger at the mid-to-lower right. Add a small handwritten-style white note near the girl with a tiny heart. In the lower left, include a dark circular callout badge with gold rim and white/yellow Japanese text about charcoal grilling and flavor. Along the very bottom, place 3 circular ingredient-feature icons with exact labels beneath them: raw pork slices labeled {argument name="feature label 1" default="肉厚!"}, glowing charcoal embers labeled {argument name="feature label 2" default="炭火焼き!"}, and glossy dark sauce labeled {argument name="feature label 3" default="極上ダレ!"}. At the bottom right, add a huge energetic gold brush-calligraphy slogan with splattered paint effects, plus a smaller white sentence beneath it. Use intense lighting, glossy highlights, premium yakiniku flyer aesthetics, dense Japanese typography, bold brush fonts, and a mouthwatering late-night food terror vibe.

items.title: Classical Chinese Scholar with XAI Motif
items.description: This prompt generates a faux-ancient Chinese scroll painting that blends a robed scholar portrait with XAI branding, a rocket launch, and scholarly scientific symbolism.
items.content: A refined Chinese ink-painting style portrait on aged parchment, composed like a classical literati hanging scroll with muted sepia, tan, charcoal, and faded indigo tones. In the center stands a scholarly male figure in flowing dark blue-black Hanfu robes with intricate gold-patterned trim and wide cream inner sleeves, posed front-facing with a dignified stance. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blurred block, while his hair is dark, wavy, and neatly styled. He holds a stitched traditional-style book against his chest with a vertical cover inscription that includes the large Latin letters "XAI" and 4 Chinese text columns beneath it. His other hand rests on an ornate armillary sphere set on a carved pedestal at the lower left. Behind him is a monumental shanshui landscape of 1 mountain range, layered mist, rocky peaks, and drifting clouds, rendered with fine brushwork in an old master style. In the upper right sky area, place 1 bold modern "XAI" logo with the stylized emblem above the letters, and to the far right include 1 slender rocket launching upward beside a launch tower, with smoke billowing into the clouds, blending futuristic aerospace imagery into the classical scene. On the upper left, add 1 vertical column group of Chinese calligraphy title text in black ink, plus 1 smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps beneath it. The overall effect should fuse ancient Chinese scholar portraiture with space-age technology and AI symbolism, highly detailed, elegant, balanced, and slightly satirical, with the texture of antique paper and the composition of a museum-quality scroll painting.

items.title: Ancient Scholar AI Safety Poster
items.description: This generates a parchment-style classical Chinese scholar poster with Claude branding and AI safety symbolism, suitable for editorial art, concept posters, or cultural-tech visual essays.
items.content:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. In the upper center-right, place the Claude logo with a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word “Claude” in dark serif lettering. On the upper left, add a large vertical title in Chinese, “德米斯圖”, with 1 vertical column of smaller Chinese calligraphy text beside it reading: “以語言為媒，理解為舟，助人洞見，推動協作，造福人類，安全可信，通往更美好的未來。” Add a smaller vertical signature line on the far left reading “甲辰春寫” with 2 red seal stamps below it. The background shows a classical Chinese landscape painting with distant mountains, a small pavilion on a cliff, mist, and dense bamboo leaves framing the upper right and right edge, plus dark pine branches on the lower left.

The wooden desk fills the lower third and contains exactly 8 distinct object groups: 1 brush pot holding 4 brushes on the left, 1 stack of 4 stitched books with Chinese titles on the spines reading “人工智慧概論”, “機器學習原理”, “負責任的 AI”, and “對齊與價值觀”, 1 ink stone or ink dish near the center-left, 1 central parchment diagram sheet, 1 small dark cube seal near the bottom left with Chinese characters on two visible faces, 1 framed placard on the right, 1 rolled scroll at the bottom right, and 1 tabletop surface with visible wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled “AI 安全 Safety” connected to 6 surrounding nodes labeled “準確”, “可靠”, “有益”, “透明”, “對齊”, and “隱私”, with delicate cloud motifs around the diagram. The framed placard on the right should read “AI 安全原則” as a header and list 4 bullet points in Chinese: “減少災難性風險”, “尊重人類價值觀”, “確保系統可控”, and “促進長遠福祉”. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

items.title: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision
items.description: This prompt generates a faux-classical Chinese scroll painting that satirically portrays Google DeepMind as a philosophical vision in an ancient mythic setting.
items.content: A sepia-toned ancient Chinese scroll painting reimagined as a visionary propaganda-style scene. In the center stands a scholarly robed figure styled like an imperial sage or philosopher, wearing flowing blue-gray hanfu with ornate trim, addressing a crowd of exactly 8 followers seen mostly from behind in the foreground. The sage’s face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur, and 3 members of the crowd also have blurred rectangular faces. The central figure raises one hand in a teaching gesture and holds a glowing geometric polyhedron crystal in the other hand. Behind him is a monumental hanging banner or framed plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words “Google DeepMind.” The background is a richly detailed traditional shanshui landscape with layered mountains, mist, trees, rocky formations, and a pagoda temple on the right. Along the upper right side, include vertical Chinese calligraphy text headed by “德米斯願景圖,” followed by several elegant columns of classical-style writing, plus a smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps. Use aged paper texture, muted brown ink, faded mineral pigments, fine linework, and the composition of a historic Chinese hanging scroll or literati painting, but with subtle anachronistic modern-AI symbolism. The overall mood is solemn, mythic, intellectual, and satirical, blending traditional East Asian art with corporate AI iconography.

items.title: Ancient Scroll Scholar Riding Dragon
items.description: This prompt generates a classical Chinese scroll-style fantasy portrait of a robed scholar on a dragon with calligraphy and subtle modern AI symbols, ideal for poster art or stylized editorial imagery.
items.content: An ancient Chinese ink-and-wash style portrait on aged tan parchment, composed like a classical hanging scroll. A scholarly East Asian man in flowing gray-blue robes sits side-saddle atop a long serpentine Chinese dragon emerging through swirling clouds. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in parchment-brown tones. He has short dark curly hair and wears layered traditional robes with ornate patterned trim, a dark sash belt, and two modern OpenAI knot emblems worked into the costume: one printed on the chest and one on a round hand fan he holds upright in his right hand. His left hand rests near the dragon's mane as if holding the creature steady. The dragon is large and detailed, with blue-green scales, a pale underbelly, reddish-brown mane and fin accents, antler-like horns, whiskers, bared teeth, and a fierce expressive face in the lower left foreground, while its body coils upward to the upper right. Surround the figures with mist, stylized clouds, and steep craggy mountain peaks fading into the background. Add a vertical column of black Chinese calligraphy at the upper left and 3 red seal stamps near the lower part of the inscription area. The palette is muted, dusty, and antique: parchment beige, faded teal, moss green, smoky gray, sepia, and rust. Overall feeling: mythical, scholarly, dignified, slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI iconography. Highly detailed brushwork, weathered paper texture, elegant composition, no border, full-frame vertical artwork.

items.title: Censored Mona Lisa Oil Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a Renaissance-style Mona Lisa parody with the face replaced by a solid censor block, ideal for surreal fine-art edits and meme-like museum imagery.
items.content: A faithful oil-painting parody of the Mona Lisa in the style of a High Renaissance museum masterpiece, waist-up seated portrait with folded hands, dark brown dress, translucent veil, soft golden-brown sfumato lighting, and the classic hazy landscape with winding paths, water, and rocky hills in the background. Replace the entire face area with a single flat rectangular censor block in {argument name="censor color" default="medium brown"}, centered over the head and covering from forehead to chin, with clean hard edges that contrast against the painterly surface. Keep the hair visible around the block, including light brown hair parted at the top and falling over the shoulders. Preserve the aged varnish look, muted earthy palette, subtle craquelure-like texture, and solemn museum-quality composition. Vertical framing, centered subject, realistic proportions, old master brushwork, dramatic but soft shading.

items.title: Minecraft Ender Dragon Fantasy Poster
items.description: A cinematic Minecraft-inspired dark fantasy poster showing a lone hero confronting a colossal Ender Dragon, ideal for game cover art, event key visuals, or epic promotional posters.
items.content: Create a dramatic vertical dark-fantasy poster in a Minecraft-inspired voxel style, like an epic movie or game cover. At the very top, place a large ornate metallic-gold blackletter title reading {argument name="headline text" default="[Heliocore.C6]"}, with a smaller elegant serif subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle" default="The Final Convergence"}. The main scene shows 1 massive Ender Dragon made of black cubic blocks, flying forward and downward out of the sky with its wings spread wide, mouth open, glowing purple eyes, and violet energy in its throat, while chunks of voxel debris break apart around its body. Behind the dragon, place 3 large concentric glowing magic circles with arcane runes and geometric symbols in pale gold light, centered in the sky like a summoning seal. In the foreground, show 1 blocky hero seen from behind, resembling Steve, standing on a ruined stone staircase-throne and raising 1 glowing purple enchanted sword toward the dragon. Surround the platform with 4 visible Endermen total, tall and slender with black blocky bodies and glowing purple eyes, acting as ominous witnesses. The environment is an enormous ruined End-city style abyss with towering broken pillars, floating block fragments, crystal clusters, and distant structures fading into purple fog. Use a palette of black, charcoal, deep violet, magenta glow, and antique gold highlights, with cinematic volumetric lighting, heavy atmosphere, sparks, dust, magical particles, extreme scale, high contrast, and a polished ultra-detailed poster composition.

items.title: Low-Angle Anime Bunny Girls in Ruins
items.description: This prompt generates a tilted low-angle anime poster of two bunny-suited girls against a ruined cathedral background, useful for recreating stylized character-and-background compositions with dramatic perspective.
items.content: A dynamic anime-style low-angle illustration of two young women in rabbit-themed bodysuits, viewed from below as if the camera is tilted upward and they are looking slightly down toward the viewer. The left girl has {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair in short twin pigtails with curled ends, large red bunny ears, and a glossy bright red high-cut bodysuit with puff sleeves, long opera gloves, a sweetheart-shaped chest panel, and 4 round silver button-like discs on the front. The right girl has long straight brown hair, pale bunny ears, and a glossy white and pale pink version of the same bodysuit design, also with puff sleeves, long gloves, sweetheart chest panel, and 4 round silver discs. Both have slim builds, long legs, expressive wide anime eyes, and mildly surprised, curious expressions as they glance toward each other and slightly toward the viewer. Their hands hang loosely at their sides, almost touching in the center. Place them in front of a vast ruined cathedral or decayed grand stone building with broken arches, skeletal metal framework, shattered windows, and crumbling debris, rendered as a soft-painted anime background. Use a dramatic Dutch angle and strong perspective so the architecture leans with the camera tilt and the characters feel towering and close to the lens. Bright blue sky with large white clouds behind the ruins. Clean cel shading on the characters, painterly detailed background, crisp line art, vibrant but slightly weathered color palette, cinematic composition. Add 3 text elements in the upper right area as graphic design overlay: small uppercase text "ARINKO AGENTS", large bold Japanese text "平和島", and a large white handwritten signature-like script overlapping the background.

items.title: Vintage Chinese SpaceX Propaganda Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a retro Chinese-style propaganda poster featuring a SpaceX rocket, a heroic worker portrait, and a bold slogan, suitable for satirical political art or retro-futurist design.
items.content: A vintage socialist propaganda poster in a mid-20th-century Chinese style, printed on aged paper with a warm sepia tint, distressed texture, faded ink, and slightly worn edges. The composition is vertical and heroic. On the right half of the poster, show a large waist-up portrait of a male worker or revolutionary figure wearing a dark cap and a dark utilitarian jacket, facing slightly to the left with a stoic, determined expression. On the left-center, a white reusable rocket rises upward with bright engine flame, depicted like an aspirational symbol of technological progress; the rocket has the word "SPACEX" written vertically on its body and visible landing legs near the base. Behind the rocket, fill the sky with dramatic cream-colored sunburst rays spreading outward across a muted blue background. In the lower left, include a cheering crowd of exactly 6 factory workers or citizens in blue-gray uniforms, raising their hands in celebration, with one large red flag waving beside them. Add faint industrial city elements and launch-tower silhouettes behind the crowd. At the bottom, reserve a wide text panel with large bold red Chinese slogan lettering in two lines reading: "今天回收火箭，明天建设星际家园！". Use a screen-printed poster look, painterly realism, limited palette of dusty blue, cream, brick red, and dark olive, with strong ideological poster composition, triumphant mood, and retro-futurist space-race symbolism.

items.title: Moonlit Anime Horror Cosplay Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic vertical anime-horror promotional poster with a moonlit couple, two shadowy background figures, and a dark supernatural romance atmosphere.
items.content: A dark, cinematic anime-horror key visual in a vertical poster composition, set at night inside or beside a shattered window with a huge glowing full moon dominating the background. In the center foreground, a young couple stands in an intimate embrace. The male figure is tall and slim, wearing a dark brown or charcoal hoodie with the hood up, white drawstrings, subtle red blood-like stains on the sleeve and lower hem, and dark red pants. His skin is pale, his long black hair falls over one eye, and the lower half of his face is wrapped in dirty white bandages stained with blood, giving him a disturbing but protective antihero presence. One hand and wrist are also wrapped in bandages. He looks slightly upward and away with a solemn, haunted expression while holding the girl around her back. The female figure is petite with extremely long straight platinum-blonde hair reaching past her waist, wearing a loose white coat or cardigan over a black-and-white outfit and a black choker. She faces him closely with both hands clasped together against his chest, creating a tender contrast against the horror atmosphere. Add 2 ghostly supporting figures in the background: on the left, a pale blonde girl in shadow wearing striped clothing and holding an object close to her chest; on the right, a hooded male figure in profile with glasses or sharp facial lines, his hood marked by a dark blood stain. The environment is filled with floating shards of broken glass, blue moonlight, dust motes, and star-like particles, with deep navy, black, and icy blue tones throughout. Place a stylized red Japanese title at the top right, {argument name="headline text" default="殺戮の天使"}, with a smaller red serif English subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Memory Collection"}. items.title: Anime Wedding Poster at a Church
items.description: A dramatic anime-style wedding poster featuring a bride and groom before a flower-decorated church, ideal for recreating a romantic light-novel or anime promotional visual.
items.content: A vertical anime-inspired wedding key visual poster that blends live-action cosplay-style newlyweds in the foreground with illustrated anime girls surrounding them, set in front of a sunlit stone church under a brilliant deep blue sky. In the center foreground, a bride and groom pose for a dramatic selfie-like shot with their arms reaching toward the viewer. The groom is a youthful androgynous character with {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} shaggy short hair, wearing a crisp white wedding suit, white shirt, and white tie, smiling and making a playful hand sign near his face. The bride has {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple-black"} hair in short twin tails and wears an ornate white wedding dress with layered lace, veil, pearl choker, long white gloves, and holds a bouquet of white roses. Behind them rises a beautiful European-style church with a tall steeple, floral garlands over the entrance, stained glass, and warm sunlight bursting from the left side, creating lens flare and sparkling highlights. The sky is filled with fluffy white clouds, flying white birds, a faint rainbow streak, and drifting pink flower petals. Around the edges are 6 anime schoolgirl portraits in dark school uniforms with red or yellow ribbon bows, each showing a different emotional expression: top left brown-haired girl reaching forward, upper left purple-haired girl with an eyepatch looking flustered, lower left pink-haired cheerful girl, top right brown-haired girl extending a gloved hand, mid-right dark-haired boy in school uniform, lower right brown-haired shy girl, and bottom right small blonde girl with an excited open-mouth expression. Add ornate decorative corner filigree framing the poster. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="さあ、契約の時間だ— 私たちの永遠を誓おう"}. Place a large colorful Japanese title across the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="中二病でも恋がしたい！"} in bold blue and pink outlined typography, with a small romanized subtitle beneath it reading "Chu-2 byo demo KOI ga shitai!" and small credits near the bottom reading {argument name="credit text" default="富樫勇太　小鳥遊六花"}. Overall look: dazzling, romantic, sentimental, nostalgic anime movie poster, ultra-detailed, glossy lighting, magical sparkle effects, vivid colors, polished promotional composition.

items.title: Cinematic Woman in Vintage Library
items.description: This prompt generates a warm 16:9 photorealistic period-style portrait of an elegant woman in a book-lined study, suitable for historical drama visuals or cinematic character art.
items.content: A cinematic waist-up portrait of a refined woman in an old-fashioned library, turned slightly to the left and seated or standing close to the camera, with her face centered and partly in soft shadow. She has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair styled in an elegant Edwardian or early 20th-century updo with volume at the crown and loose curled strands framing the sides. She wears a high-necked {argument name="dress color" default="cream-gold"} lace dress with intricate floral texture and delicate trim, plus one visible dangling earring. The setting is a warm, intimate study with 2 tall wooden bookcases filled with aged books in brown, green, and muted blue tones, and on the far left a softly glowing window with a sheer curtain beside 1 framed wall picture. Use golden-hour indoor lighting, amber highlights, shallow depth of field, rich wood tones, soft filmic contrast, realistic skin and fabric detail, and a quiet historical-drama mood. Compose it in a 16:9 frame, medium close-up, photorealistic, luxurious, subtle, and painterly without looking illustrated.

items.content: A realistic 16:9 close-up photograph of a sheet of slightly textured white paper resting diagonally on a medium-brown wooden table, viewed from a shallow overhead angle. On the paper, a short French poem is handwritten neatly in elegant cursive with vivid {argument name="ink color" default="blue"} ink. The title at the top center reads {argument name="poem title" default="Pigeon"}. Beneath it are exactly 4 lines of handwriting, centered and evenly spaced: {argument name="poem line 1" default="Oiseau à la grise robe,"}, {argument name="poem line 2" default="Dans l'enfer des villes"}, "À mon regard tu te dérobes", and "Tu es vraiment le plus agile." Keep the handwriting graceful, legible, and natural, like careful fountain-pen calligraphy by hand rather than typography. Soft warm indoor lighting, subtle shadows along the paper edges, visible paper grain, and a simple uncluttered composition focused entirely on the handwritten poem.

items.title: Xuanwu Gate Incident Moments Post
items.description: This prompt generates a satirical image of the Xuanwu Gate Incident presented as a Chinese social-media Moments post alongside a cinematic Tang-dynasty battle scene.
items.content: A humorous, highly detailed composite image showing a modern smartphone displaying a Chinese social-media Moments post about the Xuanwu Gate Incident, placed on the left side of the frame, with the posted battle image expanded into a large cinematic historical scene filling the right side. The phone should look like a black iPhone with thin bezels and a top notch, shown front-facing. On the phone screen, the app header bar is dark gray-black and reads “朋友圈” in white, with a back arrow on the left and a camera icon on the right. Below it is a social post from {argument name="poster name" default="唐王世民"}, with a small square profile avatar of an ancient Chinese warrior in armor and helmet. Under the name is a location pin and the text “长安·玄武门”, and a timestamp line “唐武德九年六月初四 巳时”. The main post text in Chinese says: “吾为国家除逆贼，请社稷。今日玄武门，功在千秋！⚔️💪”. Beneath the text is a square battle image preview matching the large scene on the right. Below the image is a metadata row showing exactly three items: “3.8万次浏览”, “赞 (666)”, and “(128)” beside a comment icon. Under that is a comments box with exactly 5 visible commenters, each with a tiny avatar and Chinese text styled like supportive social-media replies from historical figures. The comments should include these names in Chinese: “尉迟恭”, “房玄龄”, “李渊”, “杜如晦”, and “长孙无忌”, with the tone praising the success of the action; one comment line should suggest the emperor is shocked and the state is secured. The right side is a dramatic Tang-dynasty battle painting at sunset outside {argument name="gate name" default="玄武门"}, with a massive gray stone gate tower and the gate plaque reading “玄武门”. In the center foreground, a mounted armored archer in red-plumed helmet draws a bow while riding a brown horse; around him are exactly 7 clearly visible mounted or standing soldiers in Tang armor, plus 1 fallen armored figure on the ground pointing upward. Multiple yellow battle flags with the large black character “唐” wave through the dust; show at least 4 visible flags. Arrows fly through the sky, horses rear and turn, and the air is filled with dust, warm sunset light, and battlefield motion. The visual style is realistic historical epic key art with painterly detail, but the overall concept is comedic and anachronistic because it presents an ancient coup as a social-media朋友圈 post. Keep all visible interface text in Chinese, maintain believable mobile UI spacing, and blend the phone mockup with the expanded battle artwork in one widescreen composition.

items.title: Wet Summer Anime Schoolgirl Portrait
items.description: A glossy anime illustration prompt for creating a sunlit summer school pool portrait with wet clothing, sparkling water effects, and cinematic backlighting.
items.content: A luminous anime-style summer portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} shown from the chest up in side profile, standing outdoors under an intense blue sky with bright white clouds. She has a short wet bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"}, large sparkling blue-violet eyes, soft blush on her cheeks, and a calm, slightly distant expression. Her white sailor school uniform shirt is soaked and semi-translucent, clinging realistically to the fabric folds, with a deep navy sailor collar and a large navy ribbon at the chest. She raises one arm and presses a clear ridged plastic water bottle against her forehead, with cold water droplets running down her face, neck, arm, and clothing. The scene is filled with strong summer sunlight, glossy highlights, rim light through damp hair strands, rainbow lens flares, tiny floating bubbles, and glittering reflections. In the background, include a softly blurred outdoor school pool area with metal railings, a pool ladder, and shimmering water. Emphasize crystalline transparency in the bottle, wet skin sheen, delicate eyelashes, detailed anime rendering, dramatic backlighting, refreshing heat-of-summer atmosphere, and a polished high-end illustration style.

Outside the generated image preview but still within the ChatGPT app screenshot, show a horizontal row of 4 action icons below the image: thumbs up, thumbs down, share/export, and more.
