items.description: This prompt generates a bold, high-contrast anime fashion illustration of a black-haired goth girl biting a playground bar, ideal for stylized character art and eye-catching social media visuals.
items.content: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a pale goth girl in a colorful urban playground, shown in a close medium shot as she leans forward and bites a horizontal metal bar with a mischievous, slightly defiant expression. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} hair with blunt bangs, vivid red eyes, and a delicate face with a small mouth partly pressed against the bar. Her hair is decorated with 3 geometric hair clips on the right side: 1 red triangle clip, 1 blue angular clip, and 1 small gold ring clip. She wears multiple ear piercings including several studs and dangling industrial-style earrings. Her outfit is a black techwear-goth ensemble with 5 visible key pieces: 1 cropped black jacket with red and blue accent stripes, 1 black choker, 1 strappy black top or dress with front buckles, 1 wide black belt with metal hardware, and 1 hanging waist chain. Her sleeves are long and oversized, with white stripe details on one forearm. Both hands grip the bar, one near her mouth and one farther to the side, creating an intimate confrontational pose. The setting is a playground with bright primary-colored equipment: blue posts, red connectors, yellow and red climbing bars, and a patterned rubber floor made of bold geometric blocks in blue, red, yellow, white, and black. In the background are dark green trees and a dramatic graphic sky with large flat shapes in red, orange, blue, black, and white, plus circular sun-like dots, giving the whole scene a posterized pop-art look. Include 1 vertical warning sticker on the left blue post with Japanese text and a small caution icon. Use crisp cel shading, sharp linework, slight glitchy texture accents, ultra-saturated colors, high contrast, a moody cyber-goth fashion vibe, and a dynamic composition centered on the girl's intense gaze and the metal bar.

items.title: Steampunk Zodiac Anatomy Poster
items.description: A complex professional prompt for creating a vintage steampunk-style zodiac anatomy poster with mechanical structures and aged parchment textures.
items.content: 你是一位专业复古蒸汽朋克解剖图谱设计师，擅长星座机械结构科普海报。根据用户指定的【{argument name="星座名称" default="射手座 / Sagittarius"}】，生成一张复古蒸汽朋克风格星座解剖图谱海报：顶部标题栏为“{argument name="中文标题" default="射手座解剖图谱"}”或“ANATOMIA {argument name="英文标题" default="Sagittarius"}”，采用复古丝带横幅设计；背景为做旧羊皮纸/泛黄旧纸张纹理，带自然污渍与折痕，营造复古科学手稿质感；中心主体为该星座经典神话形象，内部结构替换为精密齿轮、管线、金属骨骼等蒸汽朋克元素；所有图标与插画为手绘线稿风格，用箭头或连线展示逻辑关系；主色调为暖棕、米黄、古铜色，点缀少量高对比色彩突出重点；画面分左右两栏，中心为主体形象，两侧分布功能模块，底部为总结与表格。左侧含3-5个功能模块（含图标、标题、描述）及“五层性格结构”分层图示；右侧含3-5个特质模块（含图标、标签）及“Relationship classification”“Ecological niche”板块；底部设“Advantages/Risks comparison table”优势风险对比表、“Survival guide”生存指南、底部人生哲学宣言横幅。整体严谨精致、复古机械美学，文字清晰可读 4K高清，直接出图。
items.translatedContent: You are a professional vintage steampunk anatomical atlas designer, specializing in constellation mechanical structure science posters. Based on the specified 【{argument name="constellation" default="Sagittarius"}】, generate a vintage steampunk style constellation anatomical atlas poster: top title bar says "{argument name="CN title" default="Sagittarius Anatomy Atlas"}" or "ANATOMIA {argument name="EN title" default="Sagittarius"}" using a vintage ribbon banner design; background is aged parchment/yellowed old paper texture with natural stains and creases to create a vintage scientific manuscript feel; central subject is the classic mythological image of the constellation, with internal structures replaced by precision gears, pipelines, metal bones, and other steampunk elements; all icons and illustrations are hand-drawn line art style, using arrows or lines to show logical relationships; primary colors are warm brown, beige, and bronze, with small high-contrast accents to highlight key points; the layout is divided into left and right columns with the main image in the center, functional modules on both sides, and summaries/tables at the bottom. The overall style is rigorous, exquisite, and follows a retro-mechanical aesthetic, with clear readable text in 4K HD.

items.title: Chinese Livestream Rocket Gala Edit
items.description: This prompt turns a portrait reference into a flashy Chinese livestream screenshot with celebratory UI overlays, fireworks, gifts, and a rocket-launch spectacle for social-media mockups or viral demo images.
items.content: Using the provided reference photo, transform the person into a flashy Chinese livestream screenshot while keeping the same head position, crop, hairstyle, and overall identity. Replace the outdoor umbrella-and-street background with a dramatic night city skyline scene filled with fireworks, and add a large rocket launch on the right side. Change the clothing to a dark business blazer over a light blue dress shirt to make the subject look like a high-value livestream VIP guest. Overlay a polished live-stream app interface in Chinese: top left profile area with the name "王树芝兰", a red "关注" button, and the line "12.8万本场浪费"; top left ranking tag "🔥小时榜第1名"; top center a glowing neon celebratory headline in 2 lines reading "感谢榜一大哥" and "的大火箭嘉年华" with heart and sparkle decorations; top right 4 small circular viewer avatars, the count "1.3万", a close "×" icon, and the label "更多直播". On the left side add 2 gift notification cards: "神秘大哥 送 大火箭 x1" and "可乐加冰 送 嘉年华 x1". Below that add 5 stacked chat bubbles with exact visible usernames and messages: 1) "榜1 神秘大哥：大火箭送给最棒的主播！" followed by 6 party popper emojis, 2) "小美：哇！嘉年华太震撼了！😍😍😍", 3) "阳光男孩：主播真棒，支持支持！👍👍👍", 4) "快乐星球：666666，太厉害了！", 5) "路人甲：大哥威武！主播加油！". Add a bottom translucent comment bar with "说点什么...". Add 5 bottom action icons: smiley, colorful swirl, heart, gift box, and three dots. Add a vertical stream of 4 floating heart reactions on the lower right. Make the composite look like a convincing, high-end social app livestream screenshot with smooth Chinese typography, vivid neon colors, realistic UI integration, and festive viral spectacle.

items.title: Anime Martial Arts Dojo Duel
items.description: This prompt generates a high-energy anime-style two-girl martial arts battle scene in a wooden dojo, ideal for dramatic promotional art or social media visuals.
items.content: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading {argument name="watermark text" default="UM YouMind"}.

items.content:
A high-resolution museum-style photograph of a traditional Chinese calligraphy handscroll on aged beige xuan paper, shown flat and filling the frame with no mounting border visible. The composition is a single elegant work of running-script brush calligraphy in deep black ink, arranged in 11 vertical columns read right to left. The main text is the poem title and verse of {argument name="poem text" default="定風波
莫聽穿林打葉聲
何妨吟嘯且徐行
竹杖芒鞋輕勝馬
誰怕
一蓑煙雨任平生
料峭春風吹酒醒
微冷
山頭斜照卻相迎
回首向來蕭瑟處

items.title: WSJ-Style Business Newspaper Front Page
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic financial newspaper front page on a desk, ideal for editorial mockups, announcement satire, and high-fidelity AI typography demos.
items.content: A photorealistic overhead three-quarter view of a folded financial newspaper on a dark wooden desk, styled like a prestigious American business daily from the 1980s–2000s, with crisp realistic newsprint texture, subtle paper wrinkles, slightly worn folded edges, and warm morning sunlight casting diagonal window-shadow bands across the page. The masthead dominates the top in large classic serif capitals reading {argument name="newspaper name" default="THE WALL STREET DAILY."}. Directly beneath it is a thin header strip with small financial-paper details: "DOW JONES", "News Corp", the date line "MONDAY, APRIL 20, 2026 – VOL. CCLXXXV NO. 90", "WSJ.com", a star rating row, and the price "$5.00". The main lead story spans the upper center-left with a huge bold serif headline reading {argument name="main headline" default="Cook to Step Down as Apple CEO; Ternus Named Successor"}. Below it is a smaller serif subheadline: "Transition caps 15-year run; company pivots to AI-driven future". Add a byline line in small caps with 2 reporters: "By Tim Higgins" and "And Joanna Stern". Fill the lead article with dense, fully legible multi-column newspaper body text about Tim Cook stepping down as Apple chief executive, John Ternus succeeding him, Apple's growth, AI strategy, and corporate transition; the text should read like authentic financial journalism, not placeholder gibberish. On the right half of the lead story, place a black-and-white engraved stipple portrait of a male executive in collared shirt and jacket, centered in a rectangular image area; the face is partially obscured by a pale gray square censor block over the eyes and upper nose, creating a modern satirical effect. At the top-right, include a sidebar box titled "What’s New" with exactly 2 subsection headers, "Business & Finance" and "World-Wide", each followed by bullet-point briefs in small serif text; include exactly 3 bullets under "Business & Finance" and exactly 4 bullets under "World-Wide", all fully typeset and legible. Beneath the main story, add a secondary banner article across the page titled "Silicon Valley Braces for New Chapter in AI Arms Race" with a byline "By Liz Hoffman" and several short columns of text about big tech, startups, OpenAI, Google, Meta, chips, platforms, and AI competition. To the right of this lower-middle section, insert a compact markets table titled "Markets" with exactly 4 rows labeled "DOW JONES", "S&P 500", "NASDAQ", and "10-YR. TREASURY", with columns for index/value/change/percent and realistic numeric values in tight newspaper tabular formatting. Along the bottom strip of the front page, include exactly 3 teaser boxes: left box with section label "Heard on the Street" and headline "Why Investors Are Rethinking Big Tech" plus page marker "B12"; center box with section label "Markets" and headline "Earnings Season Lifts Stocks Despite Rate Uncertainty" plus page marker "B1"; right box with section label "Inside" and headline "Private Credit Sees Inflow Surge as Yields Stay High" plus page marker "B14". Make all typography clean, sharp, perfectly legible, and consistently aligned in authentic newspaper grid layout with thin rules between columns, justified text, classic serif fonts, and realistic print contrast. The newspaper sits slightly rotated clockwise on the desk. In the environment, show a white ceramic coffee cup filled with black coffee in the top-right corner and a pair of dark-framed eyeglasses resting near the lower-right edge of the paper. In the top-left corner, include the cropped edge of a dark cylindrical object, likely a camera lens or tumbler. Overall mood: premium editorial mock front page, serious business-news aesthetic, believable print photography, ultra-detailed, natural shadows, high resolution.

items.title: Retro RPG Item Grid Prompt
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating a 10x10 grid of 100 diverse fantasy RPG items in a classic 16-bit or 32-bit pixel art style, organized by category.
items.content: 创建一个 {argument name="网格尺寸" default="10×10"} 的网格，其中包含 {argument name="物品数量" default="100"} 种不同的奇幻角色扮演游戏 (RPG) 物品，采用{argument name="艺术风格" default="经典的像素艺术风格"}（16 位或 32 位精灵图风格，类似于 SNES/GBA 时代的日式角色扮演游戏）。每个物品应单独占据一个正方形图块，并在下方附上简短清晰的标签。网格应整齐排列在白色背景上。确保每个物品在视觉上都独具特色，并且每个标签的拼写都正确。使用清晰的像素边缘，每个精灵使用有限的调色板，并使用轻微的抖动效果来表现阴影。使用以下行主题：第 1 行：剑和刀剑；第 2 行：盾牌和盔甲；第 3 行：弓、弩和远程武器；第 4 行：法杖、魔杖 and 魔法法器；第 5 行：药水、药剂 and 药瓶；第 6 行：卷轴、典籍 and 魔法书；第 7 行：戒指、护身符 and 附魔饰品；第 8 行：头盔、王冠 and 头饰；第 9 行：钥匙、圣物 and 任务物品；第 10 行：宝石、符文 and 制作材料。将每个图块显示为居中的物品精灵，置于干净的背景方块上，并以经典的物品栏图标形式呈现——类似于你在奇幻角色扮演游戏菜单中看到的那种。保持整体风格的一致性、连贯性，并让人联想起备受喜爱的复古奇幻角色扮演游戏——既迷人又精致，即使在小尺寸下也清晰易读。
items.translatedContent: Create a {argument name="grid size" default="10x10"} grid containing {argument name="item count" default="100"} different fantasy role-playing game (RPG) items in a {argument name="art style" default="classic pixel art style"} (16-bit or 32-bit sprite style, similar to Japanese RPGs from the SNES/GBA era). Each item should occupy a square tile individually with a short, clear label below. The grid should be neatly arranged on a white background. Ensure each item is visually unique and every label is spelled correctly. Use clean pixel edges, a limited palette for each sprite, and subtle dithering for shadows. Use the following row themes: Row 1: Swords and blades; Row 2: Shields and armor; Row 3: Bows, crossbows, and ranged weapons; Row 4: Staves, wands, and magical implements; Row 5: Potions, elixirs, and bottles; Row 6: Scrolls, grimoires, and spellbooks; Row 7: Rings, amulets, and enchanted accessories; Row 8: Helmets, crowns, and headgear; Row 9: Keys, relics, and quest items; Row 10: Gems, runes, and crafting materials. Display each tile as a centered item sprite on a clean background square, presented in the form of classic inventory icons—similar to what you'd see in a fantasy RPG menu. Maintain consistency and coherence in the overall style, reminiscent of beloved retro fantasy RPGs—charming and refined, yet clear even at small sizes.

items.title: Photorealistic Boeing 747 Cockpit
items.description: This prompt generates a highly realistic front-on airliner cockpit interior image suitable for aviation visualization, simulation art, or editorial-style aircraft imagery.
items.content: Ultra-realistic interior photograph of a {argument name="aircraft model" default="Boeing 747"} cockpit viewed from slightly behind and between the two pilot seats, centered and perfectly symmetrical, showing the full main instrument panel, center pedestal, dual control yokes, and the overhead switch panel across the top edge of the frame. The cockpit is unoccupied, with 2 pilot seats visible in the foreground, each with light gray or off-white sheepskin seat covers, and 2 control yokes each holding a dark rectangular checklist or electronic note board clipped to the center. The main panel is densely packed with authentic-looking avionics, analog dials, autopilot controls, radio panels, and 6 illuminated display screens total: 2 large central navigation displays, 2 smaller blue-toned flight displays near the left and right sides, and 2 green text/data screens on the lower center pedestal. Include 4 throttle levers in the center, plus additional flap and systems levers, rotary knobs, guarded switches, and weathered brown-gray metal surfaces typical of a widebody airliner cockpit. The overhead panel should be crowded with rows of switches, toggles, and indicator lights, partially shadowed but sharply detailed. Through the front cockpit windows, show an airport gate scene in soft focus with pale concrete tarmac, painted ground markings, and a passenger jet bridge connected or positioned near the aircraft. Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

The main panel is densely packed with authentic-looking avionics, analog dials, autopilot controls, radio panels, and 6 illuminated display screens total: 2 large central navigation displays, 2 smaller blue-toned flight displays near the left and right sides, and 2 green text/data screens on the lower center pedestal. Include 4 throttle levers in the center, plus additional flap and systems levers, rotary knobs, guarded switches, and weathered brown-gray metal surfaces typical of a widebody airliner cockpit. The overhead panel should be crowded with rows of switches, toggles, and indicator lights, partially shadowed but sharply detailed. Through the front cockpit windows, show an airport gate scene in soft focus with pale concrete tarmac, painted ground markings, and a passenger jet bridge connected or positioned near the aircraft. Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

items.title: Traditional Chinese Scroll Illustration
items.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating a traditional Chinese gongbi style long scroll poster featuring legendary characters.
items.content: (国风卷轴插画师)你是一位顶尖的中国传统工笔人物画师，擅长将经典人物群像绘制成长卷式百科海报。根据用户指定的{argument name="人物群像" default="eight immortals"}，生成一张 “中国传统人物群像长卷海报”：画面为横向长卷式构图，所有人物排成一条队列，从左至右依次展开；每个人物都有鲜明的传统服饰、标志性道具和神态，下方配有竖排名牌标注姓名；卷轴顶部有醒目的书法标题；背景为符合主题的场景元素（如祥云、海浪、山水、亭台等）。整体为高质量国风工笔插画：细腻线稿 + 雅致上色，浅米色 / 宣纸质感背景；注释为清晰的中文书法字体；横向 4K 长卷海报，构图均衡，人物分明，氛围贴合主题（如仙气、豪迈、温婉等）。直接出图，人物群像为{argument name="人物群像" default="eight immortals"}。
items.translatedContent: (Guofeng Scroll Illustrator) You are a top-tier traditional Chinese gongbi figure painter, skilled at drawing classic group portraits into long-scroll encyclopedic posters. Based on the user-specified {argument name="character group" default="eight immortals"}, generate a "Traditional Chinese Character Group Long Scroll Poster": The composition is a horizontal long scroll, with all characters arranged in a queue unfolding from left to right; each character has distinct traditional clothing, iconic props, and expressions, with vertical nameplates below; the top of the scroll features a striking calligraphy title; the background includes thematic scene elements (such as auspicious clouds, waves, landscapes, pavilions, etc.). The overall style is high-quality Guofeng gongbi illustration: fine line work + elegant coloring, light beige / rice paper texture background; annotations in clear Chinese calligraphy font; horizontal 4K long scroll poster, balanced composition, distinct characters, and an atmosphere that fits the theme (e.g., ethereal, heroic, gentle, etc.). Output the image directly, character group is {argument name="character group" default="eight immortals"}.

items.title: SSR Kamen Rider Kuuga Card
items.description: This prompt generates a premium holographic-style SSR trading card illustration of Kamen Rider Kuuga, ideal for collectible card art, fan posters, and tokusatsu-inspired promotional visuals.
items.content: A premium ultra-detailed collectible trading card illustration of {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider Kuuga"} in {argument name="form name" default="Amazing Mighty Form"}, designed like a high-rarity SSR card. The composition is a dramatic front-facing action portrait with the armored hero centered and dominating the frame from thighs up, wearing glossy black and deep metallic crimson armor, a gold horned crest on the helmet, large faceted red compound eyes, and a detailed transformation belt with a red core. The hero extends one gloved hand toward the viewer holding a smaller card featuring his own image, creating a recursive card-within-card effect, while the other hand is open in a battle-ready pose. The background is a ruined city street at night filled with sparks, embers, debris, smoke, and multiple enemy monsters leaping and attacking from all sides; exactly 8 background figures are visible: 3 airborne enemies in the upper background, 3 standing or lunging enemies on the right side, and 2 smaller enemies near the lower left and bottom edge. Use intense cinematic lighting, glittering particle effects, holographic foil texture, gold filigree linework, and a luxurious black-and-gold art deco frame. Include ornate card UI text and badges integrated into the border: top center title "MASKED RIDER" above large metallic serif text "KAMEN RIDER KUUGA", a circular emblem in the top left, an iridescent shield badge in the top right with "SSR" and 5 gold stars beneath it, a bottom left label panel reading "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER", a bottom center nameplate reading "KAMEN RIDER KUUGA" with Japanese text "仮面ライダークウガ", a barcode below, and the subtitle "AMAZING MIGHTY FORM" at the very bottom. Add a large gold cursive artist-style signature at the lower right reading {argument name="signature text" default="NickZag"}. Overall style: hyper-detailed tokusatsu character art, explosive poster energy, premium trading card game rarity, shimmering holographic highlights, crisp focus on the central hero, epic collectible showcase.

items.title: SSR Kamen Rider Double Card
items.description: A glittering ultra-rare tokusatsu trading card image featuring Kamen Rider Double in a cinematic battle scene, ideal for collectible card art or premium game card designs.
items.content: A hyper-detailed premium Japanese trading card illustration in the style of an ultra-rare tokusatsu collectible, vertical composition with an ornate holographic foil border and explosive cinematic action. Center the armored hero {argument name="character name" default="Kamen Rider Double"} in a dramatic low-angle full-body pose, lunging forward through a ruined city battlefield while thrusting a trading card toward the viewer in his left hand. His suit is sharply split down the middle: vivid metallic green on the left half and glossy black on the right half, with large glittering red compound eyes, a silver V-shaped crest, segmented insect-like armor plating, a white scarf flowing behind him, and a highly detailed transformation belt with red mechanical components. The card he holds should show a smaller image of the same hero and match the premium collectible design. Surround him with exactly 8 background riders or enemies in dynamic combat positions across the destroyed urban warzone: 2 flying figures near the upper background, 3 mid-ground combatants on the right side, 1 blue-and-gold figure on the lower right, 1 red-and-blue rider on the lower left, and 1 additional partially visible fighter near the left edge. Fill the environment with shattered rubble, damaged skyscrapers, sparks, smoke, debris, and streaks of energy, creating a chaotic apocalyptic battle scene. Use intense prismatic holographic effects, rainbow diffraction, glitter, lens flares, starbursts, and reflective foil textures across the entire image. Frame the artwork like an SSR rarity game card with visible text elements: top center title "KAMEN RIDER", a large "W" beneath it, a top-right shield emblem reading {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} with 6 stars below, a top-left circular green-and-purple W insignia, a bottom-left panel reading "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER", a bottom center nameplate reading "KAMEN RIDER DOUBLE" and "仮面ライダーW(ダブル)", a barcode beneath, small bottom text "CYCLONE JOKER XTREME 09", and a large gold script signature at bottom right reading {argument name="signature text" default="NickTag"}. Make the whole card look like a luxurious, foil-stamped, ultra-rare, officially licensed tokusatsu collector card with razor-sharp detail, rich metallic highlights, dense particles, and maximal dramatic contrast.

items.content: A hyper-detailed premium holographic trading card illustration of {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider 1"}, designed like an ultra-rare tokusatsu collectible card with a vertical full-frame ornate border. The central figure is a classic masked hero in a dynamic forward-reaching pose, filling most of the composition from thighs up, with one gloved hand thrust toward the viewer and the other hand holding a smaller version of the same card. He wears a dark green armored chest, black suit, silver segmented gloves and forearms, a red scarf streaming dramatically to the right, a red belt with a large circular red buckle, and a metallic insect-like helmet with 2 long silver antennae and 2 oversized faceted crimson compound eyes. Behind him is a chaotic apocalyptic city battle scene at night with ruined buildings, smoke, sparks, streaking explosions, and a star-filled cosmic sky. Include exactly 10 smaller rider figures in the background and corners: 2 flying in the upper right sky, 1 climbing or leaping on the mid-left ruins, 3 mid-background combat figures across the center-right, 2 small figures in the lower right, 1 blue-accented figure in the lower left, and 1 partially visible figure near the far left edge. The art style is gritty, painterly, metallic, and cinematic, with dense glitter particles, rainbow foil reflections, gold filigree linework, and prism-like holographic highlights across the entire image. The card frame should be lavish black, gold, and iridescent foil with collectible-game styling. At the top center place the text "MASKED RIDER" above large serif text "{argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER"}" and a huge gold number "{argument name="card number" default="1"}". In the top left place a circular emblem showing the masked rider face. In the top right place a large badge reading "{argument name="rarity" default="SSR"}" with 5 gold stars beneath it. In the bottom left place a panel reading "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER". At the bottom center place the text "KAMEN RIDER 1" with "仮面ライダー1号" below it, and a barcode-like strip with the text "RIDER LEGEND 1971". In the bottom right add a large gold cursive autograph reading "{argument name="signature" default="NickZag"}". The armored hero wears a glossy magenta, black, and white suit with a segmented helmet and large luminous green compound eyes, facing the viewer in a powerful stance. One arm is thrust forward toward the camera, holding up a character card between black gloved fingers so the card is clearly visible in forced perspective; the other hand gives a confident thumbs-up. The belt device is prominent at the waist. Surrounding the hero are exactly 8 secondary figures and monsters scattered through the rubble and midair battle scene: 1 blue-and-red armored rider crouching in the bottom left foreground, 1 red-and-gold armored rider on the right midground, 2 small rider figures in the distant center background, 2 flying figures in the upper background, and 2 monstrous enemy creatures on the right side, one mid-right and one bottom-right. The environment is dense with collapsed buildings, broken concrete, sparks, smoke, debris, and cinematic action lighting. Render the whole image as a luxurious holographic SSR card with an ornate prismatic foil border, glittering rainbow refractions, metallic gold filigree framing, and layered collectible-card UI. At the top center, large embossed title text reads {argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER DECADE"}, with smaller text above reading "MASKED RIDER". In the top right is a large metallic badge reading {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} with 5 gold stars beneath it. In the top left and bottom right are 2 circular magenta crest icons. In the lower center is a gold cursive signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="NickZág"}. Along the bottom frame are 4 labeled UI sections: left panel "CARD TYPE" over "CHARACTER", center nameplate "KAMEN RIDER DECADE" with Japanese subtitle "仮面ライダーディケイド", a barcode panel beneath, and right panel "RARITY" over "SSR". Add tiny footer text under the barcode reading {argument name="footer text" default="DECADE COMPLETE 21"}. Style: ultra-detailed tokusatsu hero art, cinematic photoreal armor textures, dramatic depth, explosive action composition, premium gacha card design, holographic foil print effects, sharp focus on the main hero and card, highly polished game-card promotional artwork.

items.content: A clean editorial fashion collage on a light gray-white background with a thin black rectangular border, styled like a minimalist magazine outfit board. Center the outfit as a flat lay style composition with 5 visible fashion items: a bright {argument name="jacket color" default="crimson red"} cropped zip-front jacket with a pointed collar and elastic hem placed slightly left and layered on top; underneath it, a fitted {argument name="top color" default="white"} long-sleeve crew-neck knit top visible at the shoulders and sleeves; below, a voluminous mid-calf A-line skirt in off-white with evenly spaced large black polka dots; at lower left, a structured small black handbag with short top handles and a subtle glossy crocodile texture; at lower right, one pair of black square-toe Mary Jane flats with wide straps and silver grommet-ring hardware. The composition should feel balanced, chic, and contemporary, with soft studio lighting, no shadows or only faint soft shadows, crisp cutout edges, and a polished social-media fashion moodboard aesthetic.

items.title: Floral Chickens Trio Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a cute high-detail studio image of three flower-constructed chickens, ideal for whimsical character art or decorative fantasy animal imagery.
items.content: A whimsical studio portrait of 3 stylized chickens made entirely from layered flower petals and blossoms, standing side by side against a plain light gray background with soft even lighting and faint ground shadows. The left chicken is cream and ivory colored, built from pale petals and small white wildflowers, with a surprised expression, very large round googly eyes, a small pale comb, drooping pink wattles, and thin yellow chicken legs. The center chicken is fluffy and round, made from dense pink petals and pink flowers in multiple shades, with a stern slightly grumpy expression, narrowed eyes, a larger pale beak, oversized pink wattles, and a floppy pink flower-like comb falling over its forehead. The right chicken is bright orange and golden, made from vivid orange petals and marigold-like blooms with a few green leaves and yellow sprigs, with a sleepy unimpressed expression, half-lidded eyes, a tall red-orange comb, red wattles, and yellow legs. Make all 3 birds highly detailed, cute, quirky, and handcrafted-looking, with realistic floral textures arranged into convincing chicken anatomy, centered composition, full-body view, clean minimal backdrop, and a polished fantasy editorial photograph aesthetic.

items.title: Cyberpunk Web3 AI Profile Poster
items.description: A futuristic personal-branding poster showing a Web3 and AI persona with holographic stats panels, ideal for social media intros, profile banners, or techno-entrepreneur self-promotion.
items.content: A cinematic vertical sci-fi personal brand poster in a dark blue cyberpunk style, designed like a futuristic profile infographic for {argument name="profile name" default="Meta_wu"}. The composition centers on a young Asian man shown from the back and in partial side profile, standing confidently in a glossy black futuristic jacket with luminous blue accents and the text “META_WU” and “WEB3 × AI” printed on the back. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block. Behind him is a dramatic outer-space scene with a large glowing Earth filling the upper background, dense stars, a futuristic megacity skyline at night, neon road light trails, and 1 small flying spaceship near the left-middle area. At the very top, place a huge metallic ice-textured title reading “{argument name="main title" default="Meta_wu"}” in bold beveled silver letters with blue rim light. Directly below it, add 2 centered lines of Chinese text: the first line is a role tagline reading “BTC矿工｜币安夏普比率No.1交易员｜程序员｜专注web3+AI交叉”, and the second line reads “投资观察-加密货币&美股&A股”. Surround the character with glowing holographic HUD panels in transparent dark glass with cyan neon borders. On the left side, create 4 stacked panels: panel 1 is an “关于我” card containing 4 lines of profile info, “科技｜Hongkong 🇭🇰”, “github.com/Ferwoo”, “出生于 1999年5月1日”, and “2016年10月 加入”; panel 2 is a social stats card with 3 large metrics, “1,950 正在关注”, “3,906 关注者”, and “1 置顶推文”; panel 3 is a “BTC MINER” card showing 1 large gold Bitcoin coin and a server-mining rack scene; panel 4 is a “交易哲学” card with 3 lines of text, “数据驱动 × 理性决策”, “长期主义 × 价值投资”, and a glowing upward candlestick chart. On the right side, create 6 stacked panels: panel 1 shows a globe icon and “被全球KOLs关注 1”; panel 2 shows a group icon and “被中文KOLs关注 93”; panel 3 shows a chart icon and “全球影响力排名 62,434 /200K”; panel 4 shows a trophy icon and “华语影响力 5,053 /10K”; panel 5 is a “TRADER” card with subtitle “币安夏普比率 No.1” and a golden rising line graph, plus the small text “SHARPE RATIO TOP 1”; panel 6 is a “DEVELOPER” card with code-like text lines “// Code is law”, “// Web3 is future”, “// AI x Crypto”, “function build() {”, “return change_the_world();”, “}” and a GitHub-style icon. In the lower center, add a bold Chinese slogan in large glowing white text: “{argument name="slogan text" default="探索未来的交叉点"}”. Beneath it, add a smaller subtitle line: “在web3与AI的浪潮中，构建价值与未来”. At the bottom, include 3 rectangular category cards aligned horizontally: card 1 labeled “加密货币” with a Bitcoin icon and tiny market chart; card 2 labeled “美股” with Tesla and Apple logos; card 3 labeled “A股” with a rising bar-and-line market graph. At the very bottom center, place 4 Chinese keywords separated by vertical bars, “科技｜投资｜自由｜影响力”, and below them the English words “TECHNOLOGY · INVESTMENT · FREEDOM · INFLUENCE”. Use a high-contrast blue-and-silver color scheme with subtle gold accents, ultra-detailed sci-fi UI, crisp and accurate typography, volumetric glow, reflective surfaces, dramatic rim lighting, premium poster design, clean layout symmetry, sharp focus, and a polished high-end GPT-image-2 futuristic promotional aesthetic.

items.title: Modular Knowledge Encyclopedia Infographic
items.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating high-quality modular educational graphics similar to high-end museum or scientific encyclopedia pages.
items.content: 请根据【{argument name="主题" default="主题"}】生成一张高质量竖版「科普百科图」。 这张图不是普通海报，也不是单纯插画，而是一张兼具“图鉴感、百科感、信息结构感、收藏感”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格参考高级博物图鉴、现代百科书页、生活方式知识卡和社交媒体高传播信息图的结合。 请让画面包含： - 一个清晰漂亮的主题主视觉- 若干局部特征放大细节- 多个圆角模块化信息分区- 清楚的标题层级与重点标签- 简洁但丰富的百科内容- 可视化评分、要点总结或Top 5模块内容栏目请根据主题自动适配，优先从这些方向中选择并合理组合： 基础档案、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构组成、生长或使用条件、养护或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适合人群或适用场景、优缺点对比、快速评分卡。 视觉要求： 浅色干净背景，柔和配色，轻阴影，精致小图标，圆角信息框，整洁排版，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验好。整体必须像真正可以发布、阅读、收藏、系列化生产的科普百科卡，而不是广告图。 请不要做成普通商业宣传海报。要突出“知识整理+ 模块信息+ 图鉴式展示”的特征。
items.translatedContent: Please generate a high-quality vertical 'Science Encyclopedia Infographic' based on the theme: 【{argument name="theme" default="Theme"}】. This should be a modular infographic with a 'handbook, encyclopedia, and structural' feel. Style should combine high-end museum guides, modern encyclopedia pages, and knowledge cards. Include: a clear main visual, close-up feature details, rounded modular info sections, clear heading hierarchy, and concise encyclopedia content. Sections should automatically adapt to the theme, choosing from: basic files, classification, appearance, habits/ecology, mechanism/structure, growth conditions, maintenance, risks, target audience, pros/cons, or rating cards. Visuals: clean light background, soft colors, light shadows, exquisite icons, tidy layout with high density but clear readability. It must look like a publishable knowledge card for collection, not a commercial advertisement.

items.title: Dark Fantasy RPG Key Visual Poster
items.description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style vertical key visual for a psychological horror RPG, suitable for game promotion, title screens, and social media announcements.
items.content: A dramatic vertical dark-fantasy anime key visual poster for the RPG {argument name="game title" default="夢喰-BAKU-"}. Center the composition around 3 human figures layered in depth. In the background, a large intimidating adult man is shown from the chest up, facing forward, with messy wavy dark hair, light stubble, a partially open dark shirt, and a shadowed, ominous presence; his face is mostly obscured by darkness and framing, making him feel mysterious and threatening. In the foreground left, place 1 young man in a dynamic three-quarter pose lunging toward the viewer with his right hand stretched out dramatically, wearing a blue jacket over a white hoodie, with short tousled brown hair and a determined expression. In the foreground right, place 1 young woman standing slightly behind him, with long brown hair, a pale blouse, and a dark skirt or high-waisted bottom with a belt; she clasps her hands near her mouth or chest and looks anxious and vulnerable. Use a moody supernatural atmosphere with swirling black and deep violet smoke, ink-like shadows, spectral textures, and pixel-glitch fragments around the edges. Add broken chains diagonally in the background, several floating rectangular frames or screens, and a faint interior corridor or room behind the characters. Integrate the large Japanese title {argument name="title text" default="夢喰"} vertically in the center, rendered in bold white calligraphic kanji with purple splatter, scratches, and glow accents, partially overlapping the characters. At the bottom, include the Japanese tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="分かるだろ？俺達が必要とされる理由がよ"} in elegant white text with part of the sentence highlighted in purple. In the top right corner, add a white studio logo reading {argument name="logo text" default="DCC Project"} with a lotus-like emblem and large serif letters. Overall style: polished illustrated key art for a psychological horror RPG, ultra-detailed anime painting, high contrast, cinematic lighting, deep blacks, indigo and violet palette, ominous supernatural energy, poster-ready typography, premium promotional visual.

items.title: Crimson Space Opera Key Visual
items.description: A dark, cinematic sci-fi game poster showing a red-black biomechanical starship against planets, glowing orbital rings, and Japanese title typography, ideal for key visual or cover art generation.
items.content: A dramatic vertical sci-fi key visual poster for a dark space opera game, featuring a single colossal alien-mechanical spacecraft centered slightly low in the frame, angled diagonally from lower left toward upper right as if surging forward through space. The ship is razor-sharp, asymmetrical, and aggressively organic, built from layered black metal and glowing crimson-red armor plates, with a long spear-like prow, many jagged fins, and about 12 to 16 whip-like tendrils or spines streaming backward from its upper rear like biomechanical hair. Behind it floats a large shadowed planet at center, encircled by 3 luminous red orbital rings that create a halo effect. At upper left, include 1 cratered moon or planet partially cropped by the frame. Scatter multiple dark asteroids and rocky debris across the foreground and edges, especially lower right and lower left, to create depth. The background is a dense starfield with red nebula clouds and streaks of fiery cosmic dust. In the upper right, place a blazing orange-white sun flare breaking into the scene, casting hot rim light across the ship and rings. Use a high-contrast palette of black, deep crimson, ember red, and white highlights, with glossy metallic reflections and a grim, apocalyptic mood. Add vertical Japanese tagline text on the right side in white Mincho-style serif characters: 「あの太陽に飛び込めば 冷めきった私の心も温かくなるのだろうか」. At the bottom center, add the main title in very large distressed white Japanese serif characters with cracked texture and subtle red glow: 「斑鳩の柩」. Beneath it, add 1 line of smaller red katakana subtitle text: 「イカルガのクルスー」, and beneath that 1 line of small Roman letters in red: "IKARUGA NO CRUX". Make it look like premium anime game key art, cinematic poster composition, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, dynamic lighting, epic scale, ominous and beautiful.

items.title: Censored Research Paper Office Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic office announcement-style portrait of a man holding a technical paper in front of visible company branding, useful for tech news, parody announcements, or corporate editorial imagery.
items.content: A realistic corporate office photo of a young man seated indoors, holding up a printed research paper toward the camera with both hands. His face is fully obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in a medium tan color. He has short dark brown hair and wears a plain dark charcoal crewneck sweater. The paper is a white letter-size document in portrait orientation, clearly visible and centered in front of his torso. The document title reads “DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems”. Below it are the author lines “DFlash Research Team” and “DFlash Inc.” The page shows 4 visible text sections: “Abstract”, “1. Introduction”, “2. DFlash Technology Overview”, and “2.1 Dual Charge-Trapping Architecture”, set in a formal academic paper layout with dense black serif text. In the background, place a softly blurred modern office lobby with warm ambient lighting, beige walls, glass partitions, a sofa, indoor plants, and the black OpenAI logo and wordmark mounted on the wall at upper left. The composition is a medium shot, straight-on, with the subject slightly right of center so the OpenAI logo remains visible. Shallow depth of field, soft natural office lighting, polished photorealistic style, subtle warm color grading, high detail in the hands, paper, sweater texture, and interior environment. Keep the overall image clean, believable, and like a candid press or announcement photo. Use {argument name="document title" default="DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems"} for the paper title, {argument name="company logo text" default="OpenAI"} for the wall branding, {argument name="sweater color" default="dark charcoal"} for the subject’s clothing, and {argument name="censor block color" default="medium tan"} for the face covering.

items.title: Turn Food Photo Into Japanese Poster
items.description: This prompt converts a reference meal photo into a polished Japanese restaurant advertisement poster, useful for menu promos and social media food marketing.
items.content: Using the provided reference image of the udon meal, turn it into a clean, print-ready Japanese restaurant promotional poster while keeping the food photo itself as the main hero image. Expand the composition vertically into a portrait flyer layout, add a light icy-blue seasonal background with subtle watercolor texture and faint wave motifs, and overlay decorative green maple leaves for an early-summer feel. Add 5 text elements in Japanese: a blue circular badge at the upper left reading "初夏のおすすめ", a large bold brush-calligraphy headline across the top in 2 lines reading "とり天" and "ざるうどん", a small red vertical seal near the headline reading "自慢のとり天", a tall translucent blue vertical copy block at the upper right reading "ひんやり、つるり。さっぱり、満たされる。", and a price block at the lower right reading "980円 税込" with a blue brushstroke banner below that says "大盛り無料！". Add a short 4-line Japanese body copy paragraph at the lower left describing the dish in a menu-poster style. Preserve the original meal arrangement and realistic photography, but enhance it slightly for advertising: brighter, more appetizing, crisp, and high contrast. Make the overall design look like a polished restaurant poster created from a casual food photo.

items.title: ChatGPT App Screenshot With Generated Portrait
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic Android screenshot of the ChatGPT Japanese mobile app displaying a photorealistic nightlife portrait image, useful for social media mockups or UI demonstrations.
items.content: A realistic smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in Japanese on an Android device, shown full screen in portrait orientation with a clean light theme. The status bar at the top shows the time 19:27, network and battery icons, and 54% battery. The header has a back-style menu icon on the left, a rounded tab labeled ChatGPT, and 2 icons on the right: an edit pencil icon and a vertical three-dot menu. In the chat area, include 1 user message bubble in Japanese reading "インフルエンサーで港区飲みしてそうなリアルな女子". Below it, show the assistant status text "画像が作成されました" and then 1 generated image card with rounded corners. The generated image is a photorealistic night restaurant portrait of a glamorous young Japanese woman seated indoors by a window with Tokyo Tower visible outside, wearing a black spaghetti-strap dress, long wavy brown hair, a delicate necklace, and a bracelet, leaning her face on one hand at a candlelit dinner table with a wine glass in the foreground; the setting feels upscale, dimly lit, and influencer-like, with a mirror behind her reflecting the back of her head and the city view. Blur or mosaic the woman’s face for privacy. Beneath the image, show 5 action icons in a row: copy, thumbs up, thumbs down, share, and more. At the bottom, include the message input bar with a plus icon on the left, placeholder text "ChatGPT に返信する", a microphone icon, and a circular voice button on the right. Also show the Android navigation bar with 3 controls at the very bottom. Keep the overall composition exactly like a casual app screenshot, minimal, spacious, and authentic.

items.title: Mechanical Keyboard Product Page Mockup
items.description: This generates a polished desktop e-commerce product page for a premium mechanical keyboard, suitable for product design showcases, storefront concepts, and UI mockups.
items.content: Create a clean modern e-commerce product detail page for a premium mechanical keyboard brand called {argument name="brand name" default="KeyForge"}, presented as a high-fidelity desktop website mockup on a white background with subtle light-gray dividers and generous spacing. The layout is a single unified storefront scene with a top navigation bar, a left product thumbnail rail, a large center product hero image, and a right-side purchase information panel. In the header, place the bold wordmark on the far left, then 7 navigation items reading “Keyboards”, “Switches”, “Keycaps”, “Accessories”, “Sale”, “Blog”, and “Support”, and on the far right 3 icons for search, account, and cart, with a small black notification badge showing “1” on the cart. The main product shown in the center is a compact 75% mechanical keyboard photographed from a slightly elevated front angle on a pale gray stage, with an aluminum case in silver, white and gray keycaps, several accent keys in lavender purple, and a silver volume knob at the top right. The left vertical gallery contains exactly 5 thumbnails: 1 selected front product shot, 1 angled keyboard view, 1 mechanical switch close-up, 1 keycap texture close-up, and 1 dark video thumbnail with a circular play icon. The right product panel includes a small pill badge reading “NEW”, a large bold product name {argument name="product name" default="KeyForge K75 Pro"}, a subtitle “75% Mechanical Keyboard”, a 5-star rating row with 4.8 and “(126 reviews)”, a large bold price {argument name="price" default="$129.99"} followed by a green “In Stock” status, and a short two-sentence description about premium performance, gasket-mounted design, QMK/VIA support, and RGB. Under that, include a “Switch Type” selector with exactly 4 pill buttons labeled “Cherry MX Red”, “Gateron Brown”, “Gateron Blue”, and “TTC Gold Pink”, with the first selected; a “Color” selector with exactly 3 pill buttons labeled “White / Purple”, “Black / Gray”, and “Navy / Blue”, with the first selected; a “Quantity” dropdown set to “1”; one large black primary button labeled “Add to Cart” with a cart icon; and one outlined secondary button labeled “Add to Wishlist” with a heart icon. Beneath the buttons, show exactly 3 horizontal service highlights with small icons: “Free Shipping” with subtext “On orders over $99”, “30-Day Returns” with subtext “Hassle-free returns”, and “2-Year Warranty” with subtext “Peace of mind”. In the lower content area, create a two-column section separated by light lines. On the left is a vertical tab list with exactly 5 items: “Overview” selected, then “Specifications”, “What’s in the Box”, “Shipping & Returns”, and “Reviews (126)”. To the right of the tabs, place a rounded white feature card grid with exactly 6 feature blocks in 2 rows of 3, each with a simple line icon, bold title, and short explanatory text: “75% Layout”, “Gasket-Mounted”, “QMK/VIA Support”, “Hot-Swappable”, “RGB Backlighting”, and “Premium Build”. On the far right of this lower area, add a specifications bullet list with exactly 7 bullets: “Layout: 75% (82 Keys)”, “Switch Type: Cherry MX Red”, “Mounting: Gasket-Mounted”, “Connectivity: USB-C (Wired)”, “Backlight: RGB, South-facing”, “Material: Aluminum Case”, and “Dimensions: 322 x 135 x 42 mm”, plus an additional final bullet “Weight: 1.25 kg”. Use a refined minimalist product-design aesthetic, realistic UI spacing, clean sans-serif typography similar to Inter or SF Pro, soft shadows, subtle rounded corners, monochrome icons, and polished startup-style consumer electronics presentation.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll
items.description: A vertical ink-wash artwork combining a famous Chinese poem in six calligraphy columns with a lone scholar on a cliff, ideal for classical art, cultural posters, or elegant wall-scroll imagery.
items.content: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll painting on warm aged rice paper, vertical composition, with six large vertical columns of bold black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right half of the image. The calligraphy should be highly legible expressive Chinese cursive-regular script with varied ink density and natural brush taper, reading from right to left in 6 columns: "金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱", "停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然", "欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山", "闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边", "行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在", "长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海". Add one smaller vertical inscription on the left side reading "李白行路难" with a small red seal stamp beneath it. In the lower left foreground, depict an ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing white and pale gray robes with a blue sash, long black hair in a traditional topknot with loose strands and ribbon, standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, body angled right and head lifted upward in a contemplative, heroic pose. Below and across the lower half, paint a turbulent river or sea with white crashing waves in monochrome ink and soft gray washes; in the distance, faint misty mountains and fog dissolve into the paper. Classical literati painting style, dynamic calligraphy as the main focus, poetic and majestic mood, restrained palette of black ink, gray wash, off-white paper, and a small touch of muted blue on the robe, ample negative space, museum-quality Chinese shanshui and calligraphy fusion.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Landscape
items.description: This prompt generates a classical Chinese ink painting with flawless poem calligraphy and a scholar in a dramatic shanshui landscape, ideal for cultural posters, scroll art, or literary-themed visuals.
items.content: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll style painting on warm off-white rice paper, vertically composed with large black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right-central area and a poetic landscape illustration in the lower left and bottom. The calligraphy must be crisp, fully legible, and written in expressive semi-cursive brush script, arranged in 6 vertical columns read right to left. The exact text of the 6 columns is: “金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”, “停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”, “欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”, “闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”, “行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”, “长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”. Add a smaller vertical signature inscription to the left of the main poem reading “李白行路难”, plus 1 small red square seal beneath the inscription. In the painted scene, show 1 ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing pale robes with a dark topknot and trailing ribbons, standing on the edge of a rugged cliff at lower left, gazing upward and outward in contemplation. Below and across the lower half, depict a turbulent river or sea with whitecaps and foam, misty ink-wash mountains receding in the distance, sparse grasses and dark brush vegetation near the cliff edge, and soft atmospheric fog. Use monochrome black and gray ink with very restrained muted blue-gray washes in the water and robe shadows. The mood is heroic, melancholic, and literary, evoking classical Chinese shanshui painting and museum-quality calligraphy, with empty negative space preserved around the text and landscape.

items.title: Visit Malaysia 2026 Travel Poster
items.description: A premium vertical tourism poster showcasing Malaysia’s landmarks, culture, and tropical beauty, ideal for destination marketing and campaign visuals.
items.content: A luxurious tourism poster for {argument name="destination" default="Malaysia"}, designed as a vertical fine-art travel advertisement on a clean ivory-white textured background with subtle embossed ornamental patterns. The composition is built around one long flowing red-and-gold batik silk ribbon that sweeps diagonally and spirals through the page, forming an elegant S-curve and visually containing a dreamlike collage of landmarks, culture, and nature. At the top left, warm golden sunrise light pours over misty tropical mountains and rainforest with a waterfall, dense palms, and a large rhinoceros hornbill perched beside hibiscus flowers and white tropical blossoms. In the upper center, a detailed Kuala Lumpur skyline rises from mist, dominated by the Petronas Twin Towers, with the KL Tower and several modern skyscrapers visible. Near the upper right floats 1 colorful traditional wau kite with floral patterns against open white space. In the middle left, include 1 grand mosque with multiple domes and minarets set among palms and haze. In the middle center-right, include the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building with its copper domes and clocktower. In the lower middle left, include 1 elevated red-and-silver urban train crossing through the city. In the lower center, show 1 ornate Chinatown gate labeled Jalan Petaling, decorated with red lanterns and bustling pedestrians. In the lower right-middle, depict the Batu Caves area with 1 towering golden Murugan statue and 1 steep rainbow staircase climbing into limestone cliffs, surrounded by crowds. At the lower right, nestle 1 landscaped city park with a turquoise lake and fountains. Purple orchids and tropical flowers are woven into the ribbon and foreground in several places. At the very bottom right, show 1 small traditional dancer in red and gold attire twirling the trailing end of the ribbon. The collage should feel luminous, hyper-detailed, majestic, and celebratory, blending photorealistic architecture with painterly fantasy travel-poster styling, soft clouds, atmospheric haze, and glowing highlights. Add elegant poster typography in the lower left: the main headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}, a smaller location line reads {argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}, a blue script tourism slogan reads {argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}, and below that a small refined subheading reads {argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"}. Use a premium color palette of gold, crimson, ivory, emerald, sky blue, and tropical greens, with polished editorial composition and high-end destination-branding aesthetics.

items.title: Futuristic Photonics Magazine Cover
items.description: This prompt generates a dramatic French-style science magazine cover centered on a glowing photonic chip, ideal for editorial mockups, tech news covers, and speculative science publication designs.
items.content: A hyper-detailed French popular science magazine cover in the style of a bold mainstream newsstand publication, full-page vertical layout, dramatic glossy print design, black background with intense neon lighting and saturated red, blue, purple, green, and orange highlights. At the very top, a wide red masthead bar with the magazine title {argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"} in huge white serif capital letters with subtle beveling and metallic shine; small issue details on the upper right in tiny white text. On the upper left, a bright yellow and black special tag reading {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"} with a red arrow motif. The main headline dominates most of the upper half in gigantic white block capitals with a red glow and slight 3D shadow: {argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"}. Beneath it, 3 short cover lines in smaller white text with selected words highlighted in yellow, discussing ultrafast light-speed chips, a French record computer called Lucy, and light trapped for millions of cycles for energy-efficient AI. Centerpiece image: a futuristic square photonic processor chip floating in space at a slight perspective tilt, extremely detailed circuitry, metallic screws at the corners, glowing traces, and a bright cyan-blue core display labeled {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"}; the chip emits intersecting beams and flowing fiber-optic light trails in electric blue, magenta, orange, and violet that radiate outward across the page. items.content: Create a clean corporate Japanese web banner for an AI training service, wide horizontal format around 1200x247. On the right side, show 1 professional Japanese businessman from the waist up, wearing a dark navy or black suit, white shirt, and blue striped tie, arms crossed, facing forward with a confident posture; his face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. Behind him, use a softly blurred modern office interior with bright daylight, glass, and green plants. Add a sweeping curved blue accent ribbon along the far right edge framing the subject. Overall style: premium B2B seminar ad, polished typography, soft gradients, minimal clutter, strong hierarchy, high readability, Japanese enterprise branding, subtle shadows, crisp vector icons, and balanced negative space.

items.title: Exploded Chicken Mushroom Stew Ad
items.description: A high-contrast vertical food poster showing an exploded ingredient layout and bilingual labels for a rich chicken, mushroom, potato, carrot, and vermicelli stew.
items.content: Create a dramatic vertical food advertisement on a pure black background, styled like a premium ingredient breakdown poster for a hearty Chinese chicken mushroom vermicelli stew. Use a clean top-to-bottom exploded composition with floating ingredients suspended in midair above the finished dish, each group clearly separated and lit with glossy commercial food-photography lighting. At the top, show a cluster of mixed brown shiitake and other savory mushrooms. Below that, show 2 grouped aromatics: a pile of red goji berries and a small bundle of green scallions with 2 thick ginger slices. Below that, show 2 grouped main items: several raw chopped bone-in chicken pieces with skin on, and 1 bundled nest of dry vermicelli noodles. Below that, show 2 grouped vegetables: peeled potato cubes and thick carrot slices. Beneath them, place 1 transparent glass bowl filled with rich golden chicken broth, with 4 shiitake mushrooms visible on the surface, tiny herb bits, a few floating oil droplets, and faint steam. At the bottom, place 1 dark brown ceramic casserole pot with side handles containing the finished stew: chicken pieces, shiitake mushrooms, translucent vermicelli, potato chunks, carrot slices, scattered goji berries, chopped green onion garnish, and glossy golden broth. Add drifting droplets, crumbs, and tiny garnish particles between layers to emphasize motion and richness. Include subtle steam rising from the final stew and 1 bright star-like sparkle highlight on the right rim of the casserole. Surround the ingredient groups with 7 bilingual callouts in Chinese and English, each with a thin curved arrow pointing to the relevant item. The 7 labels are: "榛蘑&香菇 / Hazel Mushrooms & Shiitake", "鲜美菌菇 / Savory Mushrooms", "枸杞&葱姜 / Goji Berries & Aromatics", "鸡肉&粉条 / Chicken & Vermicelli", "土豆&胡萝卜 / Potatoes & Carrots", "浓郁鸡汤 / Rich Chicken Broth", and "成品 / Finished Stew". Add 1 extra bilingual text note near the vegetables or middle area reading "丰富食材 / Rich Ingredients". Make the image hyper-realistic, appetizing, high contrast, razor sharp, with cinematic highlights, deep shadows, premium packaging-ad aesthetics, and a balanced centered layout optimized for a poster or social media ad.

items.title: Anime Martial Arts Duel in Dojo
items.description: This prompt generates a high-energy anime battle scene between two female martial artists in a wooden dojo, ideal for action poster art or dramatic character showcase imagery.
items.content: A dramatic anime action illustration inside an old wooden martial arts hall, showing two young women in mid-battle with explosive motion and elemental energy trails. In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light purple"} hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. Set the scene in a weathered dojo or wuguan interior with tall wooden beams, hanging lanterns, broken floorboards, flying splinters, dust, sparks, and debris exploding from the impact of the fight. Include one large wooden signboard above them with the black calligraphy text 武术会, plus two vertical hanging banners, the left reading 以武会友 and the right reading 刚柔并济. Use a low-angle cinematic perspective, strong foreshortening, extreme motion, dense particles, and dramatic warm-vs-cool color contrast between the red and blue energy. Highly detailed anime painting, ultra-dynamic composition, sharp linework, rich textures, glowing effects, volumetric lighting, and epic battle key visual quality.

items.title: Anime Martial Arts Energy Clash
items.description: This prompt generates a high-impact anime fight scene between two female martial artists in a traditional dojo, ideal for action posters, splash art, or cinematic fantasy illustrations.
items.content: A dramatic anime action illustration inside a traditional wooden martial arts hall, captured at a low angle with intense cinematic perspective. In the foreground, a fierce young female martial artist with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair in a messy high bun tied with red ribbons lunges forward in a deep fighting stance, one fist thrust toward the viewer. She wears a white Chinese-style kung fu top with red trim and tassel frog closures, wide red pants, and black martial arts shoes with red accents. Her expression is focused, aggressive, and determined, with sharp red-tinted eyes. Red energy ribbons and paint-like light trails spiral around her body and punch, scattering sparks and embers. In the upper right, a second young female fighter leaps through the air, partially turned sideways, wearing a dark green qipao-inspired combat dress with ornate gold embroidery, black stockings, and heeled shoes. Her {argument name="second character hair color" default="lavender"} hair is styled in two buns with loose curls and decorative hair ornaments. She casts a martial arts gesture with one hand extended, surrounded by a sweeping arc of luminous blue water-like energy that curves around her body in a near-complete ring. The two elemental forces, red and blue, contrast sharply and imply an imminent clash. The environment is a weathered dojo interior with broken wooden floorboards exploding upward, dust, splinters, and motion debris frozen midair. Warm shafts of light stream through the wooden structure and windows, mixing with glowing particles. Large hanging calligraphy signs are visible, including a central wooden plaque reading {argument name="main sign text" default="武術会"}, with additional vertical banners bearing black Chinese characters on aged paper. Highly detailed anime illustration, dynamic foreshortening, extreme motion, layered effects, rich textures, dramatic rim lighting, fiery warm highlights against cool blue energy, polished concept art quality, vertical composition.

items.title: Mars Selfie With Alien and Rocket
items.description: A cinematic photoreal selfie of a man and a female alien on Mars, useful for futuristic social posts, sci-fi announcements, or playful space-tech visuals.
items.content: A photorealistic selfie on the surface of Mars, framed at arm’s length in a casual slightly wide-angle smartphone perspective. In the foreground are 2 subjects standing close together from chest-up: a human man on the left wearing a black crewneck shirt with a clear white OpenAI logo on the chest, and a tall elegant female alien on the right with shimmering blue-green metallic skin, elongated ears, subtle facial ridges, and a sleek biomechanical-looking outfit with bronze and silver tones, a deep neckline, fine ornamental seams, and layered necklaces with a prominent blue gemstone pendant. The man has short dark messy hair and his left arm extends toward the camera as if taking the selfie. The alien leans in close beside him, both posed like a friendly commemorative snapshot. The background is a red rocky Martian desert with scattered stones, low hills, and a dusty orange sunset sky. On the far left stands a roadside-style sign with 2 lines of text reading {argument name="sign headline" default="MARS"} and {argument name="sign subtext" default="WELCOME HOME"}. On the far right in the distance is 1 large retro-futuristic white rocket standing upright on landing legs, with visible vertical text reading {argument name="rocket text" default="SPACEX"}. Warm orange lighting, cinematic realism, detailed textures, subtle atmospheric haze, social-media-announcement vibe, high detail, natural depth of field.

items.title: Moonlit Celestial Kimono Dancer
items.description: A luminous fantasy anime portrait of an elegant kimono-clad woman dancing with iridescent magical ribbons under a snowy full moon, ideal for character art or decorative poster imagery.
items.content: A breathtaking fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a celestial shrine maiden"} in a snowy winter night landscape, shown in a graceful full-body dancing pose beside a reflective lake. She has extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="rose pink"} hair, partially seen from the back and side, with an elaborate gold floral hair ornament and dangling chains. Her face is mostly obscured by the angle. She wears a richly layered, ornate Japanese court kimono inspired by a jūnihitoe, with voluminous sleeves and many overlapping panels in crimson, white, purple, green, gold, and soft pink, decorated with floral brocade, embroidered blossoms, metallic trim, and shimmering patterns. Both arms are raised elegantly as she appears to guide 2 huge arcs of translucent iridescent silk or magical ribbon that spiral around her body in a luminous loop, catching rainbow highlights like soap-film aurora light. The ribbons glow with prismatic reflections and tiny sparkles, framing her against the sky. The setting is a moonlit lakeshore covered in fresh snow, with bare winter trees on the right, a small traditional pavilion or shrine structure across the water on the left, and the bright full moon high in a deep indigo sky filled with dense stars and softly falling snow. The water mirrors the moonlight and glittering particles. Emphasize cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed fabric textures, dynamic flowing motion, magical sparkle effects, elegant composition, and a dreamlike celestial mood. Highly polished anime key visual, vertical composition, intricate detail, luminous highlights, no text, no watermark.

items.title: Two-Era Naval Comparison Poster
items.description: A cinematic Japanese military-style poster comparing a WWII battleship and a modern destroyer, ideal for presentation covers, history visuals, or dramatic concept key art.
items.content: Create a cinematic Japanese naval comparison poster in a highly detailed, photorealistic concept-art style with a warm amber sunset palette, dramatic clouds, glowing backlight, and a premium movie-poster plus technical-reference-sheet layout. The composition is vertically stacked in 2 main zones. In the top hero zone, show 2 large semi-transparent officer portraits facing inward, one on the left in an older imperial-era naval uniform and one on the right in a modern maritime self-defense force style dress uniform, both wearing peaked caps and formal dark coats, with a blazing sunset sky behind them. Centered between them, place a large serif English title reading {argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it reading ふたつの時代の霧, and 2 lines of Japanese tagline text above the title. Below the title, on the ocean at golden hour, show 2 warships moving forward on slightly converging paths: on the left, a massive World War II-era battleship with many large gun turrets, tower superstructure, weathered dark hull, and white bow spray; on the right, a modern gray guided-missile destroyer with hull number 115 visible on the bow, sleek radar-equipped superstructure, and foamy wake. Add exactly 4 helicopters in the sky, 2 on the left side and 2 on the right side, plus a suspension bridge and distant modern city skyline on the horizon. In the lower reference-sheet zone, split the page into 2 vertical panels, left for the historical ship and right for the modern ship, each panel styled like a parchment-toned military specification board with dark blue and dark red header bars, fine dividing lines, inset image boxes, and Japanese labels. The left panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the battleship, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 5 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails in a row, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character turnaround views of a male naval officer, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. The right panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the modern destroyer, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 6 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails arranged around the ship references, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character lineup views including a central female officer in white cap and dark uniform, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. Use visible Japanese headers and labels throughout, including a left historical title area and a right title area naming the ship as 護衛艦 あさつ (DDG-115). Make the whole image feel like a museum exhibition poster, military design sheet, and prestige historical sci-fi drama key art combined, with ultra-sharp detail, realistic metal textures, ocean reflections, aged paper panels, symmetrical balance, and polished editorial typography.

items.title: Cute Bunny Hiragana Poster
items.description: A whimsical Japanese hiragana learning chart with 40 bunny-illustrated cells, ideal for classroom decor, children's materials, or playful presentation covers.
items.content: Create a cute Japanese preschool hiragana poster in a soft watercolor storybook style on warm textured parchment paper. The composition is a vertical educational chart with a whimsical spring border of grass, flowers, mushrooms, butterflies, and tiny chicks, designed like a children's classroom learning sheet. At the top, place a wooden signboard header with colorful rounded Japanese text reading {argument name="headline text" default="うさぎのひらがな表"}, decorated with 2 white bunny mascots, one sitting on the left and one peeking from the right, plus small flowers and leaves around the sign. Below the header, arrange a clean 5-row by 8-column grid for a total of 40 square cells, each cell outlined in thin brown lines on a cream background. In every cell, place one large brightly colored hiragana character near the top and one small kawaii rabbit illustration below it, each rabbit acting out or holding an object associated with the word written underneath. Use a different cheerful color for many of the hiragana characters, including reds, oranges, yellows, greens, blues, and purples, with a hand-painted rounded font. Keep the text and illustrations exactly as follows, left to right by row: row 1 has 8 cells labeled あ, い, う, う, え, え, お, お with the words あめ, いい, いい, うさぎ, えんぴつ, えんぴつ, おやすり, おにぎり; row 2 has 8 cells labeled か, き, く, け, せ, せ, そ, そ with the words きくら, たま, サベツン, ケーキ, せんせい, そう, そう, しょうこう; row 3 has 8 cells labeled た, ち, ち, つ, て, て, と, と with the words たまご, たまご, ちびこ, つと, てんとうむし, てしなを, とうこ, ほしい; row 4 has 8 cells labeled な, に, ぬ, ふ, め, ね, の, ほ with the words まな, ひこうき, みんきう, ふたう, てつ, へびす, ようこ, ほし; row 5 has 8 cells labeled ま, み, む, る, れ, れ, ろ, ん with the words わた, まくら, みかん, むぎぎ, めがみ, もも, ろうた, ん. The bunny illustrations should be varied and adorable: examples include holding an umbrella, cuddling grapes, drawing with a pencil, eating a rice ball, sitting with cherry blossoms, standing under an umbrella, holding fruit, eating cake, dressed as a teacher, holding flowers, sleeping under a blue blanket, carrying eggs, hugging a tomato, holding strawberries, blowing bubbles, wearing a blue cap, holding an orange, sitting with cotton, bathing in a wooden tub, and holding candy. Maintain a gentle pastel palette, soft shading, round faces, rosy cheeks, and subtle ink outlines. The overall feeling should be nostalgic, charming, educational, highly detailed, and perfect for a nursery wall chart or a cute slide cover for a Japanese learning presentation.

- 请勿更改头像
- 保持 X UI 界面准确
- 保留原有的面部特征
- 角色为男性
- 仅增强笑容
- 确保所有中文文字清晰易读

items.title: Zombie Survival RPG Anime Ad Poster
items.description: This generates a dense Japanese-style mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG, suitable for app promo art, fake game ads, or cinematic anime key visuals.
items.content:
Create a dramatic Japanese mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG in anime-meets-cinematic style. Vertical smartphone poster layout, dense promotional design, gritty urban apocalypse background at dusk with ruined city streets, smoke, sparks, debris, damaged buildings, neon signs, and a crowd of zombies advancing from behind. In the center, a young anime woman sits on the ground in a slightly slouched pose, legs bent, holding a black handgun upright in one hand. She has straight dark brown to black shoulder-length hair, pale skin, and an oversized dirty white T-shirt splattered with blood. Large bold Japanese calligraphy is printed vertically on the shirt: "働きたくね〜". Her expression area is simple and unobtrusive so the composition emphasizes the shirt, weapon, and mood. Surround her with multiple zombies in torn clothing, reaching forward from the left and right background.

Use an aggressive game key-art design with 8 clearly separated promotional sections. Section 1: top-left game logo block, count 3 text elements, with large distressed English title "Dead or work", smaller Japanese subtitle "ゾンビサバイバルRPG", and heavy black paint-splatter background with white and red text. Section 2: right-side vertical slogan area, count 2 text elements, with white Japanese text "動かない、ただ" above giant red vertical text "生き残れ。" on a rough black brushstroke strip. Section 3: left-middle feature list panel, count 4 feature rows, each row with a white icon in a black square and yellow/white Japanese copy; labels are "ゾンビを倒して生き延びろ", "拠点を強化・カスタマイズ", "仲間と協力プレイ", and "デイリーミッションで報酬GET". Section 4: right-middle bonus campaign panel, count 1 headline plus 3 reward items; headline in a bright jagged yellow burst says "今すぐ始めると 豪華特典プレゼント!" and beneath it are three item boxes labeled "ゴールド ×5000", "レア武器 (7日間)", and "サバイバルキット ×10". Section 5: lower-middle gameplay screenshot strip, count 4 thumbnails with captions; captions are "リアルタイムバトル!", "基地を自由にカスタム!", "仲間とレイドボスに挑め!", and "広大なオープンワールド!". Section 6: bottom call-to-action banner, count 2 text elements, with a huge yellow-and-red Japanese phrase "今すぐダウンロード!" and smaller white/red subtext "あなたの選択が、生死を分ける。". Section 7: bottom-right store badges, count 2 badges, showing App Store and Google Play style download buttons. Section 8: bottom-right QR area, count 1 QR code in a white square.

Overall aesthetic: hyper-detailed, high-contrast, grimy, intense, commercially polished gacha/mobile game ad, combining anime character art with realistic zombie horror background. Use bold distressed typography, black brush textures, red warning colors, yellow promotional highlights, metallic UI framing, and cinematic orange-gray lighting.
