items.title: Philosophical Concept Infographic Manuscript
items.description: A highly detailed and complex prompt for an infographic designed as an ancient mythological manuscript, explaining the differences between Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism.
items.content: 一幅令人叹为观止、极其复杂的「{argument name="主题" default="儒释道根本区别"}」概念世界构建信息图杰作，整体被设计成一部底蕴深厚的东方古典神话传说手稿。背景：纯白色复古纹理画布，浅米黄做旧牛皮纸底色，轻微毛边与水渍感。核心布局：中心视觉采用宏大的「竖版蛋形分层结构」，从上到下依次为释、道、儒三层。边缘边角料：四个角落点缀精细微观插图，主题为古代观测手记、法器与符文。色彩：低饱和鼠尾草绿、浅金、米白为主色调，整体清淡柔和，无刺眼高饱和色彩。细节：建筑线条、山水皴法、莲花纹路、云气层次清晰可见，纤毫毕现。无缝融合：三层之间通过云雾与水流自然过渡，释的佛光、道的太极云气、儒的书卷气息无缝衔接。风格：{argument name="艺术风格" default="古典墨水线稿+低饱和数字水彩"}，清淡国风古籍手稿质感。文字标注：纯正繁体汉字，采用斑驳古风宋体，每个标注含短标题+一行诗意描述，由暗金色发丝引线连接对应细节，无重复指向。画幅比例：3:4竖版独立完整标题区（顶部）：`儒釋道·根本區別`中心分层标注：顶层「釋」：`釋`，`人與自己的關係`，`無我·治心·放得下`中层「道」：`道`，`人與萬物的關係`，`無為·治身·想得開`底层「儒」：`儒`，`人與人的關係`，`無己·治世·拿得起`左右辅助标注：左侧：`淨`，`清淨明心，斷除煩惱`；`靜`，`順應自然，回歸本心`；`敬`，`敬畏責任，積極入世`右侧：`60歲+修心`，`看淡得失，回歸內心`；`35-55歲做人`，`張弛有度，順應規律`；`7-35歲做事`，`銳意進取，建功立业`底部总结文字：`入世與出世之間的平衡，是高級的生活智慧`
items.translatedContent: A breathtaking and extremely complex conceptual world-building infographic masterpiece of the "{argument name="theme" default="fundamental differences between Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism"}", overall designed as an ancient Eastern classical mythological manuscript. Background: pure white retro textured canvas, light beige aged parchment base color, with slight frayed edges and water stain effects. Core layout: The central visual adopts a grand "vertical egg-shaped layered structure", with Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism layers from top to bottom. Edge details: four corners adorned with fine microscopic illustrations themed on ancient observation notes, ritual implements, and runes. Color: low-saturation sage green, light gold, and off-white as main tones, generally light and soft without piercing high-saturation colors. Details: architectural lines, landscape brushwork techniques, lotus patterns, and cloud layers are clearly visible and rendered with extreme detail. Seamless fusion: Natural transitions between the three layers via clouds and flowing water, seamlessly connecting Buddhist light, Taoist Taiji clouds, and Confucian scholarly atmosphere. Style: {argument name="art style" default="classical ink line art + low-saturation digital watercolor"}, with a light Chinese style ancient book manuscript texture. Text annotations: Pure traditional Chinese characters in a mottled ancient Song font, each annotation containing a short title + a line of poetic description, connected to details by dark gold hairline leads with no repetitive pointing. Aspect ratio: 3:4 vertical independent complete unit. Title Area (top): `Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism: Fundamental Differences`. Central layered annotations: Top layer 'Buddhism': `Buddhism`, `Relationship between self and self`, `No-self, governing the heart, letting go`. Middle layer 'Taoism': `Taoism`, `Relationship between self and all things`, `Non-action, governing the body, keeping an open mind`. Bottom layer 'Confucianism': `Confucianism`, `Relationship between people`, `No-ego, governing the world, taking responsibility`. Side auxiliary annotations: Left: `Purity: clear heart and bright mind, severing afflictions`; `Stillness: following nature, returning to the original heart`; `Reverence: awe of responsibility, active engagement with the world`. Right: `60+ years refining the heart: looking past gains and losses, returning to the inner self`; `35-55 years being human: balance of tension and relaxation, following laws`; `7-35 years doing things: forging ahead with determination, building a career`. Bottom summary: `The balance between being in the world and being out of it is a high-level wisdom of life`.

items.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Ad Design Grids
items.description: This generates a realistic dark-mode mobile chat screenshot showing two Japanese AI prompts and two 2x2 grids of polished ad design variations, useful for illustrating generative design capabilities.
items.content: A dark-mode mobile chat interface screenshot showing two separate Japanese prompt-and-result exchanges about AI-generated ad design. The background is nearly black. There are 2 large rounded light-gray chat bubbles aligned to the right, each containing Japanese text. The first bubble says: 「日本語の幼稚園の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」. Beneath it is 1 rounded rectangular generated image preview showing a 2x2 grid of kindergarten advertisement variations in soft pastel colors. In the top-left panel, show a bright, airy ad with a close-up photo of a young child in profile at right, soft sunlight, cream and pale green tones, handwritten-style Japanese headline text on the left, small circular badges near the bottom, and floral accents. In the top-right panel, show an energetic outdoor ad with 4 children running under a blue sky, bold Japanese headline text, teal and yellow graphic accents, and a yellow circular callout. In the bottom-left panel, show a modern kindergarten campus building with a grassy yard and children playing, with a large white speech-bubble-shaped text area on the left and muted green-beige abstract shapes. In the bottom-right panel, show an illustrated large green tree with children and parents underneath, sky-blue background, warm family-friendly Japanese copy, and soft rounded decorative shapes. Add 1 small gray circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left corner of this preview and 1 small semi-transparent circular upload/share icon at the lower-right corner. Under this first preview, include 4 small interface icons in a row: copy, thumbs up, thumbs down, and more options. Lower on the screen, show the second right-aligned light-gray chat bubble with this Japanese text: 「日本語の健康食品の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」. Beneath it is a second rounded rectangular generated image preview showing a 2x2 grid of health food advertisement variations. In the top-left panel, show a clean wellness ad in white and pale green with a woman touching her neck, Japanese headline text about inner balance, several circular benefit icons, and price text. In the top-right panel, show a dramatic black-and-gold supplement ad with a dark pouch package, glowing gold particles, luxury serif-style Japanese text, and a bold red-orange price tag reading 980円. In the bottom-left panel, show a soft pink beauty supplement ad with translucent floral or crystalline textures, pastel packaging, delicate Japanese copy, circular info badges, and feminine cosmetic styling. In the bottom-right panel, show a natural green juice ad with a tall glass of green smoothie, fresh vegetables in the background, a green-and-white product box, clean Japanese health copy, and a circular yellow callout. Add 1 small gray circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left of this second preview and 1 small semi-transparent circular upload/share icon at the lower-right. The overall image should feel like a realistic smartphone app screenshot of an AI image-generation chat, with generous spacing between the 2 conversations, rounded corners, crisp Japanese typography, and a premium contemporary UI.

items.title: Japanese Builder Website Hero Mockup
items.description: This generates a sleek presentation mockup of a Japanese construction company homepage first view with a green theme, one notice item, and a consultation photo for web design concept showcases.
items.content: A polished presentation-style mockup on a dark charcoal background showing a Japanese homebuilder website first view concept. In the upper right, place a large white rounded speech bubble with 4 Japanese bullet lines in clean sans-serif text: 「工務店のwebサイトのファーストビューを作成してください。」, 「- 緑ベース」, 「- お知らせを1件表示」, 「- FV画像は、机を囲んで業者とお客様が話しているところ」, 「- CTAボタン設置」. In the lower left, show a realistic desktop website hero section inside a large rounded browser-like frame with a muted forest-green theme and elegant lifestyle branding for a Japanese construction company. The top navigation bar includes a small house logo at far left, the company name in Japanese, 5 navigation links across the top, and 1 rounded white contact button on the right. The hero area is split visually into 2 major zones: on the left, a green textured panel with layered organic leaf patterns, small introductory copy, a large white Japanese headline in multiple lines, a short paragraph of smaller Japanese body text, and 1 white rounded CTA button; on the right, a warm natural-light photo of exactly 2 people seated across a wooden table in discussion, with papers and a small architectural house model visible, indoor plants and window light in the background. The entire website card has soft shadows, premium editorial spacing, and rounded bottom corners. Along the bottom of the website mockup, include a narrow light-gray notice bar showing exactly 1 announcement item with a small green tag, a date, Japanese notice text, and a subtle link on the right. Add a semi-transparent gray circular badge overlapping the bottom-left corner of the website card containing the Japanese text 「編集」. In the bottom-right corner of the website card, add a small circular share/upload icon. Overall style: high-end Japanese web design concept, realistic UI mockup, refined typography, green natural-material branding, minimal and elegant composition.

items.title: Abstract Chaos Character Art
items.description: A highly detailed structured prompt that transforms a character image into abstract art composed of notes and symbols.
items.content:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクターの顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}の強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- {argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}をアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪郭は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。  
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。  
- 色はモノクロ＋{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤アクセント"}のみ。  
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。
items.translatedContent:
# Art that reveals a character's face from a chaotic collection of notes and symbols

---

## Style
- Mass of handwritten notes, formulas, symbols, and random lines in black ink on white paper.
- Scribbled chaos scattered across the paper.
- Sporadic emphasis using {argument name="accent color" default="red ink"} (lines, fills, marker-like blobs).
- Texture of analog notebook doodles.

---

## Composition
- Random notes and symbols cover the entire area.
- The density of black ink lines and characters concentrates on the position of the "character's face."
- As a result, the silhouette and expression of the given character's face faintly emerge from the chaos.
- The face is not realistic but formed by a collection of chaotic fragments.

---

## Color Palette
- Mainly monochrome (black and white).
- {argument name="accent color" default="red ink"} placed sporadically as an accent.
- Low saturation, emphasizing the feel of analog paper and ink.

---

## Expressive Elements
- Mixed strings of semi-readable Japanese, English, and numbers.
- Mathematical symbols, arrows, dots, slashes, crosses, and ink drips.
- The outlines of the face, eyes, and hair emerge from the "negative space" and "shading" of the symbol placement.

---

## Prohibitions
- Direct, realistic portraits.
- Digitally processed, orderly geometric patterns.
- Colorful or oversaturated expressions.
- Logos, watermarks, or artificial CG aesthetics.

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- The whole piece works as a "chaotic collection of notes and symbols."
- The provided character's face naturally emerges from the density and arrangement of chaos.
- Colors are monochrome + {argument name="accent color" default="red accent"} only.
- Maintains the hand-drawn texture of paper and ink.

items.title: Vintage Pomegranate Growth Atlas
items.description: This prompt generates a tall museum-style botanical infographic poster showing the full life cycle, anatomy, and growth systems of a pomegranate plant for educational or decorative science-art use.
items.content:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"} with English subtitle directly below: {argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

items.title: Owl-Shaped Nebula in Deep Space
items.description: This prompt generates a realistic cosmic scene of a nebula naturally resembling an owl, ideal for surreal astronomy art and dramatic sci-fi visuals.

Two large glowing circular eyes with bright electric-blue star cores, a narrow pointed beak of amber light between them, and two long upward-sweeping ear tufts made of burnt-orange and golden-brown nebula pillars. The body is formed from layered translucent clouds of warm copper, sepia, ivory, and cool smoky blue, with soft luminous edges and intricate filament textures. Surround the figure with many sharp stars of varying sizes, including several bright blue-white stars with subtle diffraction spikes. items.title: Surreal Octopus Burger Fine Dining Photo
items.description: This prompt generates a photorealistic surreal-horror restaurant snapshot of an octopus-like burger plated at a candlelit fine-dining table, ideal for bizarre food art or uncanny culinary imagery.
items.content: A dark, moody fine-dining restaurant scene photographed with direct flash and a slightly unsettling surreal-horror tone. Center the composition on a plated gourmet sandwich that looks like a realistic octopus used as the filling: a glossy golden-brown sesame burger bun on top of a fleshy pink-purple octopus body with detailed veins, pores, suction cups, wrinkled skin, and several visible tentacles protruding from the sides and front. The creature should appear cooked yet disturbingly lifelike, with one bulbous eye-like form visible on the left side and clustered holes and texture on the right side, creating an uncanny bio-organic appearance. The sandwich sits on a large round white ceramic plate with a pool of yellow butter-like or oily sauce spreading beneath it and a few small reddish droplets mixed into the sauce. In the foreground-left background place a small white dish holding a pat of butter. On the dining table include exactly 6 visible drinking glasses: 2 large red wine glasses, 3 tall white-wine or champagne-style stem glasses, and 1 dark beer glass at the right edge. In the back center place 1 small lit candle in a gold-toned holder and 1 small clear vase with white flowers. Use a white tablecloth, very dim ambient lighting, warm candle glow, strong camera flash reflections on the glassware, shallow casual snapshot framing, and a bizarre upscale restaurant presentation that feels grotesque, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, and intentionally shocking.

items.title: Solar System Ice Cream Cones
items.description: This prompt generates a whimsical photorealistic lineup of 8 planet-themed ice cream cones, ideal for surreal food art, creative ad visuals, or social media concept imagery.
items.content: A whimsical, photorealistic product-style food photograph of 8 ice cream cones lined up in a straight row on a matte black rectangular stand, each scoop designed to look like a different planet of the solar system. The scene is shot at eye level with a shallow depth of field and creamy urban bokeh in the background, suggesting an outdoor city street or café setting in soft daylight. From left to right, show exactly 8 cones: a gray speckled Mercury scoop, a yellow-brown swirling Venus scoop, a blue-and-green Earth scoop with white cloud patterns and a small blue drip, a deep red Mars scoop with darker marbling and red melted drips, a striped Jupiter scoop with its Great Red Spot visible, a pale tan Saturn scoop with a thin ring encircling it, a light icy blue Uranus scoop with a blue drip, and a vivid cobalt-blue Neptune scoop with glossy texture and blue dripping melt. Use crisp waffle cones, realistic melting details, glossy frozen surfaces, careful studio-quality lighting, and a centered symmetrical composition. Keep the planets highly recognizable but rendered as believable ice cream, with the black stand spanning the width of the frame and the background softly blurred.

items.title: Anime Warrior With Whip Sword
items.description: A dynamic fantasy anime action illustration of an armored heroine swinging a segmented blade, ideal for character key art, splash screens, or promotional visuals.
items.content: A dramatic high-action anime fantasy illustration of a young female warrior with {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} hair and piercing {argument name="eye color" default="bright blue"} eyes, shown in a dynamic low-angle close-to-mid shot as she swings a long segmented metal whip-sword in a wide circular arc around her body. Her hair is long, voluminous, and blowing violently in the wind, with sharp glossy strands and detailed highlights. She has a focused, fierce expression and is looking directly toward the viewer over her shoulder. She wears ornate black, silver, and gold-trimmed armor with a fitted bodice, armored gauntlets, shoulder plates, thigh armor, and a short layered skirt with flowing blue-and-white fabric panels and metallic decorations. The weapon forms a bright spiral ring across the foreground and upper right of the composition, with reflective steel segments, motion blur, and sparkling highlights. Small rocks and debris are suspended in the air from the force of the attack. The setting is a ruined stone battlefield or castle courtyard with cracked ground, broken masonry, and several tall blue banners in the background beneath a cloudy daylight sky. Use cinematic action composition, strong foreshortening, intense sense of motion, ultra-detailed fantasy costume design, polished metallic textures, dramatic wind effects, crisp anime linework, painterly lighting, high contrast, and an epic heroic mood in the style of a premium fantasy key visual.

items.title: Encyclopedia Style Infographic Generator
items.description: A versatile template for generating modular, high-quality educational infographics similar to museum charts or lifestyle knowledge cards.
items.content:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="动物"}生成一张高质量竖版「科普百科图」。 

这张图不是普通海报，也不是单纯插画，而是一张兼具“图鉴感、百科感、信息结构感、收藏感”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格参考高级博物图鉴、现代百科书页、生活方式知识卡和社交媒体高传播信息图的结合。

请让画面包含：
- 一个清晰漂亮的主题主视觉
- 若干局部特征放大细节
- 多个圆角模块化信息分区
- 清楚的标题层级与重点标签
- 简洁但丰富的百科内容
- 可视化评分、要点总结或Top 5模块

内容栏目请根据主题自动适配，优先从这些方向中选择并合理组合：
基础档案、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构组成、生长或使用条件、养护或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适合人群或适用场景、优缺点对比、快速评分卡。

视觉要求：
浅色干净背景，柔和配色，轻阴影，精致小图标，圆角信息框，整洁排版，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验好。整体必须像真正可以发布、阅读、收藏、系列化生产的科普百科卡，而不是广告图。

请不要做成普通商业宣传海报。要突出“知识整理 + 模块信息 + 图鉴式展示”的特征。
items.translatedContent:
Please generate a high-quality vertical "Popular Science Encyclopedia Image" based on {argument name="theme" default="animals"}.

This image is not a regular poster or a simple illustration, but a modular popular science infographic that possesses a sense of "illustration book, encyclopedia, information structure, and collectability." The overall style should reference a combination of high-end natural history illustrations, modern encyclopedia pages, lifestyle knowledge cards, and highly shareable social media infographics.

Please include in the frame:
- A clear and beautiful main visual of the subject
- Several magnified details of local characteristics
- Multiple rounded modular information sections
- Clear title hierarchies and key labels
- Concise yet rich encyclopedic content
- Visual ratings, key point summaries, or Top 5 modules

Content columns should be automatically adapted based on the theme, prioritized from these directions: basic profile, classification information, appearance characteristics, habits/ecology, formation mechanism/structure, growth or use conditions, care or maintenance suggestions, risks and precautions, suitable audience or scenarios, pros and cons comparison, and quick rating cards.

Visual requirements:
Light-colored clean background, soft color palette, light shadows, exquisite small icons, rounded information boxes, neat layout, high information density but not crowded, good reading experience. The overall result must look like a real science encyclopedia card suitable for publishing, reading, collecting, and serialized production, rather than an advertisement.

Please do not make it a regular commercial promotional poster. Highlight the features of "knowledge organization + modular information + illustration-style display."

items.title: Pose and Lighting Analysis Sheet Transformer
items.description: A highly detailed structural prompt for transforming any input image into a white-line mannequin pose and lighting analysis sheet.
items.content:
[CORE TASK]
Transform the provided input image into a pose-and-light analysis sheet.

This is NOT a finished character illustration.
This is NOT a clothing sheet.
This is NOT a beauty-preserving redraw.

This is a white-line rough mannequin conversion.

[PRIMARY GOAL]
Extract and visualize only:
- pose structure
- body balance
- camera angle
- body line flow
- inferred light source placement
- illuminated areas and light intensity

[INPUT ROLE]
Use the provided image as the strict anchor for:
- pose
- camera angle
- body tilt
- weight distribution
- approximate lighting situation

Do NOT preserve:
- face rendering
- hairstyle rendering
- clothing detail
- accessories
- weapon detail
- background architecture
- character identity
- emotional expression

[FIGURE CONVERSION]
single rough mannequin-like human figure
white body contour lines
white internal construction lines
simple mannequin head
no face
no eyes
no mouth
no eyelashes
no personality
no individual identity

human figure should look like:
- rough pose mannequin
- anatomy proxy
- line-based body guide
- structural sketch
- white-line rough dummy

keep:
- pose readability
- silhouette flow
- head tilt
- torso direction
- pelvis direction
- limb placement

[BACKGROUND]
pure black background
negative-style dark field
no scenery
no props
no architecture
no environmental storytelling

[LINE STYLE]
rough white line drawing
clean but sketch-like
construction-line feeling
anatomy guide lines visible
joint flow visible
body contour emphasized
no polished illustration finish

[LIGHT ESTIMATION]
predict the likely light source positions from the input image
visualize the light sources and illuminated areas using green glow only

use green light intensity with variation:
- strongest green where the light directly hits
- medium green for wrap light
- soft green for reflected or fading light

mark the estimated light sources with labels and arrows such as:
- Main Light
- Rim Light
- Fill Light
- Floor Bounce
- Back Light
only if appropriate

IMPORTANT:
do not invent random lights
infer lighting from the original input image
if the lighting is ambiguous, keep the annotations simple and plausible

[GREEN LIGHT VISUALIZATION]
show green glow on:
- head / skull plane
- neck
- shoulders
- chest plane
- ribcage direction
- pelvis edge
- thigh planes
- knee contact points
- floor contact bounce if applicable

use green light not as decoration,
but as lighting analysis information

[POSE PRIORITY]
1. preserve pose structure
2. preserve camera angle
3. preserve body balance
4. preserve head-torso relationship
5. visualize likely light direction
6. show illuminated areas with readable green intensity variation

[NEGATIVE]
finished person,
cute girl,
detailed face,
hair rendering,
clothing rendering,
weapon emphasis,
beautiful anatomy

items.title: Next-Gen Voxel Game Screenshot
items.description: Generates a realistic, high-fidelity first-person screenshot of a block-building game with a custom logo, environment, and UI overlay.
items.content: A highly detailed, realistic first-person video game screenshot of a next-generation voxel-based world. At the top center, a large, bold 3D logo reads "{argument name="game title" default="MINECRAFT 2"}". The scene features a {argument name="environment" default="lush, blocky landscape with a river, a small wooden cabin, a windmill, a waterfall, and majestic mountains in the background"}. The world blends realistic lighting, volumetric clouds, and high-resolution textures with cubic, voxel geometry. In the foreground on the left, a {argument name="mob 1" default="blocky green creeper"} stands on the grass, while a {argument name="mob 2" default="blocky brown wolf"} stands on the dirt path to the right. On the far right, the player's hand holds a {argument name="held item" default="pixelated blue diamond sword"} in a first-person perspective. At the bottom of the screen is a game user interface featuring a health bar with 10 red hearts, a green experience bar with the number '16', a hunger bar with 10 brown meat icons, and a 9-slot inventory hotbar. The hotbar contains, from left to right: a selected blue tool with a green highlight box, a green tool, a knife, a wrench with the number '3', a piece of meat with '6', a lantern with '24', a dirt block with '10', a bucket, and a sponge block.

items.title: Character Relationship Diagram Poster Generator
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating professional character relationship posters that combine information visualization with the specific art style of a series.
items.content:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="鬼灭之刃"}，生成一张高设计感的人物关系图海报。要求这张图不是普通插画，而是兼具信息可视化、叙事结构、海报设计感和作品风格还原度的人物关系图。

请自动完成以下内容：
- 识别该主题对应的作品及其核心设定
- 提取最具代表性的 6–12 位关键人物，必要时不超过 15 位
- 识别并展示关键人物关系，包括血缘、爱情、友情、联盟、敌对、师徒、主从、操控、背叛、秘密关系等
- 自动按作品特点选择合适的构图方式，如主角中心型、双核心对峙型、阵营分区型、家族谱系型或时间演变型
- 自动提炼作品的风格DNA，包括色彩、世界观符号、材质纹理、情绪氛围、排版语言和代表性元素
- 将这些风格元素转化为人物关系图的整体视觉设计，而不是简单复制某张官方海报
- 用不同颜色、线型、箭头区分不同关系，保证线条清晰、层次分明、不杂乱
- 核心人物最突出，重要人物次之，次级人物弱化，形成明确视觉层级
- 每个人物名称清晰可读，必要时可加入身份或阵营标签

最终成品应满足：
- 一眼看懂人物主次和关键关系
- 具有明显的原作品气质与设定感
- 兼具信息图的清晰度与海报的高级设计感
- 画面统一、精致、完整、适合社交媒体传播或海报展示
- 避免廉价流程图感、避免杂乱堆砌、避免信息过载
items.translatedContent:
Please generate a high-design character relationship map poster based on {argument name="theme" default="Demon Slayer"}. This image should not be a simple illustration, but a character relationship map that combines information visualization, narrative structure, poster design sense, and stylistic fidelity.

Please automatically complete the following:
- Identify the work and core settings corresponding to the theme
- Extract the most representative 6–12 key characters, not exceeding 15 if necessary
- Identify and display key character relationships, including blood ties, romance, friendship, alliances, hostility, master-disciple, etc.
- Automatically choose a composition method based on the work's characteristics, such as protagonist-centered, dual-core confrontation, faction-based, family tree, or chronological evolution
- Automatically refine the work's style DNA, including color, worldview symbols, textures, mood, typography, and representative elements
- Transform these stylistic elements into an overall visual design for the relationship map, rather than simply copying an official poster
- Use different colors, line types, and arrows to distinguish different relationships, ensuring clear lines and layers without clutter
- Make core characters most prominent, followed by important characters, and subordinate characters weakened to form a clear visual hierarchy
- Ensure every character name is legible, with identity or faction labels if necessary

The final product should satisfy:
- Immediate understanding of character hierarchy and key relationships
- Obvious alignment with the original work's temperament and setting
- Combines the clarity of an infographic with the premium design of a poster
- Unified, exquisite, complete, and suitable for social media sharing or poster display
- Avoids a cheap flowchart feel, messy piling, and information overload.

items.description: A high-end city poster prompt for GPT-Image-2 featuring oriental fantasy elements, golden energy flows, and architectural landmarks like the Canton Tower.
items.content:
平面插画，东方幻想风格高端城市海报设计，竖版9:16构图，整体采用对角线+S型流动构图，从左下向右上延展，画面以深邃黑色为背景，自上而下渐变至浓烈暗红色，形成强烈冷暖对比与空间纵深，背景带微弱星尘与颗粒质感。画面中央一条金色流动能量线条如火焰般蜿蜒贯穿，自底部向上延伸，具有流体质感、粒子光效与渐变高光，局部带细微能量碎屑与体积光。

金色流光中逐层浮现{argument name="城市" default="广州"}城市地标建筑群：广州塔为视觉核心，比例突出，周围融合珠江新城高楼群、猎德大桥及现代与岭南建筑元素，建筑采用“精细线描 + 金色发光体块”表现，轮廓清晰、细节丰富，在金色光晕映衬下仿佛悬浮于虚空，形成超现实空间层次，远景轻微雾化增强纵深感。

画面底部为一位东方白发女性形象，长发飘逸，如烟似雾，与金色流光自然衔接并逐渐融合，发丝半透明带渐变光感，姿态柔美，双目微闭，神情宁静，怀抱一束多彩鲜花，花间点缀微光粒子与星点效果，象征人与城市能量的精神连接，人物细节适度简化以突出整体设计感。

光影集中于金色流线、建筑与人物轮廓，形成强烈明暗对比与视觉聚焦，整体氛围宏大、神秘、具有东方神话意境且略带治愈感。色彩以黑与暗红为基底，高亮鎏金为主视觉强调，金色具备丰富明暗层次，辅以小面积高饱和花束色彩点缀，整体高级克制。

页面文字与画面融合排版：顶部居中宋体大字“{argument name="城市" default="广州"}·中国”，下方小字“{argument name="日期" default="2026/04/20"}”，再下方小字“{argument name="作者" default="LIYUE"}”，文字采用淡金色或柔和暖白色，与整体光影统一。高品质细节，电影级光影表现，体积光与粒子细节丰富，画面干净无噪点，超高清8K分辨率，商业级海报质感。
items.translatedContent:
Flat illustration, high-end oriental fantasy style city poster design, vertical 9:16 composition. The layout uses a diagonal + S-shaped flow extending from the bottom left to top right. The background is deep black grading down to intense dark red, creating strong warm-cool contrast and spatial depth with faint stardust and grain texture. In the center, a flowing golden energy line winds through like a flame, extending upward from the base, featuring fluid texture, particle effects, and gradient highlights, with subtle energy debris and volumetric light.

Within the golden flow, the architectural landmarks of {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} emerge layer by layer: the Canton Tower is the visual core with prominent proportions, surrounded by the Zhujiang New Town skyline, Liede Bridge, and modern Lingnan architectural elements. Buildings are rendered using "fine line drawing + golden luminous blocks," with clear outlines and rich details, appearing to float in a void against the golden halo, creating a surreal spatial hierarchy with slightly fogged backgrounds for added depth.

At the bottom of the frame is an oriental white-haired female figure with flowing hair like mist, naturally connecting and merging with the golden light. Her hair is translucent with gradient light effects; she has a graceful posture, eyes closed, and a serene expression, holding a bouquet of colorful flowers dotted with shimmering particles, symbolizing the spiritual connection between people and city energy. Character details are moderately simplified to emphasize the overall design.

Lighting is concentrated on the golden flow, buildings, and character outlines, creating intense chiaroscuro and visual focus. The overall atmosphere is grand, mysterious, imbued with oriental mythology, and slightly healing. Colors use black and dark red as a base with brilliant gold as the main visual emphasis. The gold has rich light-dark layers, complemented by small areas of high-saturation floral colors, maintaining a sophisticated and restrained aesthetic.

Integrated text and layout: Centered Songti font at the top reads "{argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} · China," followed by smaller text "{argument name="date" default="2026/04/20"}" and "{argument name="author" default="LIYUE"}" below. Text uses pale gold or soft warm white, unified with the overall lighting. High-quality details, cinematic lighting, rich volumetric and particle details, clean image without noise, ultra-high 8K resolution, commercial-grade poster quality.

items.title: Epic Concept/Movie Poster Generator
items.description: A massive, highly detailed prompt that directs the AI to automatically derive visual metaphors, hierarchy, and cinematic lighting for an epic poster based on a single theme.
items.content:
GPT-Image-2 提示词请围绕{argument name="主题" default="中国历史上的皇帝排名"}自动生成一张顶级概念海报 / 信息图式电影海报。

要求 AI 根据这个主题，自动推导并统一设计以下全部视觉系统，不需要我额外指定：
- 核心主体（可以自动判断更适合人物、产品、建筑、器物、符号、场景或抽象意象）
- 底部支撑结构
- 上方悬浮符号或精神象征
- 场景包裹元素
- 隐喻系统
- 色彩层级
- 材质对比
- 光影逻辑
- 标题、副标题、辅助文案
- 品牌感与高级感表达方式

最终画面必须是：
一张震撼、精密、统一、电影级、超高细节、可用于高端印刷的概念主视觉海报。

【总风格】
超写实 3D 商业 CGI 渲染，融合电影级布光、奢侈品视觉语言、未来感概念设计与史诗级构图。画面必须具有“唯一主视觉核心”，不能杂乱，不能像拼贴，不能像普通电商海报。

【自动推导规则】
AI 必须依据【主题】自动决定最合适的：
1. 核心视觉隐喻
2. 主体类型与姿态
3. 支撑结构形式
4. 悬浮元素形式
5. 场景外壳与空间氛围
6. 主色、辅色、强调色
7. 材质组合
8. 文字气质与版式风格

【构图规则】
- 绝对高级感
- 强烈中心秩序，整体统一
- 允许中轴对称或接近中轴的史诗级构图
- 视觉重力明确，从上到下形成清晰的层级落点
- 边缘负空间干净、克制、有呼吸感

【视觉质量】
- 超高细节
- 体积光清晰
- 材质真实
- 反射、折射、阴影、雾气、景深自然
- 整体达到高端品牌 campaign key visual / luxury invitation poster / conceptual editorial poster 水准

【排版系统】
- 整体为 90% 视觉，10% 文字
- AI 根据【主题】自动生成最匹配的主标题和副标题
- 标题必须简洁、锋利、有气势
- 文字必须尽量少而准，不要堆字

【署名要求】
在画面底部角落自然加入作者署名：
@a9quant
items.translatedContent:
GPT-Image-2 prompt: please automatically generate a top-tier concept poster / infographic-style movie poster centered around {argument name="theme" default="ranking of emperors in Chinese history"}.

Require the AI to automatically derive and uniformly design the entire following visual system based on this theme, without my extra specification:
- Core subject (automatically judge suitability for people, products, architecture, artifacts, symbols, scenes, or abstract imagery)
- Bottom supporting structure
- Hovering symbols or spiritual symbols above
- Scene wrapping elements
- Metaphor system
- Color hierarchy
- Material contrast
- Lighting logic
- Title, subtitle, and auxiliary copy
- Brand sense and high-end expression

The final frame must be: a shocking, precise, unified, cinematic, ultra-high detail conceptual key visual poster suitable for high-end printing.

[Overall Style]
Ultra-realistic 3D commercial CGI rendering, merging cinematic lighting, luxury visual language, futuristic concept design, and epic composition. The image must have a "single main visual core," not messy, not like a collage, and not like a regular e-commerce poster.

[Automatic Derivation Rules]
AI must automatically decide based on the [theme]:
1. Core visual metaphor
2. Subject type and posture
3. Form of supporting structure
4. Form of suspended elements
5. Scene shell and spatial atmosphere
6. Main, auxiliary, and emphasis colors
7. Material combinations
8. Text temperament and layout style

[Composition Rules]
- Absolute sense of premium quality
- Strong central order, overall unity
- Allows for axial symmetry or epic composition near the central axis
- Clear visual gravity, forming clear levels from top to bottom
- Edge negative space is clean, restrained, and has room to breathe

[Visual Quality]
- Ultra-high detail
- Clear volumetric light
- Authentic materials
- Natural reflection, refraction, shadows, fog, and depth of field
- Overall standard of high-end brand campaign key visual / luxury invitation poster / conceptual editorial poster

[Typography System]
- Overall 90% visual, 10% text
- AI automatically generates the most matching main title and subtitle based on the [theme]
- Title must be concise, sharp, and powerful
- Text should be as minimal and accurate as possible; do not stack words

[Signature Requirement]
Naturally add the author signature in the bottom corner: @a9quant

items.content: 2000年代のこども向けテレビ特撮専門月刊誌「{argument name="雑誌名" default="テレビくんマガジン"}」{argument name="号数" default="４月号"}の表紙画像を作って。新番組仮面ライダー系特撮ヒーローのバストアップ実写画像を中央に1人配置。周囲に平成ウルトラマン系、戦隊系ヒーローの小さなカットを配置。実在しない架空のテレビ番組名をいくつかと豪華付録の画像を並べて。ライダーやウルトラマンの名前は必ず実在しないものを想像力豊かに創作してください。赤緑青原色系ボールド縁取りのグラデーションフォントなどを駆使し、とにかく雑多で全部盛りの印象に。Format {argument name="比率" default="1:1.414"} 画像生成モデルは duct-tape-1か duct-tape-2、3 を指定したいです。
items.translatedContent: Create a cover image for the {argument name="month" default="April"} issue of '{argument name="magazine name" default="Televikun Magazine"}', a 2000s monthly magazine specializing in children's TV tokusatsu. Place a single live-action bust-up shot of a new Kamen Rider-style tokusatsu hero in the center. Surround it with small cuts of Heisei Ultraman-style and Sentai-style heroes. Include several non-existent fictional TV show titles and images of luxurious bonus items. Ensure all Rider and Ultraman names are creatively invented and do not exist. Use primary colors like red, green, and blue for bold, outlined gradient fonts to create a cluttered, 'everything-included' impression. Format {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1.414"}. I want to specify the image generation model as duct-tape-1, duct-tape-2, or 3.

items.title: Oriental Aesthetics Ink Wash Poster
items.description: A prompt for a minimalist New Chinese style ink wash landscape poster featuring misty mountains, a mirror-like lake, and a small boat with a red-clothed figure.
items.content:
新中式水墨山水海报，竖版9:16构图，东方极简美学风格，
大面积留白，整体色调为春日清晨氛围（青绿色、雾蓝、淡灰、浅墨），低饱和、清透柔和，高级质感。
画面主体为奇峻巍峨的群山，从中间平静湖面的两侧拔地而起，占据左右两侧画面，
山体以水墨晕染表现，浓淡干湿变化丰富，局部融入淡青绿色渲染，体现春意生机。
山峰被湿润轻柔的晨雾包裹，雾气层层递进，与浅青蓝天空自然融合，形成空气透视与空间纵深。

湖面如镜面般平静，呈现微青绿色调，倒映山体与天空，反射略带柔焦与雾化扩散效果，增强春日湿润与梦幻氛围。
中景一艘带弧形篷顶的小木舟缓慢漂浮，船桨轻触水面形成细腻涟漪，水纹自然扩散，整体保持极静状态。

船上为一位红衣渔女，体量较小（远景比例），人物简化处理为水墨剪影 + 轻微设色，
身着低饱和朱砂红传统服饰（非鲜艳红），颜色略被雾气柔化，
人物面部不刻画细节，仅保留轮廓与姿态（如轻扶船篷或执桨），
红色在水面形成淡淡倒影，作为画面唯一暖色视觉焦点。

岸边点缀疏林与春季新生植被，采用淡墨 + 淡青绿点染，虚实结合，增强节奏与生命气息。

少量飞鸟在远空掠过，轻盈疏散分布，增强空间层次与灵动感。

画面顶部居中竖排书法：“{argument name="标题" default="东方美学"}”，采用传统手写行书或行草风格（王羲之笔意），
笔触自然起伏、提按分明，带飞白与墨韵扩散效果，避免字体感。
书法颜色为深墨青或柔和墨黑，与整体画面统一。
整体风格：水墨 + 现代极简设计融合，春日禅意、空灵湿润、宁静氛围，
冷暖对比克制，电影感光影，高级艺术海报质感，8K超清细节。
items.translatedContent:
New Chinese style ink wash landscape poster, vertical 9:16 composition, oriental minimalist aesthetic style. Large areas of white space, overall color palette of a spring morning (cyan-green, misty blue, light gray, pale ink), low saturation, clear and soft, high-end texture. The main subject consists of steep, majestic mountains rising from both sides of a calm lake, occupying the left and right sides of the frame. The mountains are rendered with ink wash techniques showing rich variations in wetness and density, with local pale green tints reflecting spring vitality. Peaks are enveloped in moist, soft morning mist that layers into the pale blue-gray sky, creating atmospheric perspective and spatial depth.

The lake surface is as calm as a mirror with a slight green tint, reflecting the mountains and sky with a soft focus and atomized diffusion effect, enhancing the moist and dreamy spring atmosphere. In the middle ground, a small wooden boat with a curved canopy floats slowly, oars lightly touching the water to create fine ripples that spread naturally, maintaining total stillness. On the boat is a fisherwoman in red, small in scale (distant perspective), simplified into an ink silhouette with light coloring. She wears a low-saturation cinnabar red traditional dress (not bright red), the color softened by the mist. No facial details, only the silhouette and posture (e.g., lightly touching the canopy or holding an oar). The red forms a faint reflection on the water, serving as the only warm visual focus.

The banks are dotted with sparse woods and new spring vegetation, using light ink and pale green dots, combining solid and void to enhance rhythm and life. A few birds soar in the distant sky, lightly and sparsely distributed to enhance spatial hierarchy and nimbleness. Centered at the top is vertical calligraphy: "{argument name="title" default="Oriental Aesthetics"}", in traditional hand-written running or cursive style (in the spirit of Wang Xizhi), with natural brushstrokes, clear transitions, and ink smudge effects to avoid a digital font feel. Calligraphy color is deep ink-blue or soft black, unified with the scene. Style: Fusion of ink wash and modern minimalist design, spring Zen, ethereal and moist, serene atmosphere, restrained warm-cool contrast, cinematic lighting, high-end artistic poster quality, 8K ultra-clear details.

items.description: Generates a vibrant anime-style promotional poster featuring four girls at an outdoor BBQ with prominent text overlays.
items.content: An anime-style key visual poster for a fictional slice-of-life anime. In the foreground left, an energetic blonde anime girl with star hairpins and blue eyes wears an {argument name="main character outfit" default="American flag t-shirt and denim shorts"}, holding tongs with a slice of smoked meat towards the viewer. In the foreground right, a gentle girl with long dark hair and a white sweater sits at a wooden table writing in a notebook. In the background, two more girls are present: one with a brown ponytail carrying firewood, and another with short silver hair holding a blue mug. The scene is a sunny outdoor BBQ area with a large black smoker grill featuring a sign that reads {argument name="background grill sign" default="LONE STAR BBQ"}. In the immediate foreground is a {argument name="food platter" default="massive wooden platter loaded with sliced brisket, ribs, sausages, burnt ends, and pickles"}, along with side dishes like coleslaw and bread. In the top left corner, a large, cute, bubbly anime logo reads {argument name="anime title" default="もくもく すもーく ガールズ"} with smoke and grill motifs. In the bottom left corner, there is a {argument name="credits text block" default="staff credits block with names and roles"}. In the bottom right corner, a small text box lists four character names. The overall atmosphere is cheerful, highly detailed, and vibrant.

items.title: Epic Chinese Cityscape Ribbon Poster
items.description: Generates a stunning, culturally rich poster featuring a sweeping red ribbon, traditional and modern city elements, and customizable typography.
items.content: A stunning vertical poster illustration on a textured cream paper background, featuring a massive, flowing translucent red silk ribbon that spirals diagonally from the bottom right to the top left. At the bottom right, one woman in a flowing traditional red dress holds the end of the ribbon. The ribbon frames a highly detailed, sprawling cityscape that transitions from historic to modern. The lower and middle sections showcase traditional Chinese temples, pagodas, and historic arcade buildings adorned with red lanterns, alongside blooming peonies and golden clouds. Integrated into the left side of the ribbon's flow are three traditional Yingge dancers with painted faces in dynamic poses. The upper section reveals a sweeping teal coastal bay with modern skyscrapers, one long suspension bridge, three ships navigating the water, distant mountains, and seagulls flying near a golden sun. The bottom left corner features elegant typography: "{argument name="season and year" default="SPRING 2026"}" in a serif font, large golden Chinese calligraphy reading "{argument name="main city name" default="汕头"}", smaller vertical text "{argument name="subtitle" default="百载商埠 · 魅力汕头"}", and "{argument name="english location" default="SHANTOU CHINA"}" with a small red seal stamp. The art style is a breathtaking fusion of traditional Chinese ink wash painting and modern digital fantasy art, utilizing a vibrant palette of crimson, teal, and gold.

items.title: Anime Light Novel Cover Illustration
items.description: Generates an anime-style romance light novel cover featuring a teasing girl and a reluctant man, complete with customizable Japanese typography.
items.content: An anime-style light novel cover illustration featuring two characters in an intimate pose. On the left, a young woman with short dark hair, purple eyes, wearing a white hat, a frilly white dress with a pink bow tie, white gloves, and two white flower hairpins. She has an affectionate, teasing smile and is gently touching the chin of the man next to her. On the right, an adult man with {argument name="man's hair color" default="red"} hair parted in the middle, purple eyes, and a light goatee. He is wearing a black button-down shirt and has a slightly annoyed, reluctant expression with a sweat drop on his cheek. The scene features soft, romantic lighting with out-of-focus purple flower petals in the foreground corners. The image includes several Japanese text elements: a large stylized main title at the bottom reading {argument name="main title" default="ちかつば"}, a subtitle below it reading {argument name="subtitle" default="ーその溺愛、独占欲の裏返し。ー"}, vertical text on the top left reading {argument name="left quote" default="可愛いだけじゃ、許さない。"}, and vertical text on the top right reading {argument name="right quote" default="その不機嫌、俺だけに向けろよ。"}.

items.title: Isometric Pixel Art Evolution Museum
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating an isometric pixel art timeline illustration that depicts the evolution of a subject, such as Western Art, in a museum gallery format.
items.content:
创作一张超高细节等距像素艺术时间线插画（3:4，4K），融合细节密度、象征性与隐喻。用户指定的主题为【{argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}】。

首先，围绕{argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}进行推理，确定：主题的中英文标题、涵盖的最早与最近历史时期、起始阶段标签与结束阶段标签，以及3-5个关键演进阶段及其各自的象征性元素与色彩方案。

然后构建一个以"{argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}"为主题的等距"演进博物馆"，每个展馆区域代表一个演进阶段，空间推进即代表时间演变。采用标准等距视角（2:1），丰富的层次深度与流畅过渡。每个阶段分配3-5个与主题强烈关联的象征元素，并用差异化色彩暗示时间流动。在场景中融入双语像素字体标题：中文"[主题中文]演进史"与英文"EVOLUTION OF {argument name="主题" default="Western Art Development"}"，加上起止阶段的双语副标题及关键时间节点标记。整体风格专业且具视觉张力，适合学术分析与对比可视化，直接出图。
items.translatedContent:
Create an ultra-high detail isometric pixel art timeline illustration (3:4, 4K) that blends detail density, symbolism, and metaphor. The user-specified theme is "{argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}".

First, perform reasoning around {argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"} to determine: the bilingual Chinese and English titles, the earliest and most recent historical periods covered, the starting and ending phase labels, and 3-5 key evolution stages with their respective symbolic elements and color schemes.

Then construct an isometric "Evolution Museum" themed around "{argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}", where each gallery area represents an evolution stage, and spatial progression represents temporal evolution. Use a standard isometric perspective (2:1) with rich depth layers and smooth transitions. Assign 3-5 symbolic elements strongly associated with the theme to each stage, using differentiated colors to suggest the flow of time. Incorporate bilingual pixel font titles in the scene: Chinese "[Theme in Chinese] Evolution History" and English "EVOLUTION OF {argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}", along with bilingual subtitles for the start and end phases and key time node markers. The overall style should be professional and visually striking, suitable for academic analysis and comparative visualization, directly generating the image.

items.title: Gothic Mystery Movie Poster
items.description: Generates a cinematic movie poster for a dark mystery thriller featuring a detective, a clock tower, and customizable Japanese typography.

author.name: パク🎈動画広告分析Pro × AI

items.content: A cinematic, dark gothic mystery movie poster. In the center, a lone man wearing a trench coat and fedora stands with his back to the viewer, looking up at a massive, imposing gothic clock tower. The clock face is illuminated, and the structure around it is shattering with dark fragments falling. The setting is a foggy, wet cobblestone square at night, illuminated by warm yellow streetlamps and glowing windows from surrounding European-style buildings. A full moon shines through cloudy skies. There are exactly 3 ravens: one perched on a stone monument on the left, and two flying in the sky. The monument on the left has engraved text "VERITAS IN UMBRA, TEMPUS NEMINI PARET". On the right, a wooden signpost has 3 directional arrows reading "Marktplatz", "Uhrenturm", and "Alte Gasse", with a small newspaper leaning against it reading "Die Uhr steht." and "Wer lügt?". The poster features elegant, slightly distressed serif Japanese typography. At the top, a horizontal tagline reads {argument name="top tagline" default="真夜中、時は止まり、嘘が動き出す。"}. On the upper left, a vertical tagline reads {argument name="side tagline" default="その鐘の音が、真実を葬った。"}. In the lower center, the large main title reads {argument name="main title" default="時計塔の殺人"}. Below the title is a smaller tagline "時を欺いたのは、誰だ。" followed by a dense block of realistic movie credits including director, cast, and crew names. At the very bottom, the release text {argument name="release date" default="2025年 秋 全国ロードショー"} is displayed alongside a website URL and rating logos. The entire poster is framed by a thin, ornate gold border.

items.content: 以涂鸦速写风表现【{argument name="主体" default="一个厉害的AI builder"}】，整体呈现快速勾勒、自由变形、即兴手绘与草稿式的视觉效果。线条随手、夸张、可粗细不一，略显凌乱但具有节奏和表现力，强调概括、夸张、趣味和随性，而不是严谨写实或精细刻画。 颜色采用粗糙、干刷感明显的块面表现，可保留不均匀的涂抹痕迹、刷痕、飞白与覆盖感，色彩根据【主题/主体】自动适配，但整体保持涂鸦式、速写式、概括式的表达。不要透明水彩晕染效果，不要细腻水彩过渡，不要纸纹理，不要柔和雾化，不要梦幻质感。 背景以留白为主，保持简洁、轻松、未完成感和设计感，可加入少量辅助性符号、箭头、记号、圈画、重复线、随手写的文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔式视觉语言，但不可过于拥挤，不可破坏主体和留白气质。 画面内容不需要预先写清楚，由【{argument name="主体" default="一个厉害的AI builder"}】自动推演并生成最适合的主体形象、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景，整体保持统一的涂鸦速写风和夸张概括的表现方式，避免复杂写实背景 and 过度铺陈。 画面中需自然加入专属签名"{argument name="签名" default="BlanPlan"}"，作为画面的一部分，位置低调但清晰，可放在左下角、右下角或标题附近，风格需与整体版式统一，像作品署名或设计落款；签名字体精致、克制、高级，不可过大，不可破坏主体构图，不可显得突兀或廉价。
items.translatedContent: Express [{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"}] in a graffiti sketch style, presenting an overall visual effect of rapid sketching, free transformation, improvised hand-drawing, and draft-like qualities. Lines are casual, exaggerated, varied in thickness, slightly messy but rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. Colors use rough, dry-brush block expressions, retaining uneven smears, brush marks, flying whites, and overlapping feelings. Colors automatically adapt to the [theme/subject], but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamlike quality. The background is mainly white space, remaining simple, relaxed, unfinished, and design-oriented. A small amount of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and atmosphere of the white space. The image content does not need to be written in advance; the [{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"}] will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The whole maintains a unified graffiti sketch style and exaggerated generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and over-elaboration. Naturally add a unique signature "{argument name="signature" default="BlanPlan"}" as part of the image, placed discreetly but clearly in the lower-left, lower-right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or design inscription; the signature font should be refined, restrained, and high-end, not too large, not destructive to the main composition, and not appearing abrupt or cheap.

items.title: Anime Light Novel Cover with Painters
items.description: Generates a vibrant anime-style promotional illustration featuring characters painting, complete with stylized Japanese title logos and taglines.
items.content: An anime-style promotional illustration of 3 characters running forward dynamically amidst a joyful painting scene under a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds. On the left, a blonde young woman in an elegant white ruffled dress and gloves smiles brightly, holding a paintbrush dripping with pink paint. In the center, a black-haired young man in blue overalls and a black t-shirt looks excited, holding a roll of masking tape and a green paint roller. On the right, an older laughing man wears dark traditional Japanese work clothes with a white towel around his neck. Colorful paint splatters fly through the air alongside floating props including 2 paint buckets, 2 paintbrushes, and 2 rolls of masking tape. At the top is a stylized title logo reading {argument name="main title" default="お嬢様は塗装を知らない"} decorated with paint splatters. Below it is a banner ribbon reading {argument name="subtitle" default="清楚なお嬢様 × 塗装男子"}. At the bottom, a bold tagline reads {argument name="bottom tagline" default="未知の世界でふたりの距離が縮まっていく…！"}. The style features vibrant colors and a light novel cover aesthetic.

items.title: Japanese Self-Help Book Cover Mockup
items.description: Generates a realistic 3D mockup of a Japanese self-help book with customizable title, subtitle, and promotional belly band text.
items.content: A realistic 3D mockup of a softcover book standing upright at a slight angle on a plain off-white background, revealing both the front cover and the spine. The cover features a minimalist, serene illustration of a white arched doorway opening to a bright pastel sunrise over a calm sea, with a woman in a flowing white dress standing in the archway looking toward the horizon. Large, elegant vertical Japanese text in a Mincho serif font dominates the right and left sides of the arch, reading {argument name="main title" default="我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。"}. In the top left corner, smaller horizontal text reads {argument name="subtitle" default="自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ"}. The bottom third of the book is wrapped in a light pink belly band. The band features a prominent horizontal catchphrase reading {argument name="obi catchphrase" default="もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。"}, with smaller text above it separated by a dotted line mentioning work, relationships, love, and future anxiety. On the right side of the band is a white circular badge with a small crown icon and text reading {argument name="sales badge text" default="累計 20万部 突破!"}. At the very bottom of the band are exactly 4 small rectangular boxes containing keywords about self-esteem, time management, mental organization, and ideal future, followed by the text "Everything will change!". The spine is white and displays the main title, subtitle, a placeholder for the author's name, and a placeholder for the publisher.

items.title: Sci-Fi Anime Detective Poster
items.description: Generates a cinematic sci-fi anime poster featuring a character sitting in a high-tech chair in space, complete with customizable titles and taglines.
items.content: A cinematic anime-style sci-fi movie poster. In the center, a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long silver"} hair and blue eyes sits confidently in a massive, futuristic grey armchair with glowing light blue neon accents. She wears a black trench coat over a white high-collared shirt, black pants, and black heeled boots. The chair rests on a glowing blue circular holographic platform floating in deep space filled with stars. Behind her, translucent blue holographic screens display data and planetary images. At the top center, the series title {argument name="series title" default="『電脳椅子探偵シャルロット』"} is written in small white text, above the large main title {argument name="main title" default="『天使の涙』"} in an elegant serif font. Below the main title is the tagline {argument name="subtitle" default="すべての記録は、この出会いから始まった。"}. At the bottom center of the poster, a block of text reads "This is the first record of Charlotte and W.A.T.S.O.N." followed by a large stylized title {argument name="bottom text" default="シャルロット & W.A.T.S.O.N."} and credits "Original Story / Screenplay / Director noriyang" at the very bottom. The overall atmosphere is mysterious, high-tech, and epic.

items.content: A cinematic sci-fi anime movie poster of a heavily armored cylindrical deep-sea submarine on a rocky ocean floor. The sub features a glowing cyan central viewport, a ring of smaller lights, two bright downward spotlights, and "{argument name="hull text" default="NEREIS-01"}" painted on its side. Behind it looms a {argument name="creature type" default="colossal bioluminescent anemone-like entity"} with radiating tentacles tipped with cyan lights. The dark teal abyss features glowing seabed flora. Top left text includes the Japanese title "{argument name="main title" default="深淵の地平線"}", the subtitle "{argument name="english subtitle" default="ABYSS HORIZON"}", and the tagline "{argument name="tagline" default="暗黒は、終わりじゃない。人類の新しい始まりだ。"}". Small technical footer text reads "INTERNATIONAL DEEP SEA TREATY ORGANIZATION" on the bottom left and "IDTO-AB-013300-ALPHA" on the bottom right. Highly detailed, dramatic lighting, industrial mecha design.

items.title: Mirrored Actor Retrospective Poster
items.description: Reorganizes a biographical movie poster by flipping the layout, shifting the timeline to the right, and adding era categories alongside new symbolic props.
items.content: Using the provided reference image, redesign the poster layout by horizontally flipping the macro composition. Move the large primary profile face to the right side, looking left. Move the main title {argument name="main title" default="LEONARDO A LIFE IN ROLES"} to the top right. Relocate the filmography timeline to the right column beneath the title, and append new era category labels to the far right: "YOUTH 1990s", "ASCENT 2000s", "EXCESS 2010s", and "SURVIVAL 2020s". Shift the blended character montage to the left side and lower middle, featuring exactly 12 distinct smaller character portraits (including a pilot, a man yelling into a microphone, a tuxedoed man toasting, and a bearded frontiersman). In the bottom left corner, introduce new elements not in the reference: a vintage pocket watch on a chain, blood splatter, and an axe handle. At the bottom right, add a new quote {argument name="quote text" default="HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS. HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY."} and exactly 2 award laurel graphics reading "ACADEMY AWARD WINNER" and "A CAREER FOR THE AGES". Add a final bottom-center tagline {argument name="tagline" default="SAME MAN. ENDLESS TRUTHS."} above the signature.

items.title: Museum Catalog Artifact Breakdown
items.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating museum-style technical breakdown infographics for artifacts or historical clothing.
items.content:
请根据 {argument name="题材" default="清代皇帝龙袍"} 自动生成一张“博物馆图鉴式中文拆解信息图”。

要求整张图兼具真实写实主视觉、结构拆解、中文标注、材质说明、纹样寓意、色彩含义和核心特征总结。你需要根据【清代皇帝龙袍】自动判断最合适的主体对象、服饰体系、器物结构、时代风格、关键部件、材质工艺、颜色方案与版式结构，用户无需再提供其他信息。

整体风格应为：国家博物馆展板、历史服饰图鉴、文博专题信息图，而不是普通海报、古风写真、电商详情页或动漫插画。背景采用米白、绢纸白、浅茶色等纸张质感，整体高级、克制、专业、可收藏。

版式固定为：
- 顶部：中文主标题 + 副标题 + 导语
- 左侧：结构拆解区，中文引线标注关键部件，并配局部特写
- 右上：材质 / 工艺 / 质感区，展示真实纹理小样并附说明
- 右中：纹样 / 色彩 / 寓意区，展示主色板、纹样样本和文化解释
- 底部：穿着顺序 / 构成流程图 + 核心特征总结

若主题适合人物展示，则以真实人物全身站姿为中央主体；若更适合器物或单体结构，则改为中心主体拆解图，但整体仍保持完整中文信息图形式。所有文字必须为简体中文，清晰、规整、可读，不要乱码、错字、英文或拼音。重点突出真实结构、材质差异、文化说明与图鉴气质。

避免：海报感、影楼感、电商感、动漫感、cosplay感、乱标注、错结构、糊字、假材质、过度装饰。
items.translatedContent:
Please automatically generate a "Museum Illustration-style Chinese Dismantling Infographic" based on {argument name="subject" default="Qing Dynasty Emperor's Dragon Robe"}.

The final image must possess a realistic main visual, structural dismantling, Chinese annotations, material descriptions, pattern meanings, color significance, and a summary of core features. You need to automatically determine the most suitable subject, clothing system, artifact structure, period style, key components, material craftsmanship, color scheme, and layout structure based on the subject, without the user providing further information.

The overall style should be: National Museum exhibition board, historical costume illustration, or a cultural heritage thematic infographic, rather than a regular poster, ancient-style portraiture, e-commerce detail page, or anime illustration. The background uses textures like off-white, silk paper white, or light tea color, making the overall look high-end, restrained, professional, and collectible.

The fixed layout is:
- Top: Chinese main title + subtitle + introduction
- Left side: Structural dismantling area, using Chinese leader lines to label key parts, accompanied by local close-ups
- Top right: Material / Craftsmanship / Texture area, showing real texture samples with explanations
- Middle right: Pattern / Color / Symbolism area, showing main color palette, pattern samples, and cultural interpretations
- Bottom: Wearing order / Composition flowchart + summary of core features

If the theme is suitable for showing a person, use a real person in a full-body standing pose as the central subject; if it's more suitable for an artifact or a single structure, change to a central subject dismantling diagram, while maintaining a complete Chinese infographic format. All text must be in Simplified Chinese, clear, regular, and readable, avoiding garbled characters, typos, English, or Pinyin. Emphasize authentic structures, material differences, cultural explanations, and illustration temperament.

Avoid: Poster feel, photo studio feel, e-commerce feel, anime feel, cosplay feel, incorrect labeling, wrong structure, blurry text, fake materials, or excessive decoration.

items.title: Urban Street Style Character Study
items.description: A highly detailed complex prompt testing spatial accuracy and descriptive adherence, featuring a young woman in a 'looking back' pose within an urban setting.
items.content: 该画面为中近景，采用平视镜头，聚焦于一位{argument name="主体" default="年轻女性"}。她以七分身镜头呈现，身体坐姿略带倾斜，臀部向后撅起，双腿自然交叠，左腿在前，右腿在后，膝盖微屈。她将上半身向右后方扭转，头部则转向镜头方向，形成一个经典的“回眸”姿态，目光直视镜头，眼神清澈而略带一丝俏皮。她的发型是{argument name="发型" default="蓬松的棕色齐肩短发"}，刘海自然垂落，发尾微卷，妆容清淡自然，仅在眼部有轻微眼线勾勒，唇色为自然裸粉。画面整体采用自然日光滤镜，光线从画面左上方斜射入，形成柔和的逆光轮廓，面部和身体右侧被温暖的金色光线照亮，左侧则形成自然的阴影过渡，增强了立体感。灯光效果是明亮的自然光，带有轻微的镜头眩光，营造出午后阳光的氛围。拍摄角度为平视，构图上，人物主体位于画面中偏右位置，背景中的斑马线与道路线条形成自然的引导线，将视线引向人物。背景为城市街道，包含道路、斑马线、绿化带和远处的车辆，背景被适度虚化，但依然可辨识出树木、护栏和停放的电动车等元素，构图上利用了三分法，人物位于右侧三分之一处，增强了画面的平衡感。主体穿着一件{argument name="服装" default="军绿色迷彩图案的连帽卫衣"}，下身搭配黑色短裤，脚穿白色高帮运动鞋配白色中筒袜。背包为黑色，带有橙黄色装饰条纹和一个橙色毛绒挂件，材质为帆布和皮革拼接。整体风格为街头休闲风，肢体语言放松自然，表情略带好奇与俏皮，整体呈现出一种随性、青春、充满活力的都市少女形象。

She is shown in a three-quarter shot, sitting with a slight tilt, hips pushed back, legs naturally crossed with the left leg in front and right behind, knees slightly bent. She turns her upper body toward the back right, with her head facing the camera in a classic 'looking back' pose, eyes direct and clear with a hint of playfulness. Her hairstyle is {argument name="hairstyle" default="voluminous brown shoulder-length short hair"} with natural bangs and slightly curled ends. Her makeup is light and natural, with slight eyeliner and natural nude-pink lips. The overall image uses a natural daylight filter, with light hitting from the upper left to create a soft back-lit silhouette. The face and right side of the body are illuminated by warm golden light, while the left side has a natural shadow transition to enhance three-dimensionality. The lighting effect is bright natural light with slight lens flare, creating an afternoon sun atmosphere. From an eye-level angle, the composition places the subject in the middle-right of the frame, with crosswalks and road lines in the background serving as natural leading lines toward the figure. The background is a city street including roads, crosswalks, green belts, and distant vehicles; it is moderately blurred but elements like trees, guardrails, and parked scooters remain recognizable. The composition uses the rule of thirds, with the figure on the right third to balance the frame. The subject wears a {argument name="clothing" default="army green camo hooded sweatshirt"}, paired with black shorts and white high-top sneakers with white mid-calf socks. The backpack is black with orange-yellow decorative stripes and an orange plush pendant, made of canvas and leather. The overall style is street casual, with relaxed body language and a curious, playful expression, presenting an image of a spontaneous, youthful, and vibrant urban girl.

items.title: Calligraphic City Impression Poster
items.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating artistic city posters that blend traditional Chinese calligraphy with modern architectural elements, featuring a transparent bird motif and detailed urban landmarks.
items.content: 【背景与骨架线条】 纯黑深邃底色，一条粗壮有力的墨色书法S型曲线自画面一端蜿蜒贯穿至另一端，笔触苍劲，墨迹浓淡有致，如大写意行笔，构成整幅画面的视觉骨架与叙事动线。 【主体：{argument name="主体鸟类" default="画眉鸟"}】 曲线上方，一只展翅飞翔的画眉鸟占据视觉核心；身体呈玻璃透明质感，内部映射传统建筑群叠影，蓝绿色光流在透明羽翼间流转折射，仿佛时间长河与文明记忆凝缩其中；轮廓以极细金线勾边，增强立体感与神圣感。 【中景：古典建筑序列】 燕子下方，沿墨线曲线错落分布{argument name="城市" default="广州"}的各种风景名胜：白云山、陈家祠、双子塔、广州塔、猎德大桥、海珠塔依次浮现；主色调青绿与淡金，建筑细节清晰，琉璃瓦、飞檐翘角、石阶回廊；木棉花簇拥点缀于建筑周围，花瓣随风轻散，静谧而悠远；几朵水墨云朵轻盈飘浮其间，增添空灵层次。 【前景：白鹤与水面】 前景湖畔：数只白鹤或静立水边、或振翅腾飞，姿态各异，优雅从容；浅蓝湖面如镜，倒影荡漾，波光细碎，营造宁静氛围。 【远景：山峦】 远处山峦层叠起伏，青黛色晕染，墨色由浓至淡，朦胧氤氲，富有水墨层次；与前景形成近实远虚的空间纵深。 【构图与光影】 非线性透视构图，墨线曲线为叙事主轴，古今元素沿线嵌入；光源自画面中心向外辐射扩散，形成强烈明暗对比，中心亮、四周渐暗；冷色调主导（深蓝、青绿、银白），暖色点缀（樱花粉、淡金），和谐而神秘；东方美学与现代意象交融，超现实诗意意境。 【技术规格】 8K超高清渲染，极致细节精度，最佳画质，比例 {argument name="比例" default="9:16"}
items.translatedContent: 【Background and Skeleton Lines】 Deep black background, a thick and powerful ink calligraphy S-shaped curve winding across the screen, vigorous strokes with varied ink density, forming the visual skeleton and narrative flow. 【Subject: {argument name="subject bird" default="thrush"}】 Above the curve, a {argument name="subject bird" default="thrush"} with wings spread occupies the visual core; the body is transparent like glass, reflecting traditional architectural layers inside with blue-green light streams; the outline is edged with fine gold lines. 【Mid-ground: Classical Architectural Sequence】 Below the bird, various scenic spots of {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} are scattered along the ink line: Baiyun Mountain, Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, and the Canton Tower; the main tones are blue-green and pale gold with clear architectural details; Kapok flowers and ink-wash clouds add ethereal layers. 【Foreground: White Cranes and Water Surface】 Lakeside foreground: several white cranes in various elegant poses; the light blue water is mirror-like with sparkling light, creating a serene atmosphere. 【Background: Mountains】 Distant mountains rise and fall in indigo ink shading from thick to light, creating depth of field. 【Composition and Lighting】 Non-linear perspective with the ink curve as the axis; light radiates from the center creating strong contrast; cool tones dominate with warm accents; fusion of Eastern aesthetics and modern imagery. 【Technical Specs】 8K Ultra HD rendering, extreme detail precision, best quality, ratio {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

S型流动构图，画面从下方向上延展，一条由足球运动轨迹形成的动态能量流贯穿画面， 中心为一颗发光的足球，带有动感轨迹与能量光效；

沿S型动线融合广东城市地标与文化元素： 广州塔、深圳平安金融中心、珠海渔女雕像、岭南建筑与佛山武术剪影、中山孙中山文化象征、潮汕英歌舞动态人物轮廓、清远山水自然景观， 所有元素采用“线描 + 局部色块 + 留白”融合表现，层次递进、远近虚实结合；

加入抽象足球运动员剪影，弱化人物细节，强化动势与竞技氛围，视觉重点仍为足球；

风格：现代国潮高级海报，极简风格但富有设计感，高级、干净、统一， 融合东方美学与现代体育视觉；

整体版式平衡、具有高级品牌海报质感，极致精细，构图简洁干净，无杂乱元素，电影级光影，8K 分辨率，高端设计感。融入源自中国传统祥云纹的雅致云纹与水波纹元素，浮动光效粒子，富有动感与生机。

items.content: Using the provided reference image, generate a {argument name="number of panels" default="4"}-panel studio-style character sheet. items.content: Using REFERENCE_0 as a wireframe layout, generate a polished, professional corporate web banner ad for an AI sales tool. Use a clean blue, white, and orange color palette. Finally, add a white panel in the bottom left containing exactly 3 blue line-art icons (a clock, a rising chart, and a laptop) with short captions below each.

items.title: KAWAISALES Ad Design
items.description: A professional advertisement generation prompt that uses a handwritten layout as a reference to create a modern sales tool promotional image.
items.content:
この手書きラフ（添付画像）のレイアウトを再現し、下記の要件で広告画像を生成してください。

# タイトル・企画
- AIを活用した新しい営業支援ツール「{argument name="ツール名" default="KAWAISALES"}」

# 目的
- 無料デモの申し込み獲得

# ターゲット
- 営業成績に伸び悩む中小企業の営業担当者

# 内容
## メインコピー
- その営業、AIで「飛躍」しませんか？
## サブコピー
- リード獲得からクロージングまでAI があなたの営業活動を強力サポート！
## CTA
- 今すぐ無料デモを体験する## アイキャッチ1
- ノートPCを見ながら笑顔で顧客とオンライン商談をしている、スタイリッシュなスーツ姿の30代男女の営業担当者（フォトリアル）
## アイキャッチ2
- 右肩上がりのグラフや、ターゲット顧客を示すアイコンなど、サービスのメリットを象徴する抽象的なイラストや図形。

# 印象
- 信頼感、革新的、成果が出そう、使いやすそう

Reproduce the layout of this handwritten rough (attached image) and generate an advertisement image with the following requirements.

# Title/Project
- A new sales support tool using AI: "{argument name="tool name" default="KAWAISALES"}"

# Purpose
- To gain free demo sign-ups

# Target
- Sales representatives of small and medium-sized enterprises struggling with sales performance

# Content
## Main Copy
- Why not let your sales "take flight" with AI?
## Sub-copy
- AI strongly supports your sales activities from lead acquisition to closing!
## CTA
- Experience the free demo now! ## Eye-catch 1
- A photorealistic stylish male and female sales representative in their 30s in suits, smiling while having an online business meeting with a customer on a laptop.
## Eye-catch 2
- Abstract illustrations or shapes symbolizing service benefits, such as a rising graph or icons indicating target customers.

# Impression
- Trustworthy, innovative, productive, easy to use

items.title: Museum Style Infographic Breakdown
items.description: A comprehensive prompt template for generating museum-style technical breakdown infographics for traditional items like Hanfu or artifacts.
items.content:
请根据【主题：{argument name="主题" default="汉服"}】自动生成一张“博物馆图鉴式中文拆解信息图”。

要求整张图兼具真实写实主视觉、结构拆解、中文标注、材质说明、纹样寓意、色彩含义和核心特征总结。你需要根据【主题】自动判断最合适的主体对象、服饰体系、器物结构、时代风格、关键部件、材质工艺、颜色方案与版式结构，用户无需再提供其他信息。

整体风格应为：国家博物馆展板、历史服饰图鉴、文博专题信息图，而不是普通海报、古风写真、电商详情页或动漫插画。背景采用米白、绢纸白、浅茶色等纸张质感，整体高级、克制、专业、可收藏。

版式固定为：
- 顶部：中文主标题 + 副标题 + 导语
- 左侧：结构拆解区，中文引线标注关键部件，并配局部特写
- 右上：材质 / 工艺 / 质感区，展示真实纹理小样并附说明
- 右中：纹样 / 色彩 / 寓意区，展示主色板、纹样样本和文化解释
- 底部：穿着顺序 / 构成流程图 + 核心特征总结

若主题适合人物展示，则以真实人物全身站姿为中央主体；若更适合器物或单体结构，则改为中心主体拆解图，但整体仍保持完整中文信息图形式。所有文字必须为简体中文，清晰、规整、可读，不要乱码、错字、英文或拼音。重点突出真实结构、材质差异、文化说明与图鉴气质。
items.translatedContent:
Please automatically generate a "Museum Guide-style Chinese Breakdown Infographic" based on the [Theme: {argument name="theme" default="Hanfu"}].

Requirements: The entire image must combine a realistic main visual, structural breakdown, Chinese annotations, material descriptions, pattern meanings, color symbolism, and a summary of core features. You need to automatically determine the most suitable subject, clothing system, artifact structure, era style, key components, material craftsmanship, color scheme, and layout based on the [Theme] without further user input.

The overall style should be: National Museum exhibition board, historical clothing guide, or cultural museum special infographic, rather than a common poster, ancient-style photo, e-commerce details page, or anime illustration. The background should use paper textures like off-white, silk white, or light tea color. The overall look should be high-end, restrained, professional, and collectible.

The layout is fixed as:
- Top: Chinese main title + sub-title + introduction
- Left: Structural breakdown area with Chinese leader lines marking key components and matching close-ups
- Top Right: Material/Craftsmanship/Texture area showing real texture samples with descriptions
- Middle Right: Pattern/Color/Meaning area showing the main color palette, pattern samples, and cultural explanations
- Bottom: Wearing order / Composition flowchart + summary of core features

If the theme is suitable for person display, use a full-body standing pose of a real person as the central subject; if it's more suitable for artifacts, use a central subject breakdown, but maintain the complete Chinese infographic format. All text must be in Simplified Chinese, clear, neat, and readable without garbled characters or typos.

items.title: Hand-drawn Chengdu Food Map
items.description: A detailed prompt for a watercolor and colored pencil style illustrated map of Chengdu's famous food locations.
items.content: 一张手绘风格的城市美食地图，以{argument name="城市" default="成都"}为主题。画面以鸟瞰视角的手绘简化城市地图为底，标注主要道路和地标但不追求精确比例而是追求可爱的手绘感。地图上分布着 12 个美食地点的精致手绘小插画：{argument name="地标" default="春熙路的串串香"}（一把竹签插着各种食材冒着热气）、宽窄巷子的三大炮（三个糯米团子飞向铜盘）、建设路的蛋烘糕（金黄酥脆正在翻面）、玉林路的火锅（九宫格锅翻滚冒泡）等，每个插画约占地图的 5% 面积，旁边用手写体标注店名和一句推荐语"凌晨两点还在排队的那家"。地图边缘用手绘藤蔓和辣椒装饰形成边框。右下角有一个手绘指南针和图例说明。左上角标题"{argument name="标题" default="成都·吃货暴走地图"}"使用胖圆的手绘美术字配辣椒装饰。整体画风为水彩+彩铅混合的手绘质感，颜色以暖色系（辣椒红、姜黄、翠绿）为主，图片比例 1:1。
items.translatedContent: A hand-drawn style city food map with {argument name="city" default="Chengdu"} as the theme. The image is based on a bird's-eye view simplified hand-drawn city map, marking major roads and landmarks with a cute, non-proportional hand-drawn feel. Scattered across the map are 12 exquisite small hand-drawn illustrations of food spots: {argument name="landmark" default="Chunxi Road Chuan Chuan Xiang"} (skewers with various ingredients steaming), Kuanzhai Alley San Da Pao (three glutinous rice balls flying towards a copper plate), Jianshe Road Egg Pancakes (golden and crispy being flipped), Yulin Road Hotpot (nine-grid pot bubbling), etc. Each illustration occupies about 5% of the map area, with the shop name and a recommendation quote "The place with a queue at 2 AM" marked in handwriting next to it. The edges of the map are decorated with hand-drawn vines and chili peppers forming a border. There is a hand-drawn compass and legend in the bottom right corner. The top left title "{argument name="title" default="Chengdu Foodie Trek Map"}" uses chubby, rounded hand-drawn artistic fonts decorated with chili peppers. The overall style is a hand-drawn texture of mixed watercolor and colored pencils, with colors dominated by warm tones (chili red, ginger yellow, emerald green), 1:1 ratio.

items.title: Epic Fantasy Double Exposure Silhouette
items.description: A complex double-exposure illustration forming a man's profile filled with fantasy characters, creatures, and castles.
items.content: An {argument name="overall theme" default="epic fantasy"} illustration utilizing a {argument name="art style" default="watercolor and ink wash double exposure"} technique on a vintage parchment background. The overall composition forms the {argument name="main silhouette subject" default="right-facing profile of a man's head"}. Inside this silhouette is a complex montage of scenes and characters. At the top, a white tree with red leaves stands near a cliffside castle, with a white winged creature flying on the left and a black dragon breathing fire on the right. Below this, a blonde woman sits on a throne made of swords, while a cloaked figure stands on a hill nearby. In the center right, a romantic couple consisting of a blonde woman and a dark-haired man in a fur collar gaze at each other. To their left stands a knight in full plate armor holding a sword. Below them is a group of 3 figures: a man, a young woman, and a child. At the bottom, a large white wolf head is on the left, and a stag stands near a castle on the right. In the bottom center, a flaming heart hovers above 2 crossed swords and 1 golden crown. The {argument name="dominant color palette" default="muted earthy tones with splashes of red and orange"} creates a dramatic, legendary atmosphere.
