items.content: 一张充满{argument name="氛围" default="新春喜庆"}氛围但不失高雅格调的 {argument name="年份" default="2026"} 城市宣传海报。双重曝光，构图延续了S型的流动感；在纯白的纹理背景右下角，一个身穿中国传统服饰的微缩人物正在挥舞着一条长长的红色丝绸舞带，这条红绸在空中舞动，不仅展现出丝绸的柔顺质感，更在向左上方飘动的过程中，奇幻地变形成了一条壮丽的山脉河流。在这条“河流”中，叠加了一个有山有海河的广州城市手绘图，国潮，景色尽在眼底，壮阔雄伟，令人震撼。广州的地标建筑(广州塔，珠江新城建筑群，珠江, 广州城里古建筑，游轮，白云山）。云雾环绕，仙气缥缈，色彩丰富，结构复杂，细节丰富，但因为大面积的留白，画面依然显得清新脱俗，左下角排版着“SPRING 2026”和竖排的宣传语，整体寓意“{argument name="宣传语" default="千年商都，魅力广州"}”。文字排版优美，大方，字迹清晰完整，尺寸9:16。
items.translatedContent: A {argument name="year" default="2026"} city promotional poster filled with a {argument name="vibe" default="festive New Year"} atmosphere without losing its elegant style. Double exposure, the composition continues the flowing S-shaped sense; in the lower right corner of a pure white textured background, a miniature figure in traditional Chinese costume is waving a long red silk dance ribbon. This red silk dances in the air, not only showing the smooth texture of silk, but also fantastically transforming into a magnificent mountain and river as it floats toward the upper left. In this 'river', a hand-drawn map of Guangzhou with mountains, seas, and rivers is superimposed, featuring national tide style, the scenery is all in sight, magnificent and shocking. Landmarks of Guangzhou (Canton Tower, Zhujiang New Town buildings, Pearl River, ancient buildings in Guangzhou city, cruise ships, Baiyun Mountain). items.title: Graffiti Sketch Style AI Builder
items.description: A detailed prompt for creating stylized graffiti-style sketches of subjects, focusing on expressive lines and rough color blocks with a personalized signature.
items.content: 以涂鸦速写风表现【{argument name="主体" default="一个厉害的AI builder"}】，整体呈现快速勾勒、自由变形、即兴手绘与草稿式的视觉效果。线条随手、夸张、可粗细不一，略显凌乱但具有节奏和表现力，强调概括、夸张、趣味和随性，而不是严谨写实或精细刻画。 颜色采用粗糙、干刷感明显的块面表现，可保留不均匀的涂抹痕迹、刷痕、飞白与覆盖感，色彩根据【{argument name="主题" default="一个厉害的AI builder"}】自动适配，但整体保持涂鸦式、速写式、概括式的表达。不要透明水彩晕染效果，不要细腻水彩过渡，不要纸纹理，不要柔和雾化，不要梦幻质感。 背景以留白为主，保持简洁、轻松、未完成感和设计感，可加入少量辅助性符号、箭头、记号、圈画、重复线、随手写的文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔式视觉语言，但不可过于拥挤，不可破坏主体和留白气质。 画面内容不需要预先写清楚，由【{argument name="主体形象" default="一个厉害的AI builder"}】自动推演并生成最适合的主体形象、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景，整体保持统一的涂鸦速写风和夸张概括的表现方式，避免复杂写实背景和过度铺陈。 画面中需自然加入专属签名“BlanPlan”，作为画面的一部分，位置低调 but 清晰，可放在左下角、右下角或标题附近，风格需与整体版式统一，像作品署名或设计落款；签名字体精致、克制、高级，不可过大，不可破坏主体构图，不可显得突兀或廉价。
items.translatedContent: Express {argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"} in a graffiti sketch style, presenting an overall visual effect of quick outlines, free deformation, improvised hand-drawing, and draft-like sketches. The lines are casual, exaggerated, varying in thickness, and slightly messy but rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. The colors are expressed in rough blocks with a distinct dry-brush feel, retaining uneven smears, brush marks, fly-white, and layering. Colors automatically adapt to the {argument name="theme" default="powerful AI builder"}, but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging effects, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamy textures. The background is mainly white space, maintaining a sense of simplicity, ease, unfinishedness, and design. Small amounts of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but they should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and the white space atmosphere. The content of the picture does not need to be written in advance; {argument name="character image" default="a powerful AI builder"} will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The overall style remains a unified graffiti sketch style and an exaggerated, generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and excessive detail. A special signature 'BlanPlan' should be naturally added as part of the picture, in a low-key but clear position such as the bottom left, bottom right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or a design mark; the signature font should be exquisite, restrained, and high-end, not too large, and should not destroy the main composition or appear abrupt or cheap.

items.title: Graffiti Sketch Style Template
items.description: A comprehensive prompt template to create artistic sketches with a hand-drawn doodle aesthetic and personalized signature.
items.content:
以涂鸦速写风表现【{argument name="主体" default="主题/主体"}】，整体呈现快速勾勒、自由变形、即兴手绘与草稿式的视觉效果。线条随手、夸张、可粗细不一，略显凌乱 but 具有节奏和表现力，强调概括、夸张、趣味 and 随性，而不是严谨写实或精细刻画。

颜色采用粗糙、干刷感明显的块面表现，可保留不均匀的涂抹痕迹、刷痕、飞白与覆盖感，色彩根据【{argument name="主体" default="主题/主体"}】自动适配，但整体保持涂鸦式、速写式、概括式的表达。不要透明水彩晕染效果，不要细腻水彩过渡，不要纸纹理，不要柔和雾化，不要梦幻质感。

背景以留白为主，保持简洁、轻松、未完成感和设计感，可加入少量辅助性符号、箭头、记号、圈画、重复线、随手写的文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔式视觉语言，但不可过于拥挤，不可破坏主体和留白气质。

画面内容不需要预先写清楚，由【{argument name="主体" default="主题/主体"}】自动推演并生成最适合的主体形象、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景，整体保持统一的涂鸦速写风 and 夸张概括的表现方式，避免复杂写实背景 and 过度铺陈。
画面中需自然加入专属签名“voxcat”，作为画面的一部分，位置低调 but 清晰，可放在左下角、右下角或标题附近，风格需与整体版式统一，像作品署名或设计落款；签名字体精致、克制、高级，不可过大，不可破坏主体构图，不可显得突兀 or 廉价。
items.translatedContent: Express {argument name="subject" default="theme/subject"} in a graffiti sketch style, presenting an overall visual effect of quick outlines, free deformation, improvised hand-drawing, and draft-like sketches. The lines are casual, exaggerated, varying in thickness, and slightly messy but rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. The colors are expressed in rough blocks with a distinct dry-brush feel, retaining uneven smears, brush marks, fly-white, and layering. Colors automatically adapt to the {argument name="subject" default="theme/subject"}, but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging effects, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamy textures. The background is mainly white space, maintaining a sense of simplicity, ease, unfinishedness, and design. Small amounts of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but they should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and the white space atmosphere. The content of the picture does not need to be written in advance; {argument name="subject" default="theme/subject"} will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The overall style remains a unified graffiti sketch style and an exaggerated, generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and excessive detail. A special signature 'voxcat' should be naturally added as part of the picture, in a low-key but clear position such as the bottom left, bottom right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or a design mark; the signature font should be exquisite, restrained, and high-end, not too large, and should not destroy the main composition or appear abrupt or cheap.

items.title: Mecha Ink Wash Landscape Painting
items.description: Generates a traditional Chinese landscape painting featuring a giant mecha seamlessly blended into misty mountains and ink washes.
items.content: A traditional Chinese ink wash landscape painting featuring a giant mecha integrated into the misty mountains. The mecha, resembling {argument name="mecha type" default="Evangelion Unit-01"}, features a purple and green color scheme with a prominent horn and the number "01" on its shoulder. Its massive form dissolves into expressive, dripping black ink washes, seamlessly blending into the rocky mountain formations. The surrounding landscape includes steep, jagged peaks painted with teal and green washes, cascading waterfalls, ancient pine trees, and small traditional pavilions perched on the cliffs. A flock of birds flies through the dense fog filling the valleys. In the top left corner, vertical traditional Chinese calligraphy reads {argument name="main text" default="初號機"} followed by {argument name="sub text" default="人之造物 亦為山水"}, accompanied by a red artist seal stamp. Another red seal is stamped in the bottom right corner. The entire artwork is rendered on textured, aged rice paper, utilizing dynamic brushstrokes and atmospheric perspective typical of classical Shan shui art.

items.content: A first-person POV shot of a romantic dinner date with a {argument name="character" default="Minecraft Creeper"}. The scene is set in a {argument name="setting" default="romantic dimly lit restaurant"} with warm ambient lighting and a blurred background showing other tables and a window looking out into the night. The character is sitting directly across the table. Around its head are 7 {argument name="atmosphere effect" default="floating 8-bit red hearts"}. On the wooden table between the viewer and the character, there is a red and white checkered placemat. On it sits a voxel-style plate containing a {argument name="food" default="blocky steak with red and green garnish"}. To the left is a blocky, transparent wine glass filled with red wine. To the right is a blocky red rose in a transparent blocky vase. There are 2 glowing blocky candles in wooden holders on the table. The foreground shows the blurred edge of the viewer's own matching plate of food. The entire image blends realistic cinematic lighting and depth of field with voxel-based, 3D pixel-art objects.

items.title: Cinematic Anime Train Station Poster
items.description: Generates a highly detailed, cinematic anime-style movie poster featuring a character at a twilight train station with customizable typography.

author.name: みかみ.ai｜AI発信と個人開発

items.content: A cinematic anime-style movie poster featuring an {argument name="character description" default="anime girl with short blue hair, blue cat ears, and a fluffy blue cat tail, wearing an oversized white t-shirt"}. She is standing on a wet, reflective outdoor train station platform at twilight, looking back over her shoulder with a gentle, melancholic expression. The background features a beautifully detailed sky transitioning from deep blue to orange and pink, with scattered clouds and early stars. To the left is an illuminated vending machine and an overhead electronic sign displaying Japanese text about the terminal station. To the right, train tracks curve away into the distance alongside rusty metal railings and a convex mirror. The lighting is atmospheric and nostalgic. At the top center, small elegant Japanese text reads "{argument name="top tagline" default="終点のひとつ手前で、ソーダさんはいつも笑う。"}". At the bottom, large elegant Japanese typography displays the main title "{argument name="main title text" default="終点からソーダさん"}", with the English subtitle "{argument name="english subtitle" default="FROM THE TERMINAL, SODA-SAN"}" just below it. At the very bottom edge, small Japanese text reads "{argument name="bottom tagline" default="たぶん恋ではなく、もう少し炭酸だった。"}".

items.title: Anime Scholars with Cosmic Holograms
items.description: Generates an anime-style scene of two characters studying magical, floating holographic spheres in a cozy, sunset-lit room.
items.content: An anime illustration of two characters at a desk in a {argument name="setting" default="cozy study overlooking the ocean at sunset"}. In the foreground, a young man in a dark knit sweater sits with his back to the viewer. Facing him is a young woman with {argument name="female character hair" default="long blonde hair"} and {argument name="female character eyes" default="striking, glowing blue eyes"}, wearing an elegant navy and white Victorian dress with a sapphire brooch. Floating between them are exactly 4 glowing holographic spheres connected by faint lines, showing {argument name="hologram theme" default="cosmic and futuristic scenes"}: a swirling galaxy, a golden energy tree, a futuristic control room, and a planet with an energy burst. The desk holds open astronomical journals, a starry mug with steam, a glowing brass lamp, a pocket watch, and a pen. Warm sunset lighting contrasts with the magical blue and gold holograms.

She is wearing an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="light purple"} hoodie, frayed denim shorts, black high-top sneakers, and a black backpack. Her arms are crossed, and her legs are crossed at the ankles as she looks calmly to the side. The side of the vending machine features a large, striking advertisement for an energy drink: a black can with a pink graffiti-style smiley face with X eyes and a sticking-out tongue, accompanied by the large text "{argument name="can text" default="NOPE"}". The front of the machine displays rows of various bottled drinks, with a second identical black and pink can graphic visible on the lower panel. The scene is brightly lit with detailed shading and vibrant colors.

items.title: Retro 3D Claymation Desk Setup
items.description: Generates a highly detailed, cute 3D illustration of a retro computer desk with customizable text elements.
items.content: A vibrant, cute 3D claymation-style illustration of a retro yellow desktop computer setup on a desk. The central yellow CRT monitor displays a teal screen with the {argument name="OS logo text" default="Microsoft Windows 98"} logo and 7 desktop icons labeled 'My Computer', 'Online Services', 'My Documents', 'Outlook Express', 'Internet Explorer', 'Connect to the Internet', and 'Recycle Bin', plus a bottom taskbar with a 'Start' button and a clock reading '5:49 PM'. The monitor has a yellow sticky note reading '{argument name="monitor sticky note" default="Be Happy"}' and a small yellow bird perched on top. The computer base is labeled 'CREATIVE PC'. In front is a yellow mechanical keyboard labeled 'KBD-98' with orange and cream keys, and a yellow mouse labeled 'MS'. To the left is a green desk lamp, a smiling potted cactus, a blue floppy disk labeled '{argument name="floppy disk label" default="FUN STUFF"}', and a blue mug reading '{argument name="mug text" default="COFFEE TIME!"}' with a smiley face. To the right are 2 stacked books (green 'WINDOWS 98 MANUAL', blue 'INTERNET EXPLORER') and 2 smiling balloons (orange and yellow). The foreground features a green cutting mat, a yellow pencil, a green tape dispenser labeled 'TAPE IT!', 2 crayons, a pink sticky note reading 'Take a Break!', and a white notepad with a 5-item 'TO DO LIST': '1. Be Awesome', '2. Play More', '3. Call Mom', '4. Eat Snacks', '5. Smile :)'. The background wall has a green and cream clock, a white poster reading '{argument name="poster text" default="HAVE A NICE DAY!"}' with a smiling sun and 'Do Your Best!', and 3 additional sticky notes: a yellow one reading 'Dream Big Work Hard!', a pink one reading 'You've Got This!', and a green one reading 'Meeting 10:00 AM!'.

items.title: 3D Realistic X Profile Interface
items.description: A detailed prompt for generating a hyper-realistic 3D social media profile interface based on a reference screenshot with specific character expressions.
items.content: 根据上传的我的X个人主页截图，生成一幅{argument name="风格" default="超写实"}的3D推特/X个人资料界面插图，略微倾斜，背景干净简洁，灰色极简。原始头像保持不变。个人资料界面完全匹配一张真实的X截图，屏幕右侧边缘，根据上传头像图片中的人物，他正冲破破损的纸张。他的面部特征完全相同（不改变脸部），但现在拥有了自然的灿烂笑容、富有表现力的眼睛和柔和发光的皮肤。他手握着撕裂的纸边，画面中呈现出动态的3D效果。 纸片飞溅，营造出逼真的突破幻觉。灯光是柔和的摄影棚灯光，带有电影般的阴影和景深。超细致，4K，写实+皮克斯风格的混色，清晰对焦。重要提示：- 不要更改头像（DP） - 保持完全相同的 X 界面布局和文本样式 - 保持他们的原始面貌身份 - 仅能将表情增强为自然的微笑 - 比例 {argument name="比例" default="9:16"}
items.translatedContent: Based on the uploaded screenshot of my X profile, generate a {argument name="style" default="hyper-realistic"} 3D Twitter/X profile interface illustration, slightly tilted, with a clean and simple background in minimalist grey. The original avatar remains unchanged. The profile interface perfectly matches a real X screenshot. At the right edge of the screen, based on the person in the uploaded avatar, he is breaking through torn paper. His facial features are identical (no changes to the face), but he now has a natural radiant smile, expressive eyes, and softly glowing skin. He is holding the torn edges of the paper, creating a dynamic 3D effect. Paper fragments are flying, creating a realistic illusion of breaking through. The lighting is soft studio lighting with cinematic shadows and depth of field. Ultra-detailed, 4K, a blend of realistic and Pixar styles, sharp focus. Important notes: - Do not change the avatar (DP) - Maintain the exact same X interface layout and text style - Maintain their original identity - Only enhance the expression to a natural smile - Aspect ratio {argument name="ratio" default="9:16"}

items.title: 3D Social Media Profile Break-Out
items.description: A complex prompt to generate a 3D effect where a character breaks out of their social media profile screen, maintaining specific UI details and character features.
items.content: 一幅超寫實的3D插畫，描繪了一個略微傾斜的Twitter/X個人資料介面，背景為簡潔的黑色。原有的頭像（卡通女孩頭像）保持不變。個人資料介面與一張圖2完全一致，用戶名為“{argument name="用戶名" default="Aigirl"}”，帶有認證徽章、詳細的個人簡介、粉絲數和推文欄。 螢幕右側，一位{argument name="角色描述" default="圖1"}。她的五官與原圖相同（臉部未做任何修改），但現在擁有了燦爛自然的笑容、靈動的眼神和柔和透亮的肌膚。她一半身子在螢幕上掙脫，以動態的3D效果從螢幕中躍然而出。 螢幕掙脫造成的波紋劇烈晃動著。燈光採用柔和的影棚燈光，並帶有電影般的陰影 and 景深。超精細的4K分辨率，逼真的畫面与皮克斯風格的融合，畫面清晰銳利，在ArtStation上廣受歡迎。 重要提示： - 請勿變更頭像 (DP) - 保持 X 介面版面配置和文字樣式不變 - 保留女孩原有的臉部特徵 - 僅可將表情調整為自然微笑
items.translatedContent: A hyper-realistic 3D illustration depicting a slightly tilted Twitter/X profile interface with a simple black background. The original avatar (cartoon girl avatar) remains unchanged. The profile interface is identical to Image 2, with the username '{argument name="username" default="Aigirl"}', a verification badge, a detailed bio, follower count, and a tweet column. On the right side of the screen, a {argument name="character description" default="Image 1"}. Her features are the same as the original (no changes to the face), but she now has a bright, natural smile, lively eyes, and soft, translucent skin. Half of her body is breaking free from the screen, jumping out with a dynamic 3D effect. The ripples caused by breaking free from the screen are shaking violently. The lighting uses soft studio lighting with cinematic shadows and depth of field. Ultra-fine 4K resolution, a blend of realistic imagery and Pixar style, clear and sharp, popular on ArtStation. Important notes: - Do not change the avatar (DP) - Keep the X interface layout and text style unchanged - Retain the girl's original facial features - Only adjust the expression to a natural smile
